import { authMiddleware } from '../middleware/auth.middleware';
import { requireVerifiedEmail } from '../middleware/verification.middleware';
import {
  requireCarrierDispatcher,
  requireCarrierRole,
  requireDockManager,
} from '../middleware/rbac.middleware';
import { idempotencyMiddleware } from '../middleware/idempotency.middleware';

const router = Router();

/**
 * @openapi
 * /bookings:
 *   get:
 *     summary: List bookings for the authenticated user's organization
 *     description: Returns bookings filtered by carrier organization or warehouse operator organization.
 *     tags:
 *       - Bookings
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: List of bookings
 *       401:
 *         description: Authentication required
 */
router.get('/', authMiddleware, getBookings);

/**
 * @openapi
 * /bookings:
 *   post:
 *     summary: Create a confirmed dock booking
 *     description: |
 *       Atomically reserves a dock time slot and schedules an asynchronous outbox event.
 *       Protected against concurrent double-booking and mobile network retries via Idempotency-Key.
 *       Restricted to users with DISPATCHER role in a CARRIER organization.
 *     tags:
 *       - Bookings
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: header
 *         name: Idempotency-Key
 *         required: false
 *         schema:
 *           type: string
 *         description: Unique key to ensure idempotent booking requests across retries
 *         example: 7f8a1b2c-3d4e-5f6a-7b8c-9d0e1f2a3b4c
 *     requestBody:
 *       required: true
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             required:
 *               - dockId
 *               - slotStartTime
 *               - slotEndTime
 *               - truckPlate
 *               - driverName
 *               - driverPhone
 *             properties:
 *               dockId:
 *                 type: integer
 *                 example: 1
 *               slotStartTime:
 *                 type: string
 *                 format: date-time
 *                 example: '2026-11-15T04:00:00.000Z'
 *               slotEndTime:
 *                 type: string
 *                 format: date-time
 *                 example: '2026-11-15T04:30:00.000Z'
 *               truckPlate:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: WP-CA-4029
 *               driverName:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: Nuwan Perera
 *               driverPhone:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: '+94771234567'
 *               cargoNote:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: 20ft Container electronics
 *     responses:
 *       201:
 *         description: Booking confirmed and outbox event created
 *       400:
 *         description: Slot out of operating hours, past date, or invalid payload
 *       401:
 *         description: Authentication required
 *       403:
 *         description: Only carrier dispatchers with verified emails can create bookings
 *       409:
 *         description: Slot already booked or maintenance closure active (Concurrency conflict)
 */
router.post(
  '/',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  requireCarrierDispatcher,
  idempotencyMiddleware,
  createBooking
);

/**
 * @openapi
 * /bookings/{id}/reschedule:
 *   patch:
 *     summary: Reschedule a confirmed booking
 *     description: |
 *       Moves an existing confirmed booking to a new time slot (and optionally a new dock).
 *       Releases the old slot atomically and logs an audit log entry.
 *     tags:
 *       - Bookings
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: path
 *         name: id
 *         required: true
 *         schema:
 *           type: integer
 *         description: Booking ID
 *     requestBody:
 *       required: true
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             required:
 *               - slotStartTime
 *               - slotEndTime
 *             properties:
 *               slotStartTime:
 *                 type: string
 *                 format: date-time
 *                 example: '2026-11-15T05:00:00.000Z'
 *               slotEndTime:
 *                 type: string
 *                 format: date-time
 *                 example: '2026-11-15T05:30:00.000Z'
 *               newDockId:
 *                 type: integer
 *                 example: 2
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Booking successfully rescheduled
 *       400:
 *         description: Invalid slot times or booking cannot be rescheduled
 *       403:
 *         description: Forbidden. Tenant boundary violation
 *       404:
 *         description: Booking not found
 *       409:
 *         description: Target slot already occupied
 */
router.patch(
  '/:id/reschedule',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  requireCarrierRole,
  rescheduleBooking
);

/**
 * @openapi
 * /bookings/{id}/cancel:
 *   patch:
 *     summary: Cancel a confirmed booking
 *     description: Cancels the booking, releases the time slot for other carriers, and creates an audit log.
 *     tags:
 *       - Bookings
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: path
 *         name: id
 *         required: true
 *         schema:
 *           type: integer
 *         description: Booking ID
 *     requestBody:
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             properties:
 *               reason:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: Truck mechanical breakdown
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Booking cancelled and slot released
 *       400:
 *         description: Booking already cancelled or completed
 *       403:
 *         description: Forbidden. Not the owning carrier
 *       404:
 *         description: Booking not found
 */
router.patch(
  '/:id/cancel',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  requireCarrierRole,
  cancelBooking
);

/**
 * @openapi
 * /bookings/{id}:
 *   delete:
 *     summary: Cancel a confirmed booking (DELETE method alias)
 *     tags:
 *       - Bookings
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: path
 *         name: id
 *         required: true
 *         schema:
 *           type: integer
 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Booking cancelled successfully
 */
router.delete(
  '/:id',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  requireCarrierRole,
  cancelBooking
);

/**
 * @openapi
 * /bookings/{id}/audit-logs:
 *   get:
 *     summary: View lifecycle audit logs for a booking
 *     description: Dual-sided audit trail visible to both the carrier and the operating warehouse.
 *     tags:
 *       - Bookings
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: path
 *         name: id
 *         required: true
 *         schema:

 *         description: Array of lifecycle audit log entries (CREATED, RESCHEDULED, CANCELLED, etc.)
 *       403:
 *         description: Forbidden
 *       404:
 *         description: Booking not found
 */
router.get('/:id/audit-logs', authMiddleware, getBookingAuditLogs);

/**
 * @openapi
 * /bookings/{id}/status:
 *   patch:
 *     summary: Update operational status of a booking (Yard check-in / check-out)
 *     description: Restricted strictly to DOCK_MANAGER in the warehouse operator organization.
 *     tags:
 *       - Bookings
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:
 *       - in: path
 *         name: id
 *         required: true
 *         schema:
 *           type: integer
 *     requestBody:
 *       required: true
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             required:
 *               - status
 *             properties:
 *               status:
 *                 type: string
 *                 enum: [ARRIVED, NO_SHOW, COMPLETED]

 *     responses:
 *       200:
 *         description: Booking status updated successfully
 *       400:
 *         description: Invalid status transition
 *       403:
 *         description: Forbidden. Only Dock Managers can update operational status
 *       404:
 *         description: Booking not found
 */
router.patch(
  '/:id/status',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  requireDockManager,
  updateBookingStatus
);

export default router;

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';

describe('OpenAPI 3.0 & Swagger UI Integration Tests', () => {
  it('should serve Swagger UI at /api-docs', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api-docs/');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.text).toContain('Swagger UI');
    expect(res.text).toContain('swagger-ui');
  });

  it('should redirect /api-docs to /api-docs/', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api-docs');
    // Express / swagger-ui-express redirects to trailing slash or serves 200/301/302
    expect([200, 301, 302]).toContain(res.status);
  });

  it('should serve raw OpenAPI 3.0 JSON specification at /api-docs.json', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api-docs.json');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.openapi).toBe('3.0.0');
    expect(res.body.info.title).toBe('DockSlot Logistics & Dock Scheduling API');
    expect(res.body.info.version).toBe('1.0.0');

    // Verify Bearer Auth security scheme
    expect(res.body.components?.securitySchemes?.bearerAuth).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.components.securitySchemes.bearerAuth.type).toBe('http');
    expect(res.body.components.securitySchemes.bearerAuth.scheme).toBe('bearer');

    // Verify key documented endpoints
    expect(res.body.paths).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.paths['/auth/register']).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.paths['/auth/login']).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.paths['/users/invite']).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.paths['/bookings']).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.paths['/bookings/{id}/reschedule']).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.paths['/bookings/{id}/cancel']).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.paths['/warehouses/{warehouseId}/slots']).toBeDefined();
  });
});

import { authMiddleware } from '../middleware/auth.middleware';
import { requireVerifiedEmail } from '../middleware/verification.middleware';
import { requireWarehouseStaff } from '../middleware/rbac.middleware';

const router = Router();

/**

 *     summary: Schedule a maintenance closure window for a dock
 *     description: |
 *       Blocks out a specific time range for dock maintenance or repairs.
 *       During the closure, time slots for this dock are excluded from slot generation.
 *       Restricted strictly to warehouse staff (WAREHOUSE_ADMIN or DOCK_MANAGER) with a verified email.
 *     tags:
 *       - Docks
 *     security:
 *       - bearerAuth: []
 *     parameters:

 *         name: dockId
 *         required: true
 *         schema:
 *           type: integer
 *         description: ID of the dock to schedule closure for
 *         example: 1
 *     requestBody:
 *       required: true
 *       content:
 *         application/json:
 *           schema:
 *             type: object
 *             required:
 *               - startTime
 *               - endTime
 *             properties:
 *               startTime:
 *                 type: string
 *                 format: date-time
 *                 example: '2026-11-15T04:45:00.000Z'
 *               endTime:
 *                 type: string
 *                 format: date-time
 *                 example: '2026-11-15T05:45:00.000Z'
 *               reason:
 *                 type: string
 *                 example: Hydraulic lift sensor calibration and preventive maintenance
 *     responses:
 *       201:
 *         description: Dock closure successfully created
 *         content:
 *           application/json:
 *             schema:
 *               type: object
 *               properties:
 *                 success:
 *                   type: boolean
 *                   example: true
 *                 message:
 *                   type: string
 *                   example: Dock closure scheduled successfully.
 *                 data:
 *                   type: object
 *                   properties:
 *                     id:
 *                       type: integer
 *                     dockId:
 *                       type: integer
 *                     startTime:
 *                       type: string
 *                       format: date-time
 *                     endTime:
 *                       type: string
 *                       format: date-time
 *                     reason:
 *                       type: string
 *       400:
 *         description: Invalid time window or overlaps with confirmed bookings
 *       401:
 *         description: Authentication required
 *       403:
 *         description: Forbidden. Requires warehouse staff role and verified email
 *       404:
 *         description: Dock not found
 */
router.post(
  '/:dockId/closures',
  authMiddleware,
  requireVerifiedEmail,
  requireWarehouseStaff,
  createDockClosure
);

/**

---

### Endpoints Documented Under the `Docks` Tag

1. **`POST /api/docks/{dockId}/closures`**:
   - **Summary**: Schedule a maintenance closure window for a dock.
   - **Access**: Restricted to `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` or `DOCK_MANAGER` with a verified email (`bearerAuth`).
   - **Parameters**: `dockId` (path parameter).
   - **Payload**: `startTime` (ISO 8601 date-time), `endTime` (ISO 8601 date-time), `reason` (optional).
   - **Responses**:
     - `201 Created`: Closure scheduled, blocking time slots from the slot availability engine.
     - `400 Bad Request`: Invalid time range or conflicts with confirmed bookings.
     - `401 Unauthorized` / `403 Forbidden` / `404 Not Found`.

2. **`GET /api/docks/{dockId}/closures`**:
   - **Summary**: List all scheduled maintenance closures for a specific dock.
   - **Access**: Restricted to `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` or `DOCK_MANAGER` (`bearerAuth`).
   - **Parameters**: `dockId` (path parameter).
   - **Responses**:
     - `200 OK`: Array of scheduled closures (`id`, `dockId`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `reason`).
     - `401 Unauthorized` / `403 Forbidden` / `404 Not Found`.

/**
 * User and Organization Types derived from OpenAPI 3.0 Specification
 */

export type OrganizationType = 'CARRIER' | 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR';

export type UserRole =
  | 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN'
  | 'DOCK_MANAGER'
  | 'CARRIER_ADMIN'
  | 'DISPATCHER';

export interface Organization {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  type: OrganizationType;
  createdAt?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
}

export interface User {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  role: UserRole;
  organizationId: number;
  isEmailVerified: boolean;
  createdAt?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
  organization?: Organization;
}

export interface LoginRequest {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
}

export interface RegisterRequest {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
  organizationName?: string;
  orgName?: string;
  organizationType: OrganizationType;
  orgType?: OrganizationType;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  success?: boolean;
  message?: string;
  token?: string;
  user?: User;
  data?: {
    token: string;
    user: User;
  };
}

```typescript
const TOKEN_KEY = 'dockslot_auth_token';

/**
 * Cookie storage helper for managing JWT tokens.
 * Sets a persistent cookie with SameSite=Lax and 7-day expiration.
 */
export const setAuthCookie = (token: string, days = 7): void => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const maxAge = days * 24 * 60 * 60;
  document.cookie = `${TOKEN_KEY}=${encodeURIComponent(token)}; path=/; max-age=${maxAge}; SameSite=Lax`;
};

export const getAuthCookie = (): string | null => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
  const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )\\s*${TOKEN_KEY}=([^;]*)`));
  return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
};

export const removeAuthCookie = (): void => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  document.cookie = `${TOKEN_KEY}=; path=/; max-age=0; SameSite=Lax`;
};

export const storage = {
  getToken: (): string | null => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) || getAuthCookie();
  },
  setToken: (token: string): void => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
      setAuthCookie(token);
    }
  },
  removeToken: (): void => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
      removeAuthCookie();
    }
  },
  clear: (): void => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.clear();
      removeAuthCookie();
    }
  },
};

export default storage;

```

import React, { createContext, useState, useEffect, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { User } from '../types/user.types';
import { storage } from '../utils/storage';
import { authApi } from '../api/auth.api';

export interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null;
  token: string | null;
  login: (token: string, user: User) => void;
  logout: () => void;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
}

export const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(() => storage.getToken());
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const initializeAuth = async () => {
      const savedToken = storage.getToken();
      if (savedToken) {
        setToken(savedToken);
        try {
          const res = await authApi.getMe();
          if (res?.data) {
            setUser(res.data);
          }
        } catch {
          // Token expired or invalid
          storage.removeToken();
          setToken(null);
          setUser(null);
        }
      }
      setIsLoading(false);
    };

    initializeAuth();
  }, []);

  const login = (newToken: string, newUser: User) => {
    storage.setToken(newToken);
    setToken(newToken);
    setUser(newUser);
  };

  const logout = () => {
    storage.removeToken();
    setToken(null);
    setUser(null);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        token,
        login,
        logout,
        isAuthenticated: !!token,
        isLoading,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export default AuthContext;

```

import React from 'react';

export interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({
  children,
  className = '',
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  isLoading = false,
  disabled,
  ...props
}) => {
  const baseStyles =
    'inline-flex items-center justify-center font-medium rounded-md transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed';

  const variants = {
    primary:
      'bg-[#2F4F4F] hover:bg-[#243d3d] text-white focus:ring-[#2F4F4F] shadow-sm',
    secondary:
      'bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 focus:ring-gray-300',
    outline:
      'border border-gray-300 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]',
    ghost:
      'bg-transparent hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]',
  };

  const sizes = {
    sm: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs',
    md: 'px-4 py-2 text-sm',
    lg: 'px-6 py-2.5 text-base',
  };

  return (
    <button
      className={`${baseStyles} ${variants[variant]} ${sizes[size]} ${className}`}
      disabled={disabled || isLoading}
      {...props}
    >
      {isLoading ? (
        <span className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <svg
            className="animate-spin -ml-1 mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-current"
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"

            />
          </svg>
          <span>Loading...</span>
        </span>

        children
      )}

};

import React from 'react';

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

export interface TabsProps {
  tabs: TabItem[];
  activeTab: string;
  onChange: (tabId: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const Tabs: React.FC<TabsProps> = ({
  tabs,
  activeTab,
  onChange,
  className = '',
}) => {
  return (
    <div
      className={`grid grid-cols-2 p-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 ${className}`}
      role="tablist"
    >
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={isActive}
            onClick={() => onChange(tab.id)}
            className={`flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-2 px-3 text-sm font-semibold rounded-md transition-all duration-150 ${
              isActive
                ? 'bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-200/50'
            }`}
          >
            {tab.icon && <span className="w-4 h-4">{tab.icon}</span>}
            <span>{tab.label}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Tabs;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Mail,
  Lock,
  Building,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,

  CheckCircle2,
  Truck,
  Warehouse,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader } from '../components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '../components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '../components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '../components/ui/label';
import { Tabs } from '../components/ui/tabs';
import { authApi } from '../api/auth.api';
import { storage } from '../utils/storage';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import type {
  OrganizationType,
  User,
  LoginRequest,
  RegisterRequest,
} from '../types/user.types';

export type AuthTab = 'signin' | 'register';

export interface AuthPageProps {
  initialTab?: AuthTab;
  onSuccess?: (user: User, token: string) => void;
  onNavigate?: (route: 'carrier' | 'warehouse') => void;
}

export const AuthPage: React.FC<AuthPageProps> = ({
  initialTab = 'signin',
  onSuccess,
  onNavigate,
}) => {
  const { login: setAuthContextUser } = useAuth();

  // Tab State: 'signin' | 'register'
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<AuthTab>(initialTab);

  // Common UI State
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Sign In Form State
  const [signInEmail, setSignInEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]], setSignInPassword] = useState<string>('');

  // Register Org Form State
  const [registerOrgType, setRegisterOrgType] = useState<OrganizationType>('CARRIER');
  const [registerOrgName, setRegisterOrgName] = useState<string>('');
  const [registerEmail, setRegisterEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]], setRegisterPassword] = useState<string>('');

  // Clear messages on tab change
  const handleTabChange = (tabId: string) => {
    setActiveTab(tabId as AuthTab);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
  };

  /**
   * Route user to their respective dashboard based on role and organization type.
   */
  const handleDashboardRedirect = (user: User) => {
    const isCarrier =
      user.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN' ||
      user.role === 'DISPATCHER' ||
      user.organization?.type === 'CARRIER';

    const targetRoute = isCarrier ? 'carrier' : 'warehouse';

    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate(targetRoute);
    } else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.location.href = isCarrier ? '/carrier' : '/warehouse';
    }
  };

  /**
   * Form Submission: Sign In
   */
  const handleSignIn = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    if (!signInEmail.trim() || ![REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]) {
      setErrorMessage('Please provide both email address and [REDACTED:generic-password].');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const payload: LoginRequest = {
        email: signInEmail.trim().toLowerCase(),
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]],
      };

      const response = await authApi.login(payload);

      const token = response.token || response.data?.token;
      const user = response.user || response.data?.user;

      if (!token || !user) {
        throw new Error('Authentication succeeded but received an incomplete server response.');
      }

      // Store JWT in HTTP cookies and localStorage
      storage.setToken(token);

      // Update global context
      setAuthContextUser(token, user);

      setSuccessMessage('Login successful! Redirecting to dashboard...');

      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess(user, token);
      }

      // Smooth redirection
      setTimeout(() => {
        handleDashboardRedirect(user);
      }, 500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const serverMessage =
        err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Login failed. Please check your credentials.';
      setErrorMessage(serverMessage);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  /**

   */
  const handleRegister = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

      };

      const user = response.user || response.data?.user;

      if (!token || !user) {
        throw new Error('Registration completed but received an incomplete server response.');
      }

      // Store JWT in HTTP cookies and localStorage
      storage.setToken(token);

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { AuthProvider } from './context/AuthContext';
import { useAuth } from './hooks/useAuth';
import { AuthPage } from './pages/AuthPage';
import { CarrierDashboard } from './pages/CarrierDashboard';
import { WarehouseDashboard } from './pages/WarehouseDashboard';
import { Warehouse, LogOut } from 'lucide-react';

const AppContent: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, isAuthenticated, logout, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'auto' | 'carrier' | 'warehouse'>('auto');

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#D9D9D9] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center space-y-3">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#2F4F4F]">Loading DockSlot...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated || !user) {
    return (
      <AuthPage
        onNavigate={(route) => setActiveView(route)}
      />
    );
  }

  // Determine dashboard based on user role and organization
  const isCarrier =
    activeView === 'carrier' ||
    (activeView === 'auto' &&
      (user.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN' ||
        user.role === 'DISPATCHER' ||
        user.organization?.type === 'CARRIER'));

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex flex-col">
      {/* Top Navbar */}
      <header className="bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between shadow-md">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className="p-1.5 bg-white/10 rounded-md">
            <Warehouse className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="font-bold text-lg tracking-tight">DockSlot</span>
            <span className="ml-2 text-xs bg-white/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">
              {user.organization?.name || 'Workspace'} ({user.role})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
          <span className="text-xs text-gray-200 hidden sm:inline">
            Logged in as <strong className="text-white">{user.email}</strong>
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={logout}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-md transition-colors"
          >
            <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Sign Out</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Dashboard View */}
      <main className="flex-1 p-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto">
        {isCarrier ? <CarrierDashboard /> : <WarehouseDashboard />}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
};

export const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <AuthProvider>
      <AppContent />
    </AuthProvider>
  );
};

export default App;

```

### What Caused This Error?

The backend is configured in [`backend/.env`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/.env) to deliver emails via a local development SMTP server (such as [Mailhog](https://github.com/mailhog/MailHog)) on port `1025`:

```env
SMTP_HOST=localhost
SMTP_PORT=1025
```

The error `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:1025` occurs because **no SMTP server is currently listening on port 1025** on your local machine.

> [!NOTE]
> The backend already handles this gracefully in [`backend/src/services/email.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/email.service.ts) by catching the error. Registration and invitation requests still complete successfully with `201 Created`.

---

### Solutions

You can resolve or work with this in any of the following ways:

#### Option 1: Run Mailhog via Docker (Recommended for testing emails)
Run Mailhog locally in Docker to capture and inspect all outgoing emails in a web browser:
```bash
docker run -d -p 1025:1025 -p 8025:8025 --name mailhog mailhog/mailhog
```
- **SMTP Server**: Listens on `localhost:1025`
- **Mailhog Web UI**: Open [http://localhost:8025](http://localhost:8025) in your browser to view incoming verification and invitation emails.

---

#### Option 2: Use a Cloud SMTP Service (Mailtrap, SendGrid, Gmail)
If you prefer an external service, update [`backend/.env`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/.env) with your SMTP provider credentials:
```env
SMTP_HOST=sandbox.smtp.mailtrap.io
SMTP_PORT=2525
SMTP_USER=your_mailtrap_user
SMTP_PASS=your_mailtrap_[REDACTED:generic-password]
```

---

#### Option 3: Local Dev Console Preview (Zero Setup)
[`backend/src/services/email.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/email.service.ts) has been updated with two improvements:
1. **Dev Preview Links**: In non-production environments, verification, [REDACTED:generic-password] reset, and invitation links are printed directly to the terminal console:
   ```text
   [EmailService:DevPreview] Invitation link for user@example.com: http://localhost:5173/accept-invite?token=...
   ```
   You can copy and paste the link directly without needing an active SMTP server.
2. **Clean Logging**: Suppressed the raw TCP error stack trace when port 1025 is unreachable.

---

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Mail,
  ArrowLeft,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Warehouse,
  Send,
  RotateCcw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader } from '../components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '../components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '../components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '../components/ui/label';
import { authApi } from '../api/auth.api';

export interface ForgotPasswordPageProps {
  onBackToSignIn?: () => void;
  onSuccess?: (email: string) => void;
}

export const ForgotPasswordPage: React.FC<ForgotPasswordPageProps> = ({
  onBackToSignIn,
  onSuccess,
}) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submittedEmail, setSubmittedEmail] = useState<string>('');

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const trimmedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!trimmedEmail) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter your email address.');
      return;
    }

    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(trimmedEmail)) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter a valid email address.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      await authApi.forgotPassword(trimmedEmail);
      setSubmittedEmail(trimmedEmail);
      setIsSubmitted(true);
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess(trimmedEmail);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const serverMessage =
        err.response?.data?.message ||
        err.message ||
        'An error occurred while sending [REDACTED:generic-password] reset link.';
      setErrorMessage(serverMessage);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetForm = () => {
    setIsSubmitted(false);
    setEmail('');
    setErrorMessage(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#D9D9D9] flex flex-col justify-center items-center p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
      {/* Brand Header */}
      <div className="mb-6 text-center">
        <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 mb-2">
          <div className="p-2.5 bg-[#2F4F4F] rounded-lg text-white shadow-md">
            <Warehouse className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <span className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#2F4F4F]">
            DockSlot
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-600">
          Smart Warehouse Dock Scheduling & Carrier Logistics
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Main Centered White Card */}
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md bg-white shadow-xl rounded-lg border border-gray-300 overflow-hidden">
        <CardHeader className="text-center pb-2">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#2F4F4F]">
            {isSubmitted ? 'Check Your Inbox' : 'Reset Your Password'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
            {isSubmitted
              ? 'Password reset instructions have been dispatched'
              : "Enter your registered email address and we'll send you a link to reset your [REDACTED:generic-password]"}
          </p>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="pt-4">
          {/* Error Banner */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="mb-4 flex items-start space-x-3 p-3.5 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-red-800 text-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="flex-1 font-medium leading-tight">
                {errorMessage}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {isSubmitted ? (
            /* Success Confirmation View */
            <div className="space-y-5 text-center py-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-7 h-7" />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
                  Instructions Sent!
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 leading-relaxed px-4">
                  If an account exists for{' '}
                  <strong className="text-gray-900">{submittedEmail}</strong>,
                  you will receive an email shortly with a secure [REDACTED:generic-password] reset link.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-md text-amber-800 text-xs text-left">
                <strong>Important:</strong> The [REDACTED:generic-password] reset link expires in 1 hour. Be sure to check your spam or junk folder if you don't see it within a few minutes.
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
                {onBackToSignIn ? (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="primary"
                    className="w-full"
                    onClick={onBackToSignIn}
                  >
                    <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    <span>Return to Sign In</span>
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="primary"
                    className="w-full"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
                        window.location.href = '/login';
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    <span>Return to Sign In</span>
                  </Button>
                )}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleResetForm}
                  className="inline-flex items-center text-xs text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 font-medium py-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
                  <span>Send to a different email address</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* Form View */
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="forgot-email" required>
                  Email Address
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="forgot-email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  required
                  placeholder="name@company.com"
                  icon={<Mail className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                  hasError={!!errorMessage}
                />
              </div>

              <Button
                type="submit"
                variant="primary"
                className="w-full mt-2"
                isLoading={isLoading}
              >
                <span>Send Reset Link</span>
                {!isLoading && <Send className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />}
              </Button>

              <div className="pt-2 text-center">
                {onBackToSignIn ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onBackToSignIn}
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className="inline-flex items-center text-xs font-semibold text-[#2F4F4F] hover:underline"
                  >
                    <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
                    <span>Back to Sign In</span>
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <a
                    href="/login"
                    className="inline-flex items-center text-xs font-semibold text-[#2F4F4F] hover:underline"
                  >
                    <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
                    <span>Back to Sign In</span>
                  </a>
                )}
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Footer Info */}
      <div className="mt-8 text-center text-xs text-gray-500">
        &copy; {new Date().getFullYear()} DockSlot Inc. Multi-tenant Logistics Platform.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ForgotPasswordPage;

```

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { AuthProvider } from './context/AuthContext';
import { useAuth } from './hooks/useAuth';
import { AuthPage } from './pages/AuthPage';
import { ResetPasswordPage } from './pages/ResetPasswordPage';
import { ForgotPasswordPage } from './pages/ForgotPasswordPage';
import { CarrierDashboard } from './pages/CarrierDashboard';
import { WarehouseDashboard } from './pages/WarehouseDashboard';
import { Warehouse, LogOut } from 'lucide-react';

const AppContent: React.FC = () => {
  const { user, isAuthenticated, logout, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'auto' | 'carrier' | 'warehouse'>('auto');

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#D9D9D9] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center space-y-3">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#2F4F4F]">Loading DockSlot...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Handle URL paths for Password Reset & Forgot Password
  const pathname = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.pathname : '';
  const searchParams =
    typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
      : new URLSearchParams();
  const urlToken = searchParams.get('token') || undefined;

  if (pathname.includes('reset-[REDACTED:generic-password]')) {
    return (
      <ResetPasswordPage
        token={urlToken}
        onBackToSignIn={() => {
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            window.location.href = '/';
          }
        }}
        onSuccess={() => {
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            window.location.href = '/';
          }
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  if (pathname.includes('forgot-[REDACTED:generic-password]')) {
    return (
      <ForgotPasswordPage
        onBackToSignIn={() => {
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            window.location.href = '/';
          }
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated || !user) {
    return (
      <AuthPage
        resetToken={urlToken}
        onNavigate={(route) => setActiveView(route)}
      />
    );
  }

  // Determine dashboard based on user role and organization
  const isCarrier =
    activeView === 'carrier' ||
    (activeView === 'auto' &&
      (user.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN' ||
        user.role === 'DISPATCHER' ||
        user.organization?.type === 'CARRIER'));

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex flex-col">
      {/* Top Navbar */}
      <header className="bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between shadow-md">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className="p-1.5 bg-white/10 rounded-md">
            <Warehouse className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="font-bold text-lg tracking-tight">DockSlot</span>
            <span className="ml-2 text-xs bg-white/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">
              {user.organization?.name || 'Workspace'} ({user.role})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
          <span className="text-xs text-gray-200 hidden sm:inline">
            Logged in as <strong className="text-white">{user.email}</strong>
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={logout}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-md transition-colors"
          >
            <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Sign Out</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Dashboard View */}
      <main className="flex-1 p-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto">
        {isCarrier ? <CarrierDashboard /> : <WarehouseDashboard />}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
};

export const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <AuthProvider>
      <AppContent />
    </AuthProvider>
  );
};

export default App;

```

```typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';
import { emailService } from './email.service';

export interface CreateInvitationInput {
  email: string;
}

export interface RequesterContext {
  userId: number;
  organizationId: number;
  role: string;
}

export interface InvitationResponse {
  invitation: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    organizationId: number;
    role: string;
    token: string;
    expiresAt: Date;
    status: string;
    createdAt: Date;
  };
  message: string;
}

export interface AcceptInvitationInput {
  token: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
}

export interface AcceptInvitationResponse {
  token: string;
  user: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    role: UserRole;
    organizationId: number;
    isEmailVerified: boolean;
    organization?: {
      id: number;
      name: string;
      type: string;
    };
  };
}

export class InvitationService {
  /**
   * Helper to issue a signed JWT token containing user ID, organization ID, and role.
   */
  public generateToken(user: { id: number; organizationId: number; role: UserRole; email: string }): string {
    return jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: user.id,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        role: user.role,
        email: user.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn as any }
    );
  }

  /**
   * Create or refresh an invitation for a new team member.
   * - Restricted strictly to CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.
   * - CARRIER_ADMIN -> "DISPATCHER"
   * - WAREHOUSE_ADMIN -> "DOCK_MANAGER"
   * - Token expiration: 48 hours
   * - Rejects if email belongs to an existing user (409 Conflict)
   */
  public async createInvitation(
    requester: RequesterContext,
    input: CreateInvitationInput
  ): Promise<InvitationResponse> {
    const { email } = input;

    if (!email || typeof email !== 'string') {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'A valid email address is required.' };
    }

    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(normalizedEmail)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid email address format.' };
    }

    // Role mapping
    let targetRole: string;
    if (requester.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN') {
      targetRole = 'DISPATCHER';
    } else if (requester.role === 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN') {
      targetRole = 'DOCK_MANAGER';
    } else {
      throw {
        status: 403,
        message: `Forbidden. Role '${requester.role}' cannot invite users. Only CARRIER_ADMIN and WAREHOUSE_ADMIN are authorized.`,
      };
    }

    // Check if user already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    // Verify requester organization exists
    const organization = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: requester.organizationId },
    });

    if (!organization) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Requester organization not found.' };
    }

    // Generate secure random token and 48-hour expiration
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 48 hours

    // Upsert invitation record (handles fresh invites and resends)
    const invitation = await prisma.invitation.upsert({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
      create: {
        email: normalizedEmail,
        organizationId: requester.organizationId,
        role: targetRole,
        token,
        expiresAt,
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
      update: {
        organizationId: requester.organizationId,
        role: targetRole,
        token,
        expiresAt,
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });

    // Send invitation email asynchronously
    emailService
      .sendInvitationEmail(normalizedEmail, organization.name, targetRole, token)
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('[InvitationService] Failed to dispatch invitation email:', err);
      });

    return {
      invitation,
      message: `Invitation successfully created for ${normalizedEmail} as ${targetRole}.`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Accept an invitation and create user account.
   */
  public async acceptInvitation(input: AcceptInvitationInput): Promise<AcceptInvitationResponse> {
    const { token, [REDACTED:generic-password] } = input;

    if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invitation token is required.' };
    }

    if (![REDACTED:generic-password] || typeof [REDACTED:generic-password] !== 'string' || [REDACTED:generic-password].length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    const invitation = await prisma.invitation.findUnique({
      where: { token },
      include: { organization: true },
    });

    if (!invitation) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Invalid or non-existent invitation token.' };
    }

    if (invitation.status !== 'PENDING') {
      throw { status: 400, message: `Invitation cannot be accepted. Current status is ${invitation.status}.` };
    }

    if (new Date(invitation.expiresAt) <= new Date()) {
      await prisma.invitation.update({
        where: { id: invitation.id },
        data: { status: 'EXPIRED' },
      }).catch(() => {});
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invitation token has expired.' };
    }

    // Check if user with this email already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: invitation.email },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash([REDACTED:generic-password], securityConfig.saltRounds);

    const { user, organization } = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const newUser = await tx.user.create({
        data: {
          email: invitation.email,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
          role: invitation.role as UserRole,
          organizationId: invitation.organizationId,
          isActive: true,
          isEmailVerified: true,
        },
      });

      await tx.invitation.update({
        where: { id: invitation.id },
        data: { status: 'ACCEPTED' },
      });

      return { user: newUser, organization: invitation.organization };
    });

    const jwtToken = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token: jwtToken,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
        organization: {
          id: organization.id,
          name: organization.name,
          type: organization.type,
        },
      },
    };
  }
}

export const invitationService = new InvitationService();

```

### What Was Implemented & Fixed

1. **Dedicated Password Reset Component ([`ResetPasswordPage.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/ResetPasswordPage.tsx)):**

   - Includes [REDACTED:generic-password] visibility toggle buttons (`Eye` / `EyeOff` icons from `lucide-react`).

   - Displays clear error alerts if the token is expired or invalid.
   - Shows a success confirmation screen with a "Sign In to Dashboard" button to return to login.

export type DockStatus = 'ACTIVE' | 'MAINTENANCE';

export interface Dock {
  id: number;
  warehouseId: number;
  name: string;
  status: DockStatus;
  createdAt?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;
  warehouse?: {

    timezone?: string;

}

  closeTime: string;

}

}

    return response.data;
  },

  create: async (data: CreateBookingRequest): Promise<{ success: boolean; data: Booking }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.post<{ success: boolean; data: Booking }>('/bookings', data);
    return response.data;
  },

  updateStatus: async (
    id: number,
    status: UpdateBookingStatusRequest['status']
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Booking }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.patch<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Booking }>(
      `/bookings/${id}/status`,
      { status }
    );
    return response.data;
  },

  reschedule: async (
    id: number,
    data: { slotStartTime: string; slotEndTime: string; dockId?: number; reason?: string }
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Booking }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.patch<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Booking }>(
      `/bookings/${id}/reschedule`,
      data
    );
    return response.data;
  },

  cancel: async (
    id: number,
    reason?: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Booking }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.patch<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Booking }>(
      `/bookings/${id}/cancel`,
      { reason }
    );
    return response.data;
  },
};

export default bookingApi;

import apiClient from './client';
import type {
  Warehouse,
  Dock,
  DockClosure,
  CreateDockClosureRequest,
  DockStatus,
} from '../types/warehouse.types';

export const warehouseApi = {
  getAll: async (): Promise<{ success: boolean; data: Warehouse[] }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.get<{ success: boolean; data: Warehouse[] }>('/warehouses');
    return response.data;
  },

  getById: async (id: number | string): Promise<{ success: boolean; data: Warehouse }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.get<{ success: boolean; data: Warehouse }>(`/warehouses/${id}`);
    return response.data;
  },

  getDocks: async (warehouseId: number): Promise<{ success: boolean; data: Dock[] }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.get<{ success: boolean; data: Dock[] }>(
      `/warehouses/${warehouseId}/docks`
    );
    return response.data;
  },

  updateDockStatus: async (
    dockId: number,
    status: DockStatus
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Dock }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.patch<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: Dock }>(
      `/warehouses/docks/${dockId}/status`,
      { status }
    );
    return response.data;
  },

  createDockClosure: async (
    dockId: number,

  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; data: DockClosure }> => {

  getDockClosures: async (

    );

  },
};
