```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Warehouse as WarehouseIcon,
  Truck,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  Calendar,
  Filter,
  Search,
  RefreshCw,
  PlusCircle,
  Wrench,
  ShieldAlert,
  Phone,
  User,
  FileText,
  X,
  ChevronDown,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from '../components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '../components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '../components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '../components/ui/label';
import { bookingApi } from '../api/booking.api';
import { warehouseApi } from '../api/warehouse.api';
import type { Booking, BookingStatus } from '../types/booking.types';
import type { Warehouse, Dock, DockClosure } from '../types/warehouse.types';
import { formatDateTime } from '../utils/formatters';

export const DockManagerDashboard: React.FC = () => {
  // State for Bookings & Warehouses
  const [bookings, setBookings] = useState<Booking[]>([]);
  const [warehouses, setWarehouses] = useState<Warehouse[]>([]);
  const [closures, setClosures] = useState<DockClosure[]>([]);

  // Loading & Error States
  const [isLoadingBookings, setIsLoadingBookings] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isLoadingWarehouses, setIsLoadingWarehouses] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [statusActionLoadingId, setStatusActionLoadingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successBanner, setSuccessBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filters
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedStatusFilter, setSelectedStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [selectedWarehouseId, setSelectedWarehouseId] = useState<string>('ALL');

  // Modal State for Maintenance Closure
  const [isClosureModalOpen, setIsClosureModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [selectedDockForClosure, setSelectedDockForClosure] = useState<number | ''>('');
  const [closureStartTime, setClosureStartTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [closureEndTime, setClosureEndTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [closureReason, setClosureReason] = useState<string>('');
  const [closureError, setClosureError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmittingClosure, setIsSubmittingClosure] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Fetch initial data
  const fetchData = async () => {
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      setIsLoadingBookings(true);
      setIsLoadingWarehouses(true);

      const [bookingsRes, warehousesRes] = await Promise.all([
        bookingApi.getAll(),
        warehouseApi.getAll(),
      ]);

      const fetchedBookings = bookingsRes?.data || [];
      const fetchedWarehouses = warehousesRes?.data || [];

      setBookings(fetchedBookings);
      setWarehouses(fetchedWarehouses);

      // Fetch closures for all docks across warehouses
      const allDocks: Dock[] = [];
      fetchedWarehouses.forEach((wh) => {
        if (wh.docks) {
          wh.docks.forEach((d) => allDocks.push(d));
        }
      });

      if (allDocks.length > 0) {
        try {
          const closurePromises = allDocks.map((dock) =>
            warehouseApi.getDockClosures(dock.id).catch(() => ({ data: [] }))
          );
          const closureResults = await Promise.all(closurePromises);
          const aggregatedClosures: DockClosure[] = [];
          closureResults.forEach((res, index) => {
            if (res?.data) {
              const dockData = allDocks[index];
              res.data.forEach((c) => {
                aggregatedClosures.push({ ...c, dock: dockData });
              });
            }
          });
          setClosures(aggregatedClosures);
        } catch {
          // Non-critical if closures fail to load
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(
        err.response?.data?.message ||
          err.message ||
          'Failed to load dock manager dashboard data. Please try again.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingBookings(false);
      setIsLoadingWarehouses(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  // Clear success banner after 5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (successBanner) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setSuccessBanner(null), 5000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [successBanner]);

  // Aggregate all docks from warehouses
  const allDocks = useMemo(() => {
    const list: (Dock & { warehouseName: string })[] = [];
    warehouses.forEach((wh) => {
      if (wh.docks) {
        wh.docks.forEach((d) => {
          list.push({ ...d, warehouseName: wh.name });
        });
      }
    });
    return list;
  }, [warehouses]);

  // Filtered Bookings
  const filteredBookings = useMemo(() => {
    return bookings.filter((b) => {
      // Warehouse Filter
      if (selectedWarehouseId !== 'ALL') {
        const whId = b.dock?.warehouseId || b.dock?.warehouse?.id;
        if (whId !== undefined && whId !== Number(selectedWarehouseId)) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // Status Filter
      if (selectedStatusFilter !== 'ALL' && b.status !== selectedStatusFilter) {
        return false;
      }

      // Search Query (ID, carrier, truck plate, driver name, driver phone, cargo note)
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
        const matchesId = b.id.toString().includes(query);
        const matchesCarrier = b.carrierOrg?.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesTruck = b.truckPlate?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesDriver = b.driverName?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesPhone = b.driverPhone?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesDock = b.dock?.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesNote = b.cargoNote?.toLowerCase().includes(query);

        return (
          matchesId ||
          matchesCarrier ||
          matchesTruck ||
          matchesDriver ||
          matchesPhone ||
          matchesDock ||
          matchesNote
        );
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [bookings, selectedWarehouseId, selectedStatusFilter, searchQuery]);

  // Handle Truck Status Update (Arrived / No-Show / Completed)
  const handleUpdateStatus = async (
    bookingId: number,
    newStatus: 'ARRIVED' | 'NO_SHOW' | 'COMPLETED'
  ) => {
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setStatusActionLoadingId(bookingId);
    try {
      const res = await bookingApi.updateStatus(bookingId, newStatus);
      const updatedBooking = res.data;

      // Update local state smoothly
      setBookings((prev) =>
        prev.map((b) => (b.id === bookingId ? { ...b, status: updatedBooking.status } : b))
      );

      const statusLabels: Record<string, string> = {
        ARRIVED: 'Marked as Arrived',
        NO_SHOW: 'Marked as No-Show',
        COMPLETED: 'Marked as Completed',
      };

      setSuccessBanner(
        `Booking #${bookingId} successfully ${statusLabels[newStatus] || newStatus}.`
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(
        err.response?.data?.message ||
          err.message ||
          `Failed to update status for booking #${bookingId}.`
      );
    } finally {
      setStatusActionLoadingId(null);
    }
  };

  // Open Closure Modal (optionally preselecting a dock)
  const handleOpenClosureModal = (dockId?: number) => {
    setClosureError(null);
    setSelectedDockForClosure(dockId !== undefined ? dockId : allDocks[0]?.id || '');

    // Default start time: current time rounded to nearest 15 mins
    const now = new Date();
    now.setMinutes(Math.ceil(now.getMinutes() / 15) * 15, 0, 0);
    const startIso = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000)
      .toISOString()
      .slice(0, 16);

    // Default end time: +2 hours
    const end = new Date(now.getTime() + 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const endIso = new Date(end.getTime() - end.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000)
      .toISOString()
      .slice(0, 16);

    setClosureStartTime(startIso);
    setClosureEndTime(endIso);
    setClosureReason('');
    setIsClosureModalOpen(true);
  };

  // Submit Closure Modal
  const handleSubmitClosure = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setClosureError(null);

    if (!selectedDockForClosure) {
      setClosureError('Please select a dock to schedule maintenance.');
      return;
    }

    if (!closureStartTime || !closureEndTime) {
      setClosureError('Both start time and end time are required.');
      return;
    }

    const startDate = new Date(closureStartTime);
    const endDate = new Date(closureEndTime);

    if (endDate <= startDate) {
      setClosureError('End time must be after the start time.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmittingClosure(true);

      const res = await warehouseApi.createDockClosure(Number(selectedDockForClosure), {
        startTime: startDate.toISOString(),
        endTime: endDate.toISOString(),
        reason: closureReason.trim() || undefined,
      });

      const newClosure = res.data;
      const targetDock = allDocks.find((d) => d.id === Number(selectedDockForClosure));

      setClosures((prev) => [{ ...newClosure, dock: targetDock }, ...prev]);
      setSuccessBanner(
        `Maintenance closure scheduled successfully for Dock ${
          targetDock?.name || selectedDockForClosure
        }.`
      );
      setIsClosureModalOpen(false);

      // Refresh data in background
      fetchData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const serverMessage =
        err.response?.data?.message ||
        err.message ||
        'Failed to schedule dock closure. Please check for scheduling conflicts.';
      setClosureError(serverMessage);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingClosure(false);
    }
  };

  // Helper for Status Badge styling
  const renderStatusBadge = (status: BookingStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'BOOKED':
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200">
            <Clock className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
            BOOKED
          </span>
        );
      case 'ARRIVED':
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
            ARRIVED
          </span>
        );
      case 'COMPLETED':
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
            COMPLETED
          </span>
        );
      case 'NO_SHOW':
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200">
            <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
            NO-SHOW
          </span>
        );
      case 'CANCELLED':
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border border-gray-300">
            <XCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
            CANCELLED
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border border-gray-300">
            {status}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 border-b border-gray-200 pb-5">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <div className="p-2 bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white rounded-lg shadow-sm">
              <WarehouseIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900">
              Dock Manager Dashboard
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
            Real-time yard check-ins, dock availability tracking, and maintenance closure management.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={fetchData}
            isLoading={isLoadingBookings || isLoadingWarehouses}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Refresh</span>
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => handleOpenClosureModal()}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5"
          >
            <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Close Dock / Maintenance</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Global Alert Banners */}
      {errorMessage && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200"
        >
          <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="flex-1 font-medium">{errorMessage}</div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setErrorMessage(null)}
            className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {successBanner && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-emerald-800 flex items-start space-x-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200"
        >
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="flex-1 font-medium">{successBanner}</div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setSuccessBanner(null)}
            className="text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Section 1: Dock Bay Operational Status Overview */}
      <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between pb-3">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Wrench className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
              <span>Dock Bays & Operational Status</span>
            </CardTitle>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
              Active loading bays and ongoing scheduled maintenance closures.
            </p>
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-md text-gray-700">
            {allDocks.length} {allDocks.length === 1 ? 'Bay' : 'Bays'} Total
          </span>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent>
          {isLoadingWarehouses ? (
            <div className="py-8 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 text-gray-500 text-sm">
              <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
              <span>Loading docks...</span>
            </div>
          ) : allDocks.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-6 text-sm text-gray-500">
              No docks registered in your warehouse facilities.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5">
              {allDocks.map((dock) => {
                const isUnderMaintenance = dock.status === 'MAINTENANCE';
                // Check if dock has active/upcoming closures
                const dockClosures = closures.filter((c) => c.dockId === dock.id);
                const hasUpcomingClosures = dockClosures.length > 0;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={dock.id}
                    className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border transition-all ${
                      isUnderMaintenance
                        ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/50'
                        : 'border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-300 shadow-xs'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-900 truncate">
                        {dock.name}
                      </div>
                      <span
                        className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                          isUnderMaintenance
                            ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200'
                            : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {dock.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 truncate mb-3">
                      <WarehouseIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{dock.warehouseName}</span>
                    </div>

                    {hasUpcomingClosures && (
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-900 bg-amber-100/70 p-1.5 rounded mb-2 flex items-start space-x-1">
                        <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <span className="truncate">
                          {dockClosures.length} scheduled closure(s)
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="pt-1 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-end">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenClosureModal(dock.id)}
                        className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#2F4F4F] hover:underline inline-flex items-center"
                      >
                        <PlusCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                        <span>Schedule Closure</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Section 2: Warehouse Bookings Table */}
      <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-gray-100">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
                <Truck className="w-5 h-5 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                <span>Warehouse Bookings & Yard Activity</span>
              </CardTitle>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                Incoming truck appointments, carrier dispatch manifests, and quick check-in actions.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Total Count Pill */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
                Showing{' '}
                <strong className="text-gray-900">{filteredBookings.length}</strong> of{' '}
                <strong className="text-gray-900">{bookings.length}</strong> bookings
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Search & Filter Toolbar */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 pt-4">
            {/* Search Bar */}
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <Input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search by ID, truck plate, driver, carrier..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                icon={<Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Warehouse Filter */}
            <div>
              <div className="relative">
                <select
                  value={selectedWarehouseId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedWarehouseId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-gray-300 pl-3 pr-8 text-xs bg-white text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F] focus:border-[#2F4F4F]"
                >
                  <option value="ALL">All Warehouses</option>
                  {warehouses.map((wh) => (
                    <option key={wh.id} value={wh.id}>
                      {wh.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 absolute right-2.5 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Status Filter */}
            <div>
              <div className="relative">
                <select
                  value={selectedStatusFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-gray-300 pl-3 pr-8 text-xs bg-white text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F] focus:border-[#2F4F4F]"
                >
                  <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
                  <option value="BOOKED">BOOKED (Incoming)</option>
                  <option value="ARRIVED">ARRIVED (In Yard)</option>
                  <option value="COMPLETED">COMPLETED</option>
                  <option value="NO_SHOW">NO_SHOW</option>
                  <option value="CANCELLED">CANCELLED</option>
                </select>
                <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 absolute right-2.5 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {isLoadingBookings ? (
            <div className="py-16 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-3 text-gray-500">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">Loading warehouse bookings...</p>
            </div>
          ) : filteredBookings.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
              <Truck className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-gray-300 mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">No bookings found</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
                {bookings.length === 0
                  ? 'No dock reservations have been created for this warehouse yet.'
                  : 'Try adjusting your search query or filters to find what you are looking for.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-gray-50/80 border-b border-gray-200 text-gray-600 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Booking ID</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Carrier Name</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Dock Bay</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Scheduled Window</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Truck Plate</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Driver Details</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Cargo Note</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Current Status</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                  {filteredBookings.map((booking) => {
                    const isActionLoading = statusActionLoadingId === booking.id;
                    const isBooked = booking.status === 'BOOKED';
                    const isArrived = booking.status === 'ARRIVED';

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={booking.id}
                        className="hover:bg-gray-50/70 transition-colors"
                      >
                        {/* 1. Booking ID */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-gray-900 whitespace-nowrap">
                          #{booking.id}
                        </td>

                        {/* 2. Carrier Name */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium text-gray-800 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                            <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                            <span>{booking.carrierOrg?.name || 'Carrier'}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* 3. Dock Bay */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                            {booking.dock?.name || `Dock #${booking.dockId}`}
                          </div>
                          {booking.dock?.warehouse?.name && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 truncate">
                              {booking.dock.warehouse.name}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* 4. Scheduled Time Window */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-gray-800 font-medium">
                            <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400" />
                            <span>
                              {formatDateTime(booking.slotStartTime, 'MMM dd, yyyy')}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">
                            {formatDateTime(booking.slotStartTime, 'HH:mm')} –{' '}
                            {formatDateTime(booking.slotEndTime, 'HH:mm')}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* 5. Truck Plate */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {booking.truckPlate ? (
                            <span className="font-mono bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold text-[11px] border border-gray-200">
                              {booking.truckPlate}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-gray-400">—</span>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* 6. Driver Details */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="font-medium text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-1">
                            <User className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                            <span>{booking.driverName || '—'}</span>
                          </div>
                          {booking.driverPhone && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 font-mono">
                              <Phone className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                              <span>{booking.driverPhone}</span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* 7. Cargo Note */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 max-w-xs">
                          {booking.cargoNote ? (
                            <div
                              className="text-gray-600 truncate flex items-center space-x-1"
                              title={booking.cargoNote}
                            >
                              <FileText className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                              <span className="truncate">{booking.cargoNote}</span>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-gray-400">—</span>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* 8. Current Status */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {renderStatusBadge(booking.status)}
                        </td>

                        {/* 9. Actions */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                          {isActionLoading ? (
                            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 text-gray-400 text-xs py-1">
                              <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                              <span>Updating...</span>
                            </div>
                          ) : isBooked ? (
                            /* Incoming Truck Actions: Mark Arrived or Mark No-Show */
                            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="primary"
                                onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(booking.id, 'ARRIVED')}
                                className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 h-7"
                                title="Mark incoming truck as arrived at the facility yard"
                              >
                                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                                <span>Arrived</span>
                              </Button>

                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="outline"
                                onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(booking.id, 'NO_SHOW')}
                                className="border-rose-200 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 h-7"
                                title="Mark carrier appointment as a No-Show"
                              >
                                <XCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                                <span>No-Show</span>
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          ) : isArrived ? (
                            /* In-Yard Truck Action: Mark Completed */
                            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="outline"
                                onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(booking.id, 'COMPLETED')}
                                className="border-purple-200 text-purple-700 hover:bg-purple-50 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 h-7"
                                title="Complete unloading/loading and clear dock bay"
                              >
                                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                                <span>Complete</span>
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-gray-400 text-xs italic">
                              No actions available
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Close Dock / Schedule Maintenance Modal */}
      {isClosureModalOpen && (
        <div
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-y-auto bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
        >
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl max-w-md w-full border border-gray-300 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <div className="p-1.5 bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white rounded">
                  <Wrench className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-gray-900">
                  Schedule Dock Maintenance Closure
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsClosureModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 focus:outline-none"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmitClosure} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {closureError && (
                <div
                  role="alert"
                  className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-xs text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-2"
                >
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="flex-1 font-medium">{closureError}</div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* 1. Dock Selection */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="closure-dock" required>
                  Dock Bay
                </Label>
                <select
                  id="closure-dock"
                  value={selectedDockForClosure}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedDockForClosure(Number(e.target.value))}
                  required
                  disabled={isSubmittingClosure}
                  className="w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F] focus:border-[#2F4F4F]"
                >
                  {allDocks.map((dock) => (
                    <option key={dock.id} value={dock.id}>
                      {dock.name} ({dock.warehouseName}) - Status: {dock.status}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  Time slots within this window will be temporarily blocked from booking.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* 2. Reason */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="closure-reason">Maintenance Reason / Note</Label>
                <Input
                  id="closure-reason"
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Hydraulic lift sensor calibration or routine inspection"
                  value={closureReason}
                  onChange={(e) => setClosureReason(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingClosure}
                />
              </div>

              {/* 3. Start Time */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="closure-start" required>
                  Closure Start Time
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="closure-start"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  required
                  value={closureStartTime}
                  onChange={(e) => setClosureStartTime(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingClosure}
                />
              </div>

              {/* 4. End Time */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="closure-end" required>
                  Closure End Time
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="closure-end"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  required
                  value={closureEndTime}
                  onChange={(e) => setClosureEndTime(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingClosure}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-2 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => setIsClosureModalOpen(false)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingClosure}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  variant="primary"
                  isLoading={isSubmittingClosure}
                >
                  Schedule Closure
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DockManagerDashboard;
```

The **Dock Manager Dashboard** component has been implemented for the DockSlot frontend in [`DockManagerDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DockManagerDashboard.tsx), tailored for users with the `DOCK_MANAGER` role (and accessible to `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN`).

---

### What Was Implemented

1. **Warehouse Bookings Table ([`DockManagerDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DockManagerDashboard.tsx)):**
   - Fetches all bookings associated with the manager's warehouses via [`bookingApi.getAll()`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/booking.api.ts#L5-L8) (`GET /bookings`).
   - Displays all required columns:
     - **Booking ID**: `#<id>`
     - **Carrier Name**: Name of the carrier organization
     - **Dock Bay**: Dock name and warehouse facility tag
     - **Scheduled Time Window**: Date and start–end time formatted via `date-fns`
     - **Truck Plate**: Monospace plate badge with truck icon
     - **Driver Name & Phone**: Driver details with phone link
     - **Cargo Note**: Manifest notes with tooltip
     - **Current Status**: Color-coded badges (`BOOKED`, `ARRIVED`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`, `NO_SHOW`)
   - Includes real-time search (by Booking ID, truck plate, driver name, carrier) and filters by warehouse and status.

2. **Truck Operational Status Actions:**
   - Quick action buttons on each booking row:
     - **"Arrived"** (green checkmark) for `BOOKED` incoming trucks.
     - **"No-Show"** (red alert) for `BOOKED` trucks that failed to arrive.
     - **"Complete"** (purple checkmark) for `ARRIVED` trucks once unloading/loading is finished.
   - Invokes [`bookingApi.updateStatus(id, status)`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/booking.api.ts#L15-L23) hitting `PATCH /bookings/{id}/status` as defined in `open-api.json`.
   - Smooth inline loading spinners and auto-dismissing success/error alerts.

3. **Dock Management & Maintenance Closures:**
   - **Dock Bay Operational Status Grid**: Visual cards displaying all active docks, their operational status (`ACTIVE` vs `MAINTENANCE`), parent warehouse, and count of active/upcoming maintenance closures.
   - **"Close Dock" Action & Modal**:
     - Allows the Dock Manager to schedule a maintenance closure by inputting:
       - **Dock**: Selector populated with active bays
       - **Reason**: Maintenance notes / sensor calibration details
       - **Start Time**: `datetime-local` picker
       - **End Time**: `datetime-local` picker (validated to be after start time)
     - Calls [`warehouseApi.createDockClosure(dockId, data)`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/warehouse.api.ts#L29-L37) hitting `POST /warehouses/docks/{dockId}/closures` as per `open-api.json`.
     - Handles backend scheduling conflicts (e.g. `409 Conflict` if an active booking overlaps) with inline alert banners.

4. **TypeScript Models & API Clients:**
   - [`booking.types.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/booking.types.ts): Added `Booking`, `BookingStatus`, `BookingDock`, `BookingCarrierOrg`, and status update request types.
   - [`warehouse.types.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts): Added `Warehouse`, `Dock`, `DockStatus`, `DockClosure`, and `CreateDockClosureRequest` types.
   - [`booking.api.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/booking.api.ts) & [`warehouse.api.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/warehouse.api.ts): Fully typed methods matching `open-api.json`.
   - [`App.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/App.tsx#L114-L123): Automatically renders `DockManagerDashboard` when `user.role === 'DOCK_MANAGER'`.

The issue has been resolved.

### Root Cause & Resolution

1. **Root Cause:**
   - The Prisma Client cached in `node_modules/.prisma/client` still held schema metadata referencing `dockManagerId` from an earlier generation, even though [`schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma#L112-L124) and the MySQL `dock_closures` table (`id`, `dockId`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `reason`, `createdAt`) did not have that column.
   - When [`prisma.dockClosure.create()`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L452-L462) was called, the engine attempted to map the stale `dockManagerId` column to MySQL.

2. **Resolution:**
   - Stopped running processes holding the query engine DLL and regenerated the clean Prisma client using `npx prisma generate` matching the actual database columns.
   - Verified [`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L452-L462) and [`warehouse.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L383-L430) create dock closures with only `{ dockId, startTime, endTime, reason }`.
   - Restarted the backend server.

### Verification Results

- **Backend Tests:** `npm test` in `backend/` passed **58/58 tests** across all 8 suites (including dock maintenance closures).
- **Frontend Build:** `npm run build` in `frontend/` succeeded with **0 errors**.

---

_**User (2026-10-14 15:01:01Z)**_

Implement strict validation rules for dock maintenance closures in DockSlot, ensuring that the closure reason is mandatory and that past times cannot be selected as the closure start time.

Please execute the following steps:

1. Backend Validation (`backend/` routes / controllers / services):
   - Update the dock closure creation endpoint (e.g., `POST wharehouse/docks/:dockId/closures`):
     - Mandatory Reason Validation Check that the `reason` field is provided and is a non-empty string. If missing or blank, return a `400 Bad Request` response.
     - Future Start Time Validation Compare the incoming `startTime` with the current server time (`new Date()`). If `startTime < new Date()`, reject the request with a `400 Bad Request` response specifying that closure start times cannot be in the past.

2. Frontend Validation (`frontend/` Dock Manager Dashboard component):
   - Update the "Schedule Dock Maintenance Closure" modal or form:
     - Required Reason Input: Ensure the reason input/textarea has the `required` attribute and displays appropriate validation feedback if left blank.
     - Prevent Past Times Selection: Set the `min` attribute on the `datetime-local` start time input dynamically using typescript/javascript (e.g., `min={new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16)}`) to block users from picking past dates/times in the browser UI.
     - Add a client-side validation check on form submission to verify that `startTime` is valid and not in the past before making the API call.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Backend validation now includes mandatory reason validation for dock closure creation. The controller in question explicitly checks if a reason is provided and is a non-empty string, returning a bad request status if the validation fails.
</details></think>

Strict validation rules for dock maintenance closures have been implemented across both the backend API and the frontend Dock Manager Dashboard.

---

### What Was Implemented

#### 1. Backend Validation
- **Mandatory Reason Validation:**
  - In [`warehouse.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L412-L418) and [`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L407-L409), validated that `reason` is provided and non-empty. Blank or omitted reasons are rejected with a `400 Bad Request` response:
    ```json
    {
      "success": false,
      "message": "Reason is required and cannot be blank."
    }
    ```
- **Future Start Time Validation:**
  - In both [`warehouse.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L428-L435) and [`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L418-L421), compared the incoming `startTime` against current server time (`new Date()`). If `startTime < new Date()`, the request is rejected with `400 Bad Request`:
    ```json
    {
      "success": false,
      "message": "Invalid startTime: Closure start time cannot be in the past."
    }
    ```
- **API Documentation & Typings:**
  - Updated JSDoc OpenAPI annotations in [`warehouse.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts#L138-L141) and root [`open-api.json`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/open-api.json#L149) marking `reason` as a required field.
  - Updated [`CreateDockClosureInput`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L38-L42) and [`CreateDockClosureRequest`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts#L54-L58) to enforce `reason: string`.

#### 2. Frontend Validation ([`DockManagerDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DockManagerDashboard.tsx))
- **Required Reason Input:**
  - Added the `required` attribute to the reason input field along with a required label indicator and red border/inline validation feedback when left blank.
- **Prevent Past Times in the Browser:**
  - Dynamically computes local ISO strings (`getMinDateTime()`) and applies `min={getMinDateTime()}` to the `datetime-local` start time input, preventing users from selecting past dates or times in the browser's native picker.
  - Sets `min={closureStartTime || getMinDateTime()}` on the end time picker so end time cannot precede start time.
- **Client-Side Pre-Flight Check:**
  - In `handleSubmitClosure`, verifies before dispatching the HTTP request that:
    1. `reason.trim()` is not empty.
    2. `new Date(closureStartTime) >= new Date()`.
    3. `new Date(closureEndTime) > new Date(closureStartTime)`.

---

- **Backend Test Suite:** `npm test` in `backend/` passed **58/58 tests** across all 8 test suites.
- **Frontend Build:** `npm run build` in `frontend/` succeeded with **0 errors**.

```typescript
  localEndTime?: string;
}

  const [isSubmittingBooking, setIsSubmittingBooking] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [actionLoadingId, setActionLoadingId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Global Feedback Banners
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successBanner, setSuccessBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Slot Search & Filter Form State
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const getTodayDateString = (): string => {
    const local = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
    return local.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  };

  const [selectedWarehouseId, setSelectedWarehouseId] = useState<string>('');
  const [targetDate, setTargetDate] = useState<string>(getTodayDateString());
  const [selectedDockId, setSelectedDockId] = useState<string>('ALL');

  // Available Slots State
  const [searchedSlots, setSearchedSlots] = useState<AvailableDockSlots[] | null>(null);

  // Booking Creation Modal State
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const [bookingFormData, setBookingFormData] = useState<{
    truckPlate: string;
    driverName: string;
    driverPhone: string;
    cargoNote: string;
  }>({
    truckPlate: '',
    driverName: '',
    driverPhone: '',
    cargoNote: '',
  });
  const [bookingModalError, setBookingModalError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Reschedule Modal State
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [isRescheduleModalOpen, setIsRescheduleModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [bookingToReschedule, setBookingToReschedule] = useState<Booking | null>(null);
  const [rescheduleDate, setRescheduleDate] = useState<string>(getTodayDateString());
  const [rescheduleSlots, setRescheduleSlots] = useState<AvailableDockSlots[] | null>(null);
  const [isLoadingRescheduleSlots, setIsLoadingRescheduleSlots] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [selectedRescheduleSlot, setSelectedRescheduleSlot] = useState<{
    dockId: number;
    dockName: string;
    slotStartTime: string;
    slotEndTime: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [rescheduleReason, setRescheduleReason] = useState<string>('');
  const [rescheduleError, setRescheduleError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmittingReschedule, setIsSubmittingReschedule] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Cancel Modal State
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [isCancelModalOpen, setIsCancelModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [bookingToCancel, setBookingToCancel] = useState<Booking | null>(null);
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState<string>('');
  const [cancelError, setCancelError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmittingCancel, setIsSubmittingCancel] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const [bookingSearchQuery, setBookingSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [bookingStatusFilter, setBookingStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Fetch Initial Data (Warehouses and Carrier Bookings)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const fetchBookings = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoadingBookings(true);
    try {
      const res = await bookingApi.getAll();
      setBookings(res?.data || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Failed to fetch carrier bookings.';
      setErrorMessage(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingBookings(false);

  }, []);

  const fetchInitialData = useCallback(async () => {

    try {
      const [warehousesRes, bookingsRes] = await Promise.all([
        warehouseApi.getAll(),
        bookingApi.getAll(),
      ]);

      const fetchedWarehouses = warehousesRes?.data || [];
      setWarehouses(fetchedWarehouses);
      if (fetchedWarehouses.length > 0) {
        setSelectedWarehouseId(String(fetchedWarehouses[0].id));
      }

      setBookings(bookingsRes?.data || []);

      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Failed to load initial data.';

      setIsLoadingInitial(false);

  const handleSearchSlots = async (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedWarehouseId) {
      setErrorMessage('Please select a target warehouse.');
      return;
    }
    if (!targetDate) {
      setErrorMessage('Please select a target date.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSearchingSlots(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setHasSearchedSlots(true);

    try {
      const warehouseIdNum = Number(selectedWarehouseId);
      const dockIdFilter = selectedDockId !== 'ALL' ? Number(selectedDockId) : undefined;

      const res = await warehouseApi.getAvailableSlots(warehouseIdNum, targetDate, dockIdFilter);
      const rawData = res.data;

      // Normalize response data: backend returns AvailableDockSlots[]:
      // [{ dockId, dockName, slots: [...] }]
      // or openapi flat list: [{ dockId, dockName, slotStartTime, slotEndTime }]
      let normalized: AvailableDockSlots[] = [];

      if (Array.isArray(rawData)) {
        if (rawData.length > 0 && 'slots' in rawData[0]) {
          normalized = (rawData as AvailableDockSlots[]).map((group) => ({
            ...group,
            slots: dockIdFilter
              ? group.dockId === dockIdFilter
                ? group.slots
                : []
              : group.slots,
          }));
        } else if (rawData.length > 0 && 'slotStartTime' in rawData[0]) {
          // Flat list format
          const flatList = rawData as unknown as AvailableSlot[];
          const grouped: Record<number, AvailableDockSlots> = {};
          flatList.forEach((slot) => {
            const dId = slot.dockId || 0;
            const dName = slot.dockName || `Dock #${dId}`;
            if (!grouped[dId]) {
              grouped[dId] = { dockId: dId, dockName: dName, slots: [] };
            }
            if (!dockIdFilter || dId === dockIdFilter) {
              grouped[dId].slots.push(slot);
            }
          });
          normalized = Object.values(grouped);
        } else {
          normalized = [];
        }
      }

      setSearchedSlots(normalized);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Failed to search available slots.';
      setErrorMessage(msg);
      setSearchedSlots([]);
    } finally {
      setIsSearchingSlots(false);
    }
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleOpenBookingModal = (dock: { id: number; name: string }, slot: AvailableSlot) => {

      dockId: dock.id,

    });
    setBookingFormData({

      setBookingModalError('Driver name is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (!driverPhone.trim()) {
      setBookingModalError('Driver phone number is required.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmittingBooking(true);

    try {
      const payload: CreateBookingRequest = {
        dockId: selectedSlotForBooking.dockId,
        slotStartTime: selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime,
        slotEndTime: selectedSlotForBooking.slotEndTime,
        truckPlate: truckPlate.trim(),
        driverName: driverName.trim(),
        driverPhone: driverPhone.trim(),
        cargoNote: cargoNote.trim() || undefined,
      };

      const res = await bookingApi.create(payload);
      const createdBooking = res.data;

      // Update bookings list
      setBookings((prev) => [createdBooking, ...prev]);

      // Remove the booked slot locally from searchedSlots for instant visual feedback
      setSearchedSlots((prev) => {
        if (!prev) return prev;
        return prev.map((dockGroup) => {
          if (dockGroup.dockId === selectedSlotForBooking.dockId) {
            return {
              ...dockGroup,
              slots: dockGroup.slots.filter(
                (s) => s.slotStartTime !== selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime
              ),
            };
          }
          return dockGroup;
        });
      });

      setIsBookingModalOpen(false);
      setSuccessBanner(
        `Booking #${createdBooking.id} created successfully for ${selectedSlotForBooking.dockName} (${truckPlate.trim()})!`
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Failed to create booking.';
      setBookingModalError(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingBooking(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenRescheduleModal = async (booking: Booking) => {

    setRescheduleError(null);
    setSelectedRescheduleSlot(null);

    // Default reschedule date: same date as current booking or today
    const bDate = booking.slotStartTime
      ? booking.slotStartTime.slice(0, 10)
      : getTodayDateString();
    setRescheduleDate(bDate);
    setIsRescheduleModalOpen(true);

    // Pre-fetch slots for this warehouse and date
    const warehouseId = booking.dock?.warehouseId;
    if (warehouseId) {
      await fetchRescheduleSlots(warehouseId, bDate);

        if (rawData.length > 0 && 'slots' in rawData[0]) {
          normalized = rawData as AvailableDockSlots[];

          const flatList = rawData as unknown as AvailableSlot[];

          flatList.forEach((slot) => {

            if (!grouped[dId]) {
              grouped[dId] = { dockId: dId, dockName: dName, slots: [] };

            grouped[dId].slots.push(slot);

          normalized = Object.values(grouped);

      setIsLoadingRescheduleSlots(false);

  };

  const handleRescheduleDateChange = async (newDate: string) => {

      setIsRescheduleModalOpen(false);

  const filteredBookings = useMemo(() => {

        const whName = (b.dock?.warehouse?.name || '').toLowerCase();

        return (

          driver.includes(query) ||

          dockName.includes(query) ||
```
