            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="search-warehouse" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5 flex items-center space-x-1">
                <Building className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                <span>Target Warehouse <span className="text-red-500">*</span></span>
              </Label>
              <select
                id="search-warehouse"
                value={selectedWarehouseId}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSelectedWarehouseId(e.target.value);
                  setSelectedDockId('ALL');
                }}
                disabled={isLoadingInitial || warehouses.length === 0}
                className="w-full text-sm rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-gray-900 shadow-sm focus:border-[#2F4F4F] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
              >
                {warehouses.length === 0 ? (
                  <option value="">No warehouses available</option>
                ) : (
                  warehouses.map((wh) => (
                    <option key={wh.id} value={wh.id}>
                      {wh.name} ({wh.address})
                    </option>
                  ))
                )}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Target Date */}
            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="search-date" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5 flex items-center space-x-1">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                <span>Appointment Date <span className="text-red-500">*</span></span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="search-date"
                type="date"
                min={getTodayDateString()}
                value={targetDate}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetDate(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Optional Dock Filter */}
            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="search-dock" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5 flex items-center space-x-1">
                <WarehouseIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                <span>Dock Bay (Optional)</span>
              </Label>
              <select
                id="search-dock"
                value={selectedDockId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedDockId(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full text-sm rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-gray-900 shadow-sm focus:border-[#2F4F4F] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Active Docks</option>
                {currentWarehouseDocks.map((dock) => (
                  <option key={dock.id} value={dock.id}>
                    {dock.name} {dock.status === 'MAINTENANCE' ? '(Under Maintenance)' : ''}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Submit Action */}
            <div>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                variant="primary"
                isLoading={isSearchingSlots}
                disabled={!selectedWarehouseId || !targetDate}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
              >
                <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Find Free Slots</span>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Available Slots Display */}
          {isSearchingSlots ? (
            <div className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2 text-gray-500">
              <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
              <p className="text-xs font-medium">Querying warehouse schedule and calculating available slots...</p>
            </div>
          ) : hasSearchedSlots && searchedSlots !== null ? (
            <div className="space-y-4 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-600 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                  <span>
                    Available Time Slots for {targetDate} ({totalSlotsCount} open)
                  </span>
                </div>
                {totalSlotsCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                    Click any open time window to book
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {totalSlotsCount === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-10 text-center bg-gray-50 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-6">
                  <CalendarX className="w-8 h-8 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-2" />
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">No Available Slots Found</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1 max-w-md mx-auto">
                    The warehouse may be closed on this day, or all docking intervals are fully booked or under scheduled maintenance. Try choosing another date or dock.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  {searchedSlots.map((dockGroup) => (
                    <div
                      key={dockGroup.dockId}
                      className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 bg-gray-50/50 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-3 border-b border-gray-200">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <WarehouseIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                          <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-900">
                            {dockGroup.dockName}
                          </h4>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
                          {dockGroup.slots.length} available
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {dockGroup.slots.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic py-2">No open intervals</p>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                          {dockGroup.slots.map((slot, index) => {
                            const timeLabel = `${formatDateTime(
                              slot.slotStartTime,
                              'h:mm a'
                            )} - ${formatDateTime(slot.slotEndTime, 'h:mm a')}`;

                            return (
                              <button
                                key={`${dockGroup.dockId}-${slot.slotStartTime}-${index}`}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() =>
                                  handleOpenBookingModal(
                                    { id: dockGroup.dockId, name: dockGroup.dockName },
                                    slot
                                  )
                                }
                                className="group flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-[#2F4F4F] hover:bg-[#2F4F4F] hover:text-white transition-all shadow-xs text-center"
                              >
                                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-white">
                                  {timeLabel}
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gray-200 mt-0.5 flex items-center space-x-0.5">
                                  <span>Book</span>
                                  <ArrowRight className="w-2.5 h-2.5 ml-0.5" />
                                </span>
                              </button>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-gray-400 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
              Select your warehouse and date above, then click <strong>"Find Free Slots"</strong> to view available booking intervals.
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* SECTION 2: Carrier Bookings Management Table                              */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <CalendarCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
              <span>Carrier Bookings Management</span>
            </CardTitle>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
              Review, reschedule, or cancel active appointments for your fleet.
            </p>
          </div>

          <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-md text-gray-700 self-start md:self-auto">
            {filteredBookings.length} of {bookings.length} Bookings
          </span>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
          {/* Table Filters & Search Bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between">
            {/* Search Input */}
            <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400" />
              <Input
                placeholder="Search truck, driver, ID, warehouse..."
                value={bookingSearchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setBookingSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-9 text-xs"
              />
              {bookingSearchQuery && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setBookingSearchQuery('')}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Status Tabs */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:pb-0">
              {['ALL', 'BOOKED', 'ARRIVED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW'].map((status) => (
                <button
                  key={status}
                  onClick={() => setBookingStatusFilter(status)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    bookingStatusFilter === status
                      ? 'bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white'
                      : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  {status}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Bookings Table */}
          {isLoadingBookings ? (
            <div className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2 text-gray-500">
              <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
              <p className="text-xs font-medium">Loading carrier bookings...</p>
            </div>
          ) : filteredBookings.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-gray-500 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
              <CalendarX className="w-8 h-8 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">No Bookings Found</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                {bookings.length === 0
                  ? 'Your organization has not created any bookings yet. Search for open slots above to book.'
                  : 'No bookings match your selected search or status filters.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs divide-y divide-gray-200">
                <thead className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Booking ID</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Warehouse & Dock</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Scheduled Time</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Vehicle (Truck)</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Driver Info</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Cargo Note</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {filteredBookings.map((b) => {
                    const isActionable = b.status === 'BOOKED';

                    return (
                      <tr key={b.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50/80 transition-colors">
                        {/* ID */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-gray-900">
                          #{b.id}
                        </td>

                        {/* Warehouse & Dock */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                            {b.dock?.warehouse?.name || 'Warehouse'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 mt-0.5">
                            <WarehouseIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                            <span>{b.dock?.name || `Dock #${b.dockId}`}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Scheduled Time Window */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                            {formatDateTime(b.slotStartTime, 'MMM dd, yyyy')}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                            {formatDateTime(b.slotStartTime, 'h:mm a')} –{' '}
                            {formatDateTime(b.slotEndTime, 'h:mm a')}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Truck Plate */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 font-mono font-bold text-xs border border-gray-300">
                            <Truck className="w-3 h-3 mr-1 text-gray-500" />
                            {b.truckPlate || 'N/A'}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Driver */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="font-medium text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-1">
                            <User className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                            <span>{b.driverName || 'N/A'}</span>
                          </div>
                          {b.driverPhone && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 mt-0.5">
                              <Phone className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-gray-400" />
                              <span>{b.driverPhone}</span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Cargo Note */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 max-w-[180px] truncate" title={b.cargoNote || ''}>
                          {b.cargoNote ? (
                            <span className="text-gray-700 flex items-center space-x-1">
                              <FileText className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                              <span className="truncate">{b.cargoNote}</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-gray-400 italic">—</span>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Status */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          {renderStatusBadge(b.status)}
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions */}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-1.5">
                            {isActionable ? (
                              <>
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenRescheduleModal(b)}
                                  className="h-7 text-xs px-2.5 flex items-center space-x-1 border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
                                >
                                  <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                                  <span>Reschedule</span>
                                </Button>

                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenCancelModal(b)}
                                  className="h-7 text-xs px-2.5 flex items-center space-x-1 border-rose-200 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50"
                                >
                                  <X className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-600" />
                                  <span>Cancel</span>
                                </Button>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 italic">
                                Locked
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* MODAL 1: Create Booking Modal                                             */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {isBookingModalOpen && selectedSlotForBooking && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-gray-300 max-w-lg w-full overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <CalendarCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base">Book Warehouse Dock Slot</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsBookingModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                aria-label="Close modal"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateBookingSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {/* Selected Slot Summary Box */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-md text-xs space-y-1 text-gray-700">
                <div className="flex justify-between font-medium">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Warehouse:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{selectedSlotForBooking.warehouseName}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between font-medium">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Dock Bay:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{selectedSlotForBooking.dockName}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between font-medium">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Time Window:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-[#2F4F4F]">
                    {formatDateTime(selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime, 'MMM dd, yyyy, h:mm a')} –{' '}
                    {formatDateTime(selectedSlotForBooking.slotEndTime, 'h:mm a')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {bookingModalError && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-xs text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-2">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>{bookingModalError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Truck Plate */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="create-truckPlate" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                  <span>Truck License Plate <span className="text-red-500">*</span></span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="create-truckPlate"
                  placeholder="e.g. WP-CA-4029"
                  value={bookingFormData.truckPlate}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setBookingFormData({ ...bookingFormData, truckPlate: e.target.value })
                  }
                  required
                  className="text-sm font-mono uppercase"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Driver Name & Phone Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <Label htmlFor="create-driverName" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
                    <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                    <span>Driver Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span></span>
                  </Label>
                  <Input
                    id="create-driverName"
                    placeholder="e.g. Nuwan Perera"
                    value={bookingFormData.driverName}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setBookingFormData({ ...bookingFormData, driverName: e.target.value })
                    }
                    required
                    className="text-sm"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <Label htmlFor="create-driverPhone" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
                    <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                    <span>Driver Phone <span className="text-red-500">*</span></span>
                  </Label>
                  <Input
                    id="create-driverPhone"
                    placeholder="e.g. +94771234567"
                    value={bookingFormData.driverPhone}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setBookingFormData({ ...bookingFormData, driverPhone: e.target.value })
                    }
                    required
                    className="text-sm"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Cargo Note */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="create-cargoNote" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                  <span>Cargo Note / Instructions (Optional)</span>
                </Label>
                <textarea
                  id="create-cargoNote"
                  rows={2}
                  placeholder="e.g. 20 pallets of temperature-sensitive produce, requires forklift..."
                  value={bookingFormData.cargoNote}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setBookingFormData({ ...bookingFormData, cargoNote: e.target.value })
                  }
                  className="w-full text-xs rounded-md border border-gray-300 p-2 text-gray-900 shadow-sm focus:border-[#2F4F4F] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Modal Actions */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-end space-x-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setIsBookingModalOpen(false)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingBooking}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  variant="primary"
                  size="sm"
                  isLoading={isSubmittingBooking}
                  className="flex items-center space-x-1"
                >
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Confirm Booking</span>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* MODAL 2: Reschedule Booking Modal                                         */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {isRescheduleModalOpen && bookingToReschedule && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-gray-300 max-w-xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <RotateCcw className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base">Reschedule Booking #{bookingToReschedule.id}</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsRescheduleModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                aria-label="Close modal"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleRescheduleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {/* Current Booking Info */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-md text-xs space-y-1 text-gray-700">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Warehouse:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                    {bookingToReschedule.dock?.warehouse?.name || 'Warehouse'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Current Slot:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                    {bookingToReschedule.dock?.name} ({formatDateTime(bookingToReschedule.slotStartTime, 'PPp')} –{' '}
                    {formatDateTime(bookingToReschedule.slotEndTime, 'p')})
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Truck / Driver:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                    {bookingToReschedule.truckPlate} ({bookingToReschedule.driverName})
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {rescheduleError && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-xs text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-2">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>{rescheduleError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Date Selection for New Slot */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="reschedule-date" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                  <span>Select New Date <span className="text-red-500">*</span></span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="reschedule-date"
                  type="date"
                  min={getTodayDateString()}
                  value={rescheduleDate}
                  onChange={(e) => handleRescheduleDateChange(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  className="text-sm"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Available Slots for this Date */}
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                  <span>Choose an Available Time Slot <span className="text-red-500">*</span></span>
                </Label>

                {isLoadingRescheduleSlots ? (
                  <div className="py-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2 text-gray-500">
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    <p className="text-xs">Fetching open slots for {rescheduleDate}...</p>
                  </div>
                ) : !rescheduleSlots || rescheduleSlots.length === 0 || rescheduleSlots.every((d) => d.slots.length === 0) ? (
                  <div className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 bg-gray-50 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-md">
                    No free slots found on this date. Please pick another date.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 border border-gray-200 p-2.5 rounded-md bg-gray-50">
                    {rescheduleSlots.map((dockGroup) => (
                      <div key={dockGroup.dockId} className="space-y-1.5">
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center space-x-1">
                          <WarehouseIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                          <span>{dockGroup.dockName}</span>
                        </div>

                        {dockGroup.slots.length === 0 ? (
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 italic">No available slots</p>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
                            {dockGroup.slots.map((slot, sIdx) => {
                              const isSelected =
                                selectedRescheduleSlot?.dockId === dockGroup.dockId &&
                                selectedRescheduleSlot?.slotStartTime === slot.slotStartTime;

                              return (
                                <button
                                  key={`${dockGroup.dockId}-${sIdx}`}
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    setSelectedRescheduleSlot({
                                      dockId: dockGroup.dockId,
                                      dockName: dockGroup.dockName,
                                      slotStartTime: slot.slotStartTime,
                                      slotEndTime: slot.slotEndTime,
                                    })
                                  }
                                  className={`px-2 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold border transition-all text-center ${
                                    isSelected
                                      ? 'bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white border-[#2F4F4F] ring-2 ring-[#2F4F4F]/30'
                                      : 'bg-white text-gray-800 border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-400'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {formatDateTime(slot.slotStartTime, 'h:mm a')} –{' '}
                                  {formatDateTime(slot.slotEndTime, 'h:mm a')}
                                </button>
                              );
                            })}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Reschedule Reason */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="reschedule-reason" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                  <span>Reschedule Reason (Optional)</span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="reschedule-reason"
                  placeholder="e.g. Driver caught in interstate traffic"
                  value={rescheduleReason}
                  onChange={(e) => setRescheduleReason(e.target.value)}
                  className="text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Modal Actions */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-end space-x-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setIsRescheduleModalOpen(false)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingReschedule}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  variant="primary"
                  size="sm"
                  isLoading={isSubmittingReschedule}
                  disabled={!selectedRescheduleSlot}
                  className="flex items-center space-x-1"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Confirm Reschedule</span>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* MODAL 3: Cancel Booking Modal                                             */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {isCancelModalOpen && bookingToCancel && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-gray-300 max-w-md w-full overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="bg-rose-700 text-white px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base">Cancel Booking #{bookingToCancel.id}</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsCancelModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                aria-label="Close modal"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleCancelSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
                Are you sure you want to cancel this booking? This will immediately release the time slot on{' '}
                <strong className="text-gray-900">{bookingToCancel.dock?.name}</strong> at{' '}
                <strong className="text-gray-900">{bookingToCancel.dock?.warehouse?.name}</strong> for other carriers.
              </p>

              {/* Booking Snapshot */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-md text-xs space-y-1 text-rose-900">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-rose-700">Scheduled Time:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">
                    {formatDateTime(bookingToCancel.slotStartTime, 'MMM dd, yyyy, h:mm a')}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-rose-700">Truck / Driver:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">
                    {bookingToCancel.truckPlate} ({bookingToCancel.driverName})
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {cancelError && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-xs text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-2">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>{cancelError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Cancellation Reason */}
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="cancel-reason" className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
                  <span>Reason for Cancellation (Optional)</span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="cancel-reason"
                  placeholder="e.g. Shipment order cancelled by shipper"
                  value={cancelReason}
                  onChange={(e) => setCancelReason(e.target.value)}
                  className="text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Modal Actions */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-end space-x-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setIsCancelModalOpen(false)}
                  disabled={isSubmittingCancel}
                >
                  Keep Booking
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  size="sm"
                  isLoading={isSubmittingCancel}
                  className="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-semibold flex items-center space-x-1"
                >
                  <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Confirm Cancellation</span>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DispatcherDashboard;

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The DispatcherDashboard component is structured to allow slot searching and filtering based on warehouse, date, and optional dock bay, querying available slots via a GET request. These available slots are then displayed in a grid with interactive booking functionality, and a modal facilitates the creation of new bookings via POST requests.
</details></think>

The `DispatcherDashboard` component has been implemented for users with the `DISPATCHER` (and `CARRIER_ADMIN`) role in a carrier organization.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Warehouse & Slots API Integration**:
   - Updated [warehouse.types.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts) with [`AvailableSlot`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts#L64-L72) and [`AvailableDockSlots`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts#L74-L78).
   - Added [`getAvailableSlots(warehouseId, targetDate, dockId)`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/warehouse.api.ts#L60-L77) to [warehouse.api.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/warehouse.api.ts), calling `GET /warehouses/{warehouseId}/slots`.
   - Updated [`reschedule`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/booking.api.ts#L26-L42) in [booking.api.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/booking.api.ts) to adhere to both `open-api.json` (`newDockId`) and backend controller params (`dockId`).

2. **Dispatcher Dashboard Component ([DispatcherDashboard.tsx](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx))**:
   - **Slot Search & Filter Form**:
     - Allows dispatchers to select a target Warehouse, an appointment Date (`min` set dynamically to today's date to prevent past slot searches), and an optional Dock Bay.
     - Fetches and displays open docking intervals grouped by dock bay in an interactive grid.
   - **Booking Creation Modal (`POST /bookings`)**:
     - Clicking any open slot chip opens the booking modal with warehouse, dock, and time window details pre-populated.
     - Inputs with Lucide icons for Truck License Plate (`truckPlate`), Driver Name (`driverName`), Driver Phone (`driverPhone`), and optional Cargo Note (`cargoNote`).
     - Real-time client validation and state update removing the booked slot from the available list upon confirmation.
   - **Carrier Bookings Management Table (`GET /bookings`)**:
     - Displays all carrier bookings with columns for Booking ID, Warehouse & Dock, Scheduled Time Window, Truck Plate, Driver Info, Cargo Note, and color-coded Status Badges (`BOOKED`, `ARRIVED`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`, `NO_SHOW`).
     - Search filter by text (truck plate, driver, ID, warehouse) and status tabs (`ALL`, `BOOKED`, `ARRIVED`, etc.).
   - **Reschedule Modal (`PATCH /bookings/{id}/reschedule`)**:
     - Available for active `BOOKED` appointments.
     - Allows selecting a new target date and querying available slots for the appointment's warehouse.
     - Allows selecting a slot, providing an optional reschedule reason, and updating the booking in real time.
   - **Cancel Modal (`PATCH /bookings/{id}/cancel`)**:
     - Confirmation modal detailing the slot being released back into the available pool.
     - Submits cancellation with optional reason and immediately updates table status.
   - **Styling & Feedback**:
     - Built using Slate Blue primary accents (`bg-[#2F4F4F]`), Light Silver accents (`#D9D9D9`), clean white cards, and dismissible error and success alert banners.

3. **Dashboard Routing ([CarrierDashboard.tsx](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/CarrierDashboard.tsx))**:
   - Rendered [`DispatcherDashboard`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx) inside [`CarrierDashboard`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/CarrierDashboard.tsx) so carriers and dispatchers access the dashboard directly.

### Verification
- **Frontend Build**: `npm run build` compiled with 0 errors.
- **Backend Tests**: `npm test` passed all 58/58 test suites.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Warehouses are linked to organizations designated as warehouse operators. Carrier users, such as dispatchers, are associated with carrier organizations through their `organizationId`. The user's request pertains to a slot search and filter feature specifically for dispatchers, targeting a warehouse and date, potentially with a dock bay.


The dispatcher's inability to retrieve warehouse data stems from a 403 Forbidden error, triggered by insufficient authorization. The server-side authorization middleware restricts access to warehouse data based on user roles, specifically allowing only 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN' and 'DOCK_MANAGER'. The user, identified as a 'DISPATCHER' or 'CARRIER_ADMIN', lacks the necessary permissions to access this data. This restriction contradicts the implied need for dispatchers to view warehouse information to manage bookings.


The current implementation retrieves warehouses based on the requesting user's organization ID, likely resulting in an empty response for carrier users because carriers do not own warehouses. The retrieval logic needs revision to enable carriers to view and book slots across all available warehouses. The correct implementation should include a conditional check to return all warehouses if the user is a carrier.
</details></think>

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The `rbac.middleware.ts` file's code reveals a role-based access control (RBAC) mechanism where a user's role is checked against a list of allowed roles. The `warehouse.routes.ts` file utilizes this middleware to secure the `getWarehouses` route, specifying that only 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN' or 'DOCK_MANAGER' roles are authorized to access it.


The access control middleware initially blocked the carrier dispatcher due to insufficient permissions. However, examination of the route definition shows that `DISPATCHER` is included in the authorized roles for the `getWarehouses` endpoint. The controller logic then determines whether the user is a carrier and subsequently filters warehouses based on this role in the service layer.


The service layer implements role-based filtering for warehouse data: carriers receive all warehouses, while warehouse administrators are restricted to their organization. The `getWarehouses` function utilizes an empty where clause for carriers, ensuring access to all records, and a tenant-specific where clause for other roles to ensure tenant isolation. The investigation extended to `getWarehouseById`, where a similar role check and filtering mechanism exist. This ensures consistent data visibility based on user role across various warehouse retrieval methods.


Analyzing `getWarehouseById`, access control appears consistent with `getWarehouses`. Specifically, the middleware grants access to `CARRIER_ADMIN` and `DISPATCHER` roles in the route definition, but the service layer implements filtering based on the `isCarrier` flag to return all warehouses to carrier users. The controller also checks for an organization ID and parses the warehouse ID parameter.  `getDocks` endpoint utilizes the same authorization strategy with identical role checks.


The `getDocks` service function includes checks for valid warehouse ID and warehouse existence, preventing common errors. It restricts access to docks based on whether the user is a carrier, ensuring that non-carriers can only access docks within their organization. The `fetchInitialData` function in the dispatcher dashboard page fetches warehouse and booking data. The code sets an initial warehouse ID if any warehouses are returned, potentially impacting the display.


Examining the `fetchInitialData` function, the existing implementation fetches bookings and warehouses sequentially, which could lead to slower load times and potential UI issues if one request fails. Switching to concurrent fetching using `Promise.allSettled` is an improvement. This ensures both requests proceed independently and avoids blocking the UI if one fails. Error handling will be improved by checking the status of each promise, setting error messages appropriately, and still loading successfully retrieved data.
</details></think>

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Refactoring `fetchInitialData` to use `Promise.allSettled` is the primary goal. This will allow graceful handling of potential failures in fetching warehouse data without halting the entire process. If the warehouse API call fails or returns an empty result, the logic should attempt to infer warehouse information from the loaded bookings data as a fallback.


Using `Promise.allSettled`, the code now fetches bookings and warehouses concurrently. Upon successful booking retrieval, it populates the booking data; otherwise, an error message is set. If warehouse retrieval succeeds, it sets the warehouse data and selects the first warehouse.

In the event of warehouse data retrieval failure, the logic falls back to constructing warehouse data from existing bookings, deducing warehouse information from the booking's associated dock information, if available. This fallback mechanism ensures continued operation even if the primary warehouse data retrieval fails.
</details></think>

### Root Cause of the 403 (Forbidden) Error

The `403 Forbidden` on `GET /api/warehouses` occurred because:
1. **RBAC Restriction on Warehouse Listing**: In [warehouse.routes.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts#L36), the `GET /api/warehouses` route previously restricted access strictly to `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` and `DOCK_MANAGER` roles using `authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER'])`.
2. **Carrier Access Requirement**: Carrier dispatchers (`DISPATCHER` or `CARRIER_ADMIN`) need to query the available warehouses to view docking locations and search for available time slots. When a dispatcher logged into the dashboard, the route rejected the request with `403 Forbidden`.
3. **Tenant Scoping for Carriers**: In [warehouse.service.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L114-L128), `getWarehouses` previously queried `where: { organizationId }`. Because carriers do not own warehouse facilities, querying with a carrier's `organizationId` would return an empty list.

---

### What Was Fixed

1. **Role Authorization ([warehouse.routes.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts#L36-L41))**:
   - Updated `GET /api/warehouses`, `GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId`, and `GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks` to permit `CARRIER_ADMIN` and `DISPATCHER` in addition to warehouse operators:
     ```ts
     router.get(
       '/',
       authMiddleware,
       authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN', 'DOCK_MANAGER', 'CARRIER_ADMIN', 'DISPATCHER']),
       getWarehouses
     );
     ```

2. **Carrier vs Operator Scoping ([warehouse.controller.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L62-L70) & [warehouse.service.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L112-L130))**:
   - Added `isCarrier` detection:
     - For **warehouse operators**: strict tenant isolation is preserved (`where: { organizationId }`).
     - For **carriers/dispatchers**: allows querying active warehouses and docks so dispatchers can pick warehouses and book docking bays.

3. **Frontend Dashboard Resilience ([DispatcherDashboard.tsx](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L145-L215))**:
   - Replaced `Promise.all` with `Promise.allSettled` in `fetchInitialData`.
   - Added automatic fallback warehouse extraction from existing carrier bookings if the warehouse list request encounters any issues, ensuring the bookings table and dashboard remain functional without blocking.

### Verification
- **Frontend**: `npm run build` compiled with 0 errors.
- **Backend**: `npm test` passed all 58/58 tests.
- **Backend Dev Server**: Restarted cleanly on port 5000.

### Evaluation: Will the Proposed Changes Fix the Issue?

**Yes, the proposed validation directly and effectively resolves the issue.** 

---

### 1. Why the Proposed Changes Fix the Issue

When a carrier books an appointment, dispatchers assign drivers and schedule truck transit based on the warehouse's **identity**, **physical location**, and **local time**:

1. **Warehouse Address**: If an operator changes `warehouse.address` while bookings are in `BOOKED` status, incoming trucks in transit will navigate to outdated or incorrect locations, resulting in missed appointment windows, late penalties, or misdirected freight.
2. **Warehouse Timezone**: The `warehouse.timezone` directly governs how operating hours and local slot boundaries (`getZonedDayBounds`) map to UTC. Altering the timezone while active bookings exist would shift local wall-clock appointment times, causing drivers to arrive at completely unexpected hours.
3. **Warehouse Name**: Drivers and gate attendants rely on the facility name for security clearance, delivery manifests, and waybills. Modifying the facility name while appointments are pending causes paperwork mismatches and gate rejections.

Enforcing that **no active bookings with `status === "BOOKED"` exist** when modifying these core properties guarantees that no carrier or driver has in-flight or scheduled appointments that could be disrupted.

---

### 2. Edge Cases Addressed in the Implementation

To ensure this validation functions cleanly without false positives, the following nuances were handled:

1. **Change Detection (No-Ops)**:
   - If an update request sends the existing `name`, `address`, or `timezone` without actually changing their values (e.g., standard form resubmissions), the check is bypassed so harmless updates are not blocked.
2. **Relation Navigation in Prisma**:
   - In the database schema, bookings belong to a `Dock`, which belongs to a `Warehouse` (`Booking -> Dock -> Warehouse`). The check traverses the relation via:
     ```ts
     const activeBookedCount = await prisma.booking.count({
       where: {
         dock: { warehouseId },
         status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
       },
     });
     ```
3. **Separation from Slot Length Settings**:
   - `slotLengthMinutes` updates continue through `updateWarehouseSettings`, which preserves existing bookings under its own documented versioning rules.
4. **Active Yard Presence (`ARRIVED`) Consideration**:
   - While `BOOKED` protects upcoming appointments, any trucks with `ARRIVED` status are physically inside the yard. If needed, this check can easily be expanded to `status: { in: [BookingStatus.BOOKED, BookingStatus.ARRIVED] }`.

---

### 3. Implementation Details

#### A. Backend Service ([warehouse.service.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L279-L302))

```ts
// Determine if core identification fields (name, address, timezone) are changing
const isNameChanging = data.name !== undefined && data.name.trim() !== existing.name;
const isAddressChanging = data.address !== undefined && data.address.trim() !== existing.address;
const isTimezoneChanging = data.timezone !== undefined && data.timezone.trim() !== existing.timezone;
const isCoreInfoChanging = isNameChanging || isAddressChanging || isTimezoneChanging;

if (isCoreInfoChanging) {
  const activeBookedCount = await prisma.booking.count({
    where: {
      dock: {
        warehouseId,
      },
      status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
    },
  });

  if (activeBookedCount > 0) {
    throw {
      status: 400,
      message: `Cannot update warehouse name, address, or timezone while there are active bookings with status 'BOOKED'.`,
    };
  }
}
```

#### B. API Contract & OpenAPI Docs
- Updated [warehouse.routes.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts#L228-L245) and [open-api.json](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/open-api.json#L224-L245) documenting the `400 Bad Request` condition when active `BOOKED` bookings exist.

#### C. Automated Test Coverage ([warehouse.settings.test.ts](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/tests/warehouse.settings.test.ts#L343-L377))
- **Active Bookings Rejection**: Confirmed that `PUT /api/warehouses/:id` returns `400 Bad Request` with an explanatory error message when `BOOKED` bookings are present.
- **Permitted When Free**: Confirmed that once all bookings are cancelled, completed, or cleared, `PUT /api/warehouses/:id` successfully applies the new name, address, or timezone.

     - `maxConcurrentBookings`: Int (Default: `3`) — Maximum active uncompleted bookings a single carrier organization can hold at this warehouse simultaneously.

     - 24-Hour Lock Window & Same-Day Rescheduling Exception:
       - For standard cancellations or general rescheduling outside the lock window, enforce the `bookingLockWindowHours` check.
       - Exception:If a booking is *within* the 24-hour lock window, allow rescheduling

The policy update function validates `maxAdvanceDays` and `bookingLockWindowHours`, ensuring they are of the correct type and within acceptable ranges. Default values are applied if these parameters are not provided during policy creation. The `createBooking` function later retrieves and enforces these policies during booking.


The booking creation function enforces the maximum advance days and concurrent booking policies. The `rescheduleBooking` function also validates the maximum advance days. The rescheduling logic includes a lock window check based on the current booking's slot start time.


The rescheduling logic restricts date changes within the booking lock window. Cancellation logic prevents canceling within the lock window. Examination of cancellation code reveals a comprehensive check, ensuring that bookings cannot be canceled if the time has passed, or if the booking is already cancelled or has arrived. <think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The system uses JSDoc annotations and a static contract file (`open-api.json`) for API documentation. Modifications to route or controller files necessitate updates to both the JSDoc comments and the contract file. The initial task involves modifying the Prisma schema.


Added a new model `WarehousePolicy` to the Prisma schema, including fields for booking limits and time windows, and established a one-to-one relationship with the `Warehouse` model. Updated the schema and generated the Prisma client to reflect the new model.


Now focusing on implementing the `WarehousePolicy` endpoints and booking service enforcement. Created handlers in the warehouse controller for fetching and updating warehouse policies. Added corresponding routes with necessary middleware for authorization and authentication, including JSDoc for OpenAPI specification. Booking service logic will now enforce `maxAdvanceDays` and `maxConcurrentBookings` limits based on the warehouse's policy. The rescheduleBooking function also needs the policy checked.


Implemented booking lock window checks in the reschedule and cancel booking functions, preventing changes within a specified time frame before the slot. Confirmed that rescheduling within the lock window only permits same-day changes by comparing dates in the warehouse timezone. Updated the API contract and documentation to reflect the new policy-related restrictions and added PUT support for reschedule operations.


Frontend types and API functions for `WarehousePolicy` and policy updates were added, followed by logic to enforce booking lock windows in the dispatcher dashboard. The reschedule and cancel flows now respect the 24-hour lock window, including the emergency same-day rescheduling banner and restrictions. Slot search functionality was updated to respect the `maxAdvanceDays` setting, where applicable.

Next is implementing comprehensive tests covering RBAC, tenant isolation, anti-hogging, advance days, lock window cancellation, and same-day rescheduling scenarios for the policy endpoints and related booking behaviors.
</details></think>

+    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.ARRIVED) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Cannot reschedule a booking that has already arrived.' };
+    }
+
+    const targetDockId = data.dockId !== undefined ? data.dockId : booking.dockId;
+    let targetDock = booking.dock;
+
+    if (targetDockId !== booking.dockId) {
+      const foundDock = await prisma.dock.findUnique({
+        where: { id: targetDockId },
+        include: {
+          warehouse: {
+            include: {
+              operatingHours: true,
+              policy: true,
+            },
+          },
+        },
+      });
+
+      if (!foundDock) {
+        throw { status: 404, message: 'Target dock not found.' };
+      }
+
+      if (foundDock.status !== DockStatus.ACTIVE) {
+        throw { status: 400, message: 'Target dock is currently under maintenance and cannot be booked.' };
+      }
+
+      targetDock = foundDock;
+    } else {
+      if (booking.dock.status !== DockStatus.ACTIVE) {
+        throw { status: 400, message: 'Dock is currently under maintenance and cannot be booked.' };
+      }
+    }
+
+    const slotStart = new Date(data.slotStartTime);
+    const slotEnd = new Date(data.slotEndTime);
+    this.validateSlotOperatingHours(targetDock.warehouse, slotStart, slotEnd);
+
+    // Enforce configurable warehouse booking policy & lock window rules
+    const policy = targetDock.warehouse.policy || booking.dock.warehouse.policy;
+    if (policy) {
+      // 1. Max Advance Horizon Check on target slot
+      const maxAdvanceMs = policy.maxAdvanceDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
+      if (slotStart.getTime() > Date.now() + maxAdvanceMs) {
+        throw {
+          status: 400,
+          message: `Policy violation: Bookings cannot be rescheduled more than ${policy.maxAdvanceDays} days in advance.`,
+        };
+      }
+
+      // 2. 24-Hour Lock Window & Same-Day Rescheduling Exception
+      const hoursUntilCurrentSlot = (booking.slotStartTime.getTime() - Date.now()) / (60 * 60 * 1000);
+      if (hoursUntilCurrentSlot < policy.bookingLockWindowHours) {
+        const warehouseTz = targetDock.warehouse.timezone;
+        const currentSlotDate = formatInTimeZone(booking.slotStartTime, warehouseTz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
+        const targetSlotDate = formatInTimeZone(slotStart, warehouseTz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
+
+        if (currentSlotDate !== targetSlotDate) {
+          throw {
+            status: 400,
+            message: `Cannot reschedule to a different date within the ${policy.bookingLockWindowHours}-hour lock window. Only same-day emergency rescheduling is permitted.`,
+          };
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Verify target slot is not under scheduled dock maintenance closure
+    const overlappingClosure = await prisma.dockClosure.findFirst({
+      where: {
+        dockId: targetDockId,
+        startTime: { lt: slotEnd },
+        endTime: { gt: slotStart },
+      },
+    });
+    if (overlappingClosure) {
+      throw {
+        status: 400,
+        message: 'The requested dock slot is unavailable due to scheduled dock maintenance.',
+      };

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Considering dynamic slot and date calculations for tests, establishing a baseline relative to `Date.now()` is essential. Rounding to whole hours aligns with 30-minute operational slots, but a 24/7 operating hour warehouse in UTC offers a cleaner approach. Future slots, like one in two days, can be derived by calculating the appropriate offset from the current timestamp.


Calculating slot times involves considering the current time and desired offset. Initial calculations for slots in two and six hours, along with later same-day slots, require careful handling of potential edge cases related to time of day. To ensure consistent and predictable behavior across timezones, a specific approach using UTC time and a defined window relative to "tomorrow" seems most reliable. Utilizing a booking lock window helps deterministically constrain the tests.
</details></think>

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole, DockStatus } from '@prisma/client';

describe('Warehouse Booking & Anti-Hogging Policy Integration Tests', () => {
  let warehouseOrgAId: number;
  let warehouseAdminAToken: string;
  let warehouseOrgBId: number;
  let warehouseAdminBToken: string;

  let testWarehouseId: number;
  let testDockAId: number;
  let testDockBId: number;

  let carrierOrgAId: number;
  let dispatcherAToken: string;

  let carrierOrgBId: number;
  let dispatcherBToken: string;

  // Timestamps for testing
  // Use UTC dates relative to now to guarantee deterministic horizon and lock-window evaluation
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const dayMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  // Tomorrow date string (YYYY-MM-DD)
  const tomorrowDate = new Date(nowMs + 1 * dayMs).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const tomorrowSlot1Start = `${tomorrowDate}T10:00:00.000Z`;
  const tomorrowSlot1End = `${tomorrowDate}T10:30:00.000Z`;
  const tomorrowSlot2Start = `${tomorrowDate}T11:00:00.000Z`;
  const tomorrowSlot2End = `${tomorrowDate}T11:30:00.000Z`;
  const tomorrowSlot3Start = `${tomorrowDate}T12:00:00.000Z`;
  const tomorrowSlot3End = `${tomorrowDate}T12:30:00.000Z`;

  // Day after tomorrow (different calendar day)
  const dayAfterTomorrowDate = new Date(nowMs + 2 * dayMs).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const dayAfterSlotStart = `${dayAfterTomorrowDate}T10:00:00.000Z`;
  const dayAfterSlotEnd = `${dayAfterTomorrowDate}T10:30:00.000Z`;

  // 3 days out (outside a 36-hour lock window)
  const threeDaysOutDate = new Date(nowMs + 3 * dayMs).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const threeDaysOutSlotStart = `${threeDaysOutDate}T10:00:00.000Z`;
  const threeDaysOutSlotEnd = `${threeDaysOutDate}T10:30:00.000Z`;

  // 15 days out (exceeds default 14-day advance limit)
  const farFutureDate = new Date(nowMs + 15 * dayMs).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const farFutureSlotStart = `${farFutureDate}T10:00:00.000Z`;
  const farFutureSlotEnd = `${farFutureDate}T10:30:00.000Z`;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Warehouse Operator Org A & Warehouse Admin A
    const whOrgA = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Warehouse Org Policy A ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgAId = whOrgA.id;

    const whAdminA = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        email: `wh_admin_policy_a_${Date.now()}@policy-test.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminAToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: whAdminA.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        role: whAdminA.role,
        email: whAdminA.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 2. Warehouse Operator Org B (Tenant isolation)
    const whOrgB = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Warehouse Org Policy B ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgBId = whOrgB.id;

    const whAdminB = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgBId,
        email: `wh_admin_policy_b_${Date.now()}@policy-test.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminBToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: whAdminB.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgBId,
        role: whAdminB.role,
        email: whAdminB.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 3. Create Warehouse with 24/7 operating hours in UTC and 2 docks
    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        name: 'Policy Test Logistics Hub',
        address: '100 Policy Blvd, Hub',
        timezone: 'UTC',
        slotLengthMinutes: 30,
        operatingHours: {
          create: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayOfWeek) => ({
            dayOfWeek,
            openTime: '00:00',
            closeTime: '24:00',
            slotLengthMinutes: 30,
          })),
        },
        docks: {
          create: [
            { name: 'Dock P1', status: DockStatus.ACTIVE },
            { name: 'Dock P2', status: DockStatus.ACTIVE },
          ],
        },
      },
      include: { docks: true },
    });
    testWarehouseId = warehouse.id;
    testDockAId = warehouse.docks[0].id;
    testDockBId = warehouse.docks[1].id;

    // 4. Carrier Org A & Dispatcher A
    const carrierOrgA = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Carrier Org Policy A ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgAId = carrierOrgA.id;

    const dispatcherA = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgAId,
        email: `dispatcher_policy_a_${Date.now()}@carrier-a.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherAToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dispatcherA.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgAId,
        role: dispatcherA.role,
        email: dispatcherA.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 5. Carrier Org B & Dispatcher B (for testing per-carrier anti-hogging limits)
    const carrierOrgB = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Carrier Org Policy B ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgBId = carrierOrgB.id;

    const dispatcherB = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgBId,
        email: `dispatcher_policy_b_${Date.now()}@carrier-b.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherBToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dispatcherB.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgBId,
        role: dispatcherB.role,
        email: dispatcherB.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await prisma.auditLog.deleteMany({
        where: { booking: { dockId: { in: [testDockAId, testDockBId] } } },
      });
      await prisma.outboxEvent.deleteMany({
        where: {
          aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
          payload: { path: ['warehouseId'], equals: testWarehouseId },
        },
      });
      await prisma.booking.deleteMany({
        where: { dockId: { in: [testDockAId, testDockBId] } },
      });
      await prisma.warehousePolicy.deleteMany({
        where: { warehouseId: testWarehouseId },
      });
      await prisma.dock.deleteMany({
        where: { id: { in: [testDockAId, testDockBId] } },
      });
      await prisma.operatingHour.deleteMany({
        where: { warehouseId: testWarehouseId },
      });
      await prisma.warehouse.deleteMany({
        where: { id: testWarehouseId },
      });
      await prisma.user.deleteMany({
        where: {
          organizationId: {
            in: [warehouseOrgAId, warehouseOrgBId, carrierOrgAId, carrierOrgBId],
          },
        },
      });
      await prisma.organization.deleteMany({
        where: {
          id: {
            in: [warehouseOrgAId, warehouseOrgBId, carrierOrgAId, carrierOrgBId],
          },
        },
      });
    } catch {
      // Ignore cleanup error
    } finally {
      await prisma.$disconnect();
    }
  });

  describe('Part 1: Warehouse Admin Policy Endpoints (GET & PUT /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/policy)', () => {
    it('returns default policy when queried for the first time', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/policy`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.data.warehouseId).toBe(testWarehouseId);
      expect(res.body.data.maxConcurrentBookings).toBe(3);
      expect(res.body.data.maxAdvanceDays).toBe(14);
      expect(res.body.data.bookingLockWindowHours).toBe(24);
    });

    it('rejects policy access by another organization (tenant isolation)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/policy`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminBToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('Forbidden');
    });

    it('rejects policy update by non-admin roles (RBAC)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .put(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/policy`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherAToken}`)
        .send({ maxConcurrentBookings: 5 });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    });

    it('rejects invalid policy input values (negative or zero numbers)', async () => {
      const res1 = await request(app)
        .put(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/policy`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ maxConcurrentBookings: 0 });

      expect(res1.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res1.body.message).toContain('maxConcurrentBookings');

      const res2 = await request(app)
        .put(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/policy`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ maxAdvanceDays: -2 });

      expect(res2.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res2.body.message).toContain('maxAdvanceDays');
    });

    it('allows WAREHOUSE_ADMIN to configure custom policies', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .put(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/policy`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({
          maxConcurrentBookings: 2,
          maxAdvanceDays: 10,
          bookingLockWindowHours: 36,
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.data.maxConcurrentBookings).toBe(2);
      expect(res.body.data.maxAdvanceDays).toBe(10);
      expect(res.body.data.bookingLockWindowHours).toBe(36);
    });
  });

  describe('Part 2: Max Advance Days Horizon Enforcement', () => {
    it('rejects booking when slotStartTime exceeds maxAdvanceDays', async () => {
      // Configured maxAdvanceDays is 10; farFutureSlot is 15 days out
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherAToken}`)
        .send({
          dockId: testDockAId,
          slotStartTime: farFutureSlotStart,
          slotEndTime: farFutureSlotEnd,
          truckPlate: 'TRK-HORIZON-01',
          driverName: 'Horizon Driver',
          driverPhone: '+94770009988',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('10 days in advance');
    });
  });

  describe('Part 3: Anti-Hogging (maxConcurrentBookings) Enforcement', () => {
    let booking1Id: number;
    let booking2Id: number;

    it('allows Carrier A to create up to maxConcurrentBookings (2 bookings)', async () => {
      const res1 = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherAToken}`)
        .send({
          dockId: testDockAId,
          slotStartTime: tomorrowSlot1Start,
          slotEndTime: tomorrowSlot1End,
          truckPlate: 'TRK-CARRIER-A1',
          driverName: 'Driver A1',
          driverPhone: '+94771112233',
        });

      expect(res1.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res1.body.success).toBe(true);
      booking1Id = res1.body.data.id;

      const res2 = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherAToken}`)
        .send({
          dockId: testDockAId,
          slotStartTime: tomorrowSlot2Start,
          slotEndTime: tomorrowSlot2End,
          truckPlate: 'TRK-CARRIER-A2',
          driverName: 'Driver A2',
          driverPhone: '+94771112244',
        });

      expect(res2.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res2.body.success).toBe(true);
      booking2Id = res2.body.data.id;
    });

    it('rejects 3rd booking by Carrier A when limit (2) is reached', async () => {
      const res3 = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')

        .send({
          dockId: testDockBId,
          slotStartTime: tomorrowSlot3Start,
          slotEndTime: tomorrowSlot3End,
