```typescript
          driverPhone: '+94771112255',
        });

      expect(res3.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res3.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res3.body.message).toContain('maximum allowed concurrent active bookings (2)');
    });

    it('allows Carrier B to book even when Carrier A has reached their limit', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
        .send({
          dockId: testDockBId,
          slotStartTime: tomorrowSlot3Start,
          slotEndTime: tomorrowSlot3End,
          truckPlate: 'TRK-CARRIER-B1',
          driverName: 'Driver B1',
          driverPhone: '+94772223344',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('Part 4: Hard Lock Window Cancellation & Emergency Same-Day Rescheduling', () => {
    let lockWindowBookingId: number;
    let outsideLockBookingId: number;

    beforeAll(async () => {
      // Temporarily expand policy maxConcurrentBookings so we can create these test bookings
      await prisma.warehousePolicy.update({
        where: { warehouseId: testWarehouseId },
        data: {
          maxConcurrentBookings: 10,
          bookingLockWindowHours: 36, // 36 hours lock window
        },
      });

      // 1. Create booking inside the lock window (~24h from now < 36h)
      const resInside = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
        .send({
          dockId: testDockBId,
          slotStartTime: tomorrowSlot1Start,
          slotEndTime: tomorrowSlot1End,
          truckPlate: 'TRK-LOCK-TEST',
          driverName: 'Lock Driver',
          driverPhone: '+94779998877',
        });
      expect(resInside.status).toBe(201);
      lockWindowBookingId = resInside.body.data.id;

      // 2. Create booking outside the lock window (~72h from now > 36h)
      const resOutside = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
        .send({
          dockId: testDockBId,
          slotStartTime: threeDaysOutSlotStart,
          slotEndTime: threeDaysOutSlotEnd,
          truckPlate: 'TRK-OUTSIDE-LOCK',
          driverName: 'Outside Driver',
          driverPhone: '+94779998866',
        });
      expect(resOutside.status).toBe(201);
      outsideLockBookingId = resOutside.body.data.id;
    });

    it('rejects cancellation when booking is within the 36-hour lock window', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/bookings/${lockWindowBookingId}/cancel`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
        .send({ reason: 'Attempting cancellation inside lock window' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('within the 36-hour lock window');
    });

    it('allows cancellation when booking is outside the lock window (> 36 hours)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/bookings/${outsideLockBookingId}/cancel`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
        .send({ reason: 'Standard advance cancellation' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('CANCELLED');
    });

    it('rejects cross-date rescheduling when booking is within the lock window', async () => {
      // Attempt to reschedule to dayAfterTomorrowDate (a different date)
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/bookings/${lockWindowBookingId}/reschedule`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
        .send({
          slotStartTime: dayAfterSlotStart,
          slotEndTime: dayAfterSlotEnd,
          dockId: testDockBId,
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('Cannot reschedule to a different date within the 36-hour lock window');
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('Only same-day emergency rescheduling is permitted');
    });

    it('supports same-day emergency rescheduling within the lock window via PUT and PATCH', async () => {
      // Reschedule lockWindowBooking (which was at tomorrowSlot1) to tomorrowSlot2 on the SAME calendar day
      const res = await request(app)
        .put(`/api/bookings/${lockWindowBookingId}/reschedule`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
        .send({
          slotStartTime: tomorrowSlot2Start,
          slotEndTime: tomorrowSlot2End,
          dockId: testDockBId,
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.data.slotStartTime).toBe(tomorrowSlot2Start);
      expect(res.body.data.slotEndTime).toBe(tomorrowSlot2End);
    });
  });
});
```

The configurable warehouse booking/anti-hogging policies and emergency same-day rescheduling rules have been implemented across the database, backend, OpenAPI specification, and frontend.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Database Schema & Prisma Client ([`backend/prisma/schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma))**
   - Added `WarehousePolicy` model linked 1-to-1 with `Warehouse`:
     - `maxConcurrentBookings: Int` (default: `3`)
     - `maxAdvanceDays: Int` (default: `14`)
     - `bookingLockWindowHours: Int` (default: `24`)
   - Applied schema changes to MySQL via `npx prisma db push` and updated `@prisma/client`.

2. **Warehouse Policy Management Endpoints ([`warehouse.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts), [`warehouse.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts), [`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts))**
   - Added `GET /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/policy` (retrieves or auto-creates default policy for the warehouse).
   - Added `PUT /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/policy` (updates `maxConcurrentBookings`, `maxAdvanceDays`, and `bookingLockWindowHours` with strict numeric validation).
   - Secured with authentication and RBAC guards restricted to `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` with tenant isolation.

3. **Booking Enforcement & Same-Day Rescheduling Rules ([`booking.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/booking.service.ts), [`booking.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/booking.routes.ts))**
   - **Max Advance Horizon Check**: Rejects booking creation or rescheduling when target slot start exceeds `now() + maxAdvanceDays`.
   - **Anti-Hogging Check**: Rejects `POST /api/bookings` if the carrier organization has reached `>= maxConcurrentBookings` active bookings (`BOOKED`, `ARRIVED`) at that warehouse.
   - **24-Hour Lock Window & Same-Day Rescheduling Exception**:
     - `PATCH /api/bookings/:id/cancel`: Blocks cancellations within the configured `bookingLockWindowHours` window.
     - `PATCH`/`PUT /api/bookings/:id/reschedule`: When within the lock window, cross-date rescheduling is rejected (400), but **same-day emergency rescheduling** to an open slot on the same calendar day is permitted.

4. **OpenAPI Specification ([`open-api.json`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/open-api.json))**
   - Documented `/warehouses/{warehouseId}/policy` (`get`, `put`).
   - Documented policy error responses and same-day lock window behavior for `/bookings`, `/bookings/{id}/reschedule`, and `/bookings/{id}/cancel`.

5. **Frontend Enhancements ([`DispatcherDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx), [`warehouse.api.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/warehouse.api.ts), [`warehouse.types.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts))**
   - **Slot Search Form**: Configured `max` date attribute based on `warehouse.policy.maxAdvanceDays`.
   - **Emergency Reschedule Cue**: When a booking is inside the 24h lock window, displays an amber banner, restricts the date picker to the same calendar day, and styles the action button as "Emergency Reschedule".
   - **Lock Window Cancellation Guard**: If a booking is within the 24h lock window, displays a lock alert, disables the cancel confirmation, and offers an instant "Emergency Reschedule" shortcut.

- **Backend Tests**: All 74 tests across 9 test suites pass (`npm test`).

The service validates the `slotLengthMinutes` update, confirming it is an integer that divides the operating schedule evenly. Crucially, the system isolates tenants and safeguards existing bookings by updating only the warehouse and operating hour settings, leaving the booking records, including their UTC timestamps, untouched.

**Yes, the requirement is properly fulfilled.**

---

### Detailed Verification & Implementation Breakdown

#### 1. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Tenant Boundaries
- **Route Guarding ([`warehouse.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts#L292-L293))**:
  Both `PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId` and `PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/settings` are protected by:
  ```ts
  authMiddleware, requireVerifiedEmail, authorize(['WAREHOUSE_ADMIN'])
  ```
  Only authenticated warehouse admins with verified emails can access the endpoint.
- **Tenant Isolation ([`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L203-L208))**:
  Verifies that `warehouse.organizationId === organizationId`; attempts by admins of other organizations are rejected with `403 Forbidden`.

#### 2. Slot Length Validation (60 to 30, 45, etc.)
- **Increment Validation ([`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L210-L225))**:
  ```ts
  const allowedIncrements = [15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120];
  if (
    typeof slotLength !== 'number' ||
    !Number.isInteger(slotLength) ||
    slotLength <= 0 ||
    (!allowedIncrements.includes(slotLength) && 1440 % slotLength !== 0)
  ) {
    throw {
      status: 400,
      message: `Invalid slotLengthMinutes: ${slotLength}. Allowed increments must divide evenly into operating schedules (e.g., 30, 45, 60 minutes).`,
    };
  }
  ```
  Transitions like `60 -> 30` or `60 -> 45` are valid, while invalid increments (e.g. 17 minutes) are rejected with `400 Bad Request`.

#### 3. **Existing Bookings Keep Their Times** (Safeguarded)
- **Database Atomicity ([`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L234-L259))**:
  The database transaction **only** updates the warehouse's default configuration and its operating schedule template:
  ```ts
  await tx.warehouse.update({
    where: { id: warehouseId },
    data: { slotLengthMinutes: data.slotLengthMinutes },
  });
  await tx.operatingHour.updateMany({
    where: { warehouseId },
    data: { slotLengthMinutes: data.slotLengthMinutes },
  });
  ```
  The `bookings` table is **never touched, shifted, shortened, or cancelled**. Existing bookings retain their stored `slotStartTime` and `slotEndTime` timestamps.

#### 4. Slot Generation & Overlap Protection ([`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L666-L677))
When future slots are queried via `getAvailableSlots`:
- New slots are generated using the updated duration (e.g., 30 minutes).
- Overlap detection accounts for the original duration of prior bookings:
  ```ts
  const isBooked = bookings.some((b) => {
    if (b.dockId !== dock.id) return false;
    const bStart = b.slotStartTime.getTime();
    const bEnd = b.slotEndTime.getTime();
    return bStart === slotStartMs || (bStart < slotEndMs && bEnd > slotStartMs);
  });
  ```
  For example, an existing 60-minute booking automatically blocks **both** sub-intervals in a 30-minute grid (04:30–05:00 and 05:00–05:30), preventing double-booking while leaving adjacent slots (05:30–06:00) available.

The two routes exist simultaneously as **URL aliases** for **API client flexibility and backwards compatibility with test suites and OpenAPI contracts**:

---

### 1. RESTful Convention vs. Explicit Sub-Resource
- **Standard REST (`PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId`)**:
  In standard REST API design, a `PATCH` request directly on the resource URI (`/:id`) represents a partial update of that resource's attributes (e.g. updating `slotLengthMinutes` without resending the entire warehouse object).
- **Explicit Sub-Resource (`PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/settings`)**:
  In administrative dashboards and API specifications, separating configuration changes under a dedicated sub-resource (`/settings`) clarifies intent and mirrors other dedicated sub-routes like `/:warehouseId/policy` and `/:warehouseId/docks`.

---

### 2. Dual Test Suite Requirements
The test suite in [`backend/tests/warehouse.settings.test.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/tests/warehouse.settings.test.ts) explicitly tests both endpoints:

### 3. OpenAPI Contract Alignment
- In [`open-api.json`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/open-api.json#L249), the path is formally documented as:
  ```json
  "/warehouses/{warehouseId}/settings": { "patch": { ... } }
  ```

- Providing both routes ensures that clients following the OpenAPI contract (`/settings`) and clients following direct RESTful resource updating (`/:warehouseId`) succeed without receiving unexpected `404 Not Found` errors.

```typescript
import Redis from 'ioredis';

const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL || 'redis://localhost:6379';

// In-memory fallback map for zero-dependency local development without Docker
const inMemoryStore = new Map<string, string>();
let isRedisConnected = false;

export const rawRedis = new Redis(redisUrl, {
  maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
  lazyConnect: true,
  enableOfflineQueue: false,
  retryStrategy(times) {
    if (times > 2) return null; // Stop retrying quickly in local dev without docker
    return Math.min(times * 100, 300);
  },
});

rawRedis.on('connect', () => {
  isRedisConnected = true;
  console.log('[Redis] Connected to Redis server.');
});

rawRedis.on('ready', () => {
  isRedisConnected = true;
});

rawRedis.on('error', (err) => {
  isRedisConnected = false;
  // Non-fatal warning for local development without Docker
});

rawRedis.on('close', () => {
  isRedisConnected = false;
});

// Attempt background connection if Redis is running locally
rawRedis.connect().catch(() => {
  // Silently fall back to in-memory store if Redis server is not running
});

/**
 * High-performance Redis client with graceful in-memory fallback
 * for local development without Docker.
 */
export const redis = {
  /**
   * Retrieves the string value associated with key.
   */
  async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await rawRedis.get(key);
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store if Redis command fails
      }
    }
    return inMemoryStore.get(key) ?? null;
  },

  /**
   * Sets key to hold the string value.
   */
  async set(key: string, value: string | number, ...args: any[]): Promise<'OK' | string | null> {
    const strVal = String(value);
    inMemoryStore.set(key, strVal);
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await (rawRedis as any).set(key, strVal, ...args);
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store
      }
    }
    return 'OK';
  },

  /**
   * Increments the number stored at key by one.
   * If key does not exist, it is set to 0 before performing the operation.
   */
  async incr(key: string): Promise<number> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        const val = await rawRedis.incr(key);
        inMemoryStore.set(key, String(val));
        return val;
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store
      }
    }
    const current = parseInt(inMemoryStore.get(key) || '0', 10);
    const next = current + 1;
    inMemoryStore.set(key, String(next));
    return next;
  },

  /**
   * Removes the specified key.
   */
  async del(key: string): Promise<number> {
    const existed = inMemoryStore.has(key) ? 1 : 0;
    inMemoryStore.delete(key);
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await rawRedis.del(key);
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store
      }
    }
    return existed;
  },

  /**
   * Returns PONG if client/fallback is ready.
   */
  async ping(): Promise<string> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await rawRedis.ping();
      } catch {
        // Fall back
      }
    }
    return 'PONG';
  },

  /**
   * Clears the store.
   */
  async flushall(): Promise<'OK'> {
    inMemoryStore.clear();
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        await rawRedis.flushall();
      } catch {
        // Fall back
      }
    }
    return 'OK';
  },

  /**
   * Quits connection.
   */
  async quit(): Promise<'OK'> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        await rawRedis.quit();
      } catch {
        // Suppress
      }
    }
    return 'OK';
  },

  /**
   * Disconnects client.
   */
  async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      rawRedis.disconnect();
    } catch {
      // Suppress
    }
  },

  get isConnected(): boolean {
    return isRedisConnected;
  },
};

export default redis;
```

```text
58:     if (!emailRegex.test(normalizedEmail)) {

63:     let targetRole: UserRole;

66:     } else if (requester.role === 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN') {
67:       targetRole = UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER;
```

```diff
+import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
+import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
+import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';
+import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
+import redis from '../config/redis';
+
+export interface AuthPayload {
+  userId: number;
+  organizationId: number;
+  role: string;
+  email: string;
+  tokenVersion?: number;
+}
+
+export interface TenantContext {
+  organizationId: number;
+  role: string;
+}
+
+declare global {
+  namespace Express {
+    interface Request {
+      user?: AuthPayload;
+      tenant?: TenantContext;
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const authenticate = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
+  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
+
+  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
+    res.status(401).json({
+      success: false,
+      message: 'Access denied. Missing or invalid Authorization header.',
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];
+
+  let decoded: any;
+  try {
+    // Step 1: Verify the JWT signature cryptographically (stateless, zero latency)
+    decoded = jwt.verify(token, securityConfig.jwtSecret);
+  } catch (error: any) {
+    if (error.name === 'TokenExpiredError') {
+      res.status(401).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Token expired. Please login again.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    res.status(401).json({
+      success: false,
+      message: 'Invalid authorization token.',
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  try {
+    const userId = decoded.userId || decoded.id;
+    const organizationId = decoded.organizationId || decoded.organization_id;
+
+    // Step 2: Check MySQL/Prisma or Redis for isActive status
+    const cachedActive = await redis.get(`user:${userId}:isActive`);
+    if (cachedActive === '0' || cachedActive === 'false') {
+      res.status(403).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Account has been deactivated',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (cachedActive === null) {
+      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
+        where: { id: userId },
+        select: { isActive: true },
+      });
+
+      if (!user || user.isActive === false) {
+        await redis.set(`user:${userId}:isActive`, '0');
+        res.status(403).json({
+          success: false,
+          message: 'Account has been deactivated',
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+      // Cache active status
+      await redis.set(`user:${userId}:isActive`, '1');
+    }
+
+    // Step 3: Check Redis for the user's current token version
+    const currentVersionStr = await redis.get(`user:${userId}:tokenVersion`);
+    const currentTokenVersion = currentVersionStr !== null ? parseInt(currentVersionStr, 10) : 0;
+    const tokenVersionInJwt = decoded.tokenVersion ?? 0;
+
+    if (tokenVersionInJwt !== currentTokenVersion) {
+      res.status(401).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Account has been deactivated',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const userPayload: AuthPayload = {
+      userId,
+      organizationId,
+      role: decoded.role,
+      email: decoded.email,
+      tokenVersion: tokenVersionInJwt,
+    };
+
+    req.user = userPayload;
+    req.tenant = {
+      organizationId,
+      role: decoded.role,
+    };
+
+    next();
+  } catch (error: any) {
+    next(error);
+  }
+};
+
+export const authMiddleware = authenticate;
+
+export default authenticate;
```

```diff
+
+  /**
+   * Deactivate a user belonging to the requester's organization and invalidate their active sessions.
+   * Restricted strictly to CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.
+   */
+  public async deactivateUser(
+    requester: RequesterContext,
+    targetUserId: number
+  ): Promise<{ user: { id: number; email: string; role: UserRole; organizationId: number; isActive: boolean }; message: string }> {
+    if (!targetUserId || isNaN(targetUserId)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'A valid target user ID is required.' };
+    }
+
+    if (requester.role !== 'CARRIER_ADMIN' && requester.role !== 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN') {
+      throw {
+        status: 403,
+        message: `Forbidden. Role '${requester.role}' cannot deactivate users. Only CARRIER_ADMIN and WAREHOUSE_ADMIN are authorized.`,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const targetUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
+      where: { id: targetUserId },
+      select: {
+        id: true,
+        email: true,
+        role: true,
+        organizationId: true,
+        isActive: true,
+      },
+    });
+
+    if (!targetUser) {
+      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
+    }
+
+    // Tenant isolation: Admin can only deactivate users in their own organization
+    if (targetUser.organizationId !== requester.organizationId) {
+      throw {
+        status: 403,
+        message: 'Forbidden. You cannot deactivate users belonging to another organization.',
+      };
+    }
+
+    // Step 1: Update MySQL to set isActive = false
+    const updatedUser = await prisma.user.update({
+      where: { id: targetUserId },
+      data: { isActive: false },
+      select: {
+        id: true,
+        email: true,
+        role: true,
+        organizationId: true,
+        isActive: true,
+      },
+    });
+
+    // Step 2: Sever access immediately via Redis cache & token version increment
+    await redis.set(`user:${targetUserId}:isActive`, '0');
+    await redis.incr(`user:${targetUserId}:tokenVersion`);
+
+    return {
+      user: updatedUser,
+      message: `User ${updatedUser.email} has been deactivated successfully.`,
+    };
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Retrieve all users belonging to the requester's organization.
+   * Restricted to organization admins.
+   */
+  public async getOrganizationUsers(requester: RequesterContext) {
+    if (requester.role !== 'CARRIER_ADMIN' && requester.role !== 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN') {
+      throw {
+        status: 403,
+        message: `Forbidden. Role '${requester.role}' cannot list organization users.`,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const users = await prisma.user.findMany({
+      where: { organizationId: requester.organizationId },
+      select: {
+        id: true,
+        email: true,
+        role: true,
+        organizationId: true,
+        isActive: true,
+        isEmailVerified: true,
+        createdAt: true,
+      },
+      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
+    });
+
+    return users;
+  }
+}
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { userService } from '../services/user.service';

export { inviteUser } from './invitation.controller';

export const deactivateUser = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const requester = req.user;
    if (!requester) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Authentication required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const targetUserId = parseInt(req.params.id, 10);
    if (isNaN(targetUserId)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid target user ID.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const result = await userService.deactivateUser(
      {
        userId: requester.userId,
        organizationId: requester.organizationId,
        role: requester.role,
      },
      targetUserId
    );

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
      data: result.user,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Failed to deactivate user.',
    });
  }
};

export const getUsers = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const requester = req.user;
    if (!requester) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized. Authentication required.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const users = await userService.getOrganizationUsers({
      userId: requester.userId,
      organizationId: requester.organizationId,
      role: requester.role,
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: users,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Failed to retrieve organization users.',
    });
  }
};

```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole } from '@prisma/client';
import redis from '../src/config/redis';

describe('Redis + JWT Session Control & User Deactivation Tests', () => {
  let carrierAdminToken: string;
  let carrierAdminId: number;
  let carrierOrgId: number;

  let warehouseAdminToken: string;
  let warehouseAdminId: number;
  let warehouseOrgId: number;

  let dispatcherUser: any;
  let dispatcherToken: string;

  let foreignOrgDispatcher: any;
  let foreignOrgDispatcherToken: string;

  const testTimestamp = Date.now();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Create Carrier Org & Admin
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Swift Sessions Carrier ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const carrierAdmin = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `c_admin_${testTimestamp}@swiftsessions.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    carrierAdminId = carrierAdmin.id;
    carrierAdminToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: carrierAdmin.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: carrierAdmin.role,
        email: carrierAdmin.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 2. Create Warehouse Org & Admin
    const warehouseOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Apex Storage Sessions ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgId = warehouseOrg.id;

    const warehouseAdmin = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        email: `wh_admin_${testTimestamp}@apexstorage.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminId = warehouseAdmin.id;
    warehouseAdminToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: warehouseAdmin.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        role: warehouseAdmin.role,
        email: warehouseAdmin.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 3. Create Dispatcher under Carrier Org
    dispatcherUser = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `dispatcher_${testTimestamp}@swiftsessions.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dispatcherUser.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: dispatcherUser.role,
        email: dispatcherUser.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 4. Create Dispatcher under Foreign Org
    const foreignOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Foreign Org ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });

    foreignOrgDispatcher = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: foreignOrg.id,
        email: `foreign_dispatcher_${testTimestamp}@foreign.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    foreignOrgDispatcherToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: foreignOrgDispatcher.id,
        organizationId: foreignOrg.id,
        role: foreignOrgDispatcher.role,
        email: foreignOrgDispatcher.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    // Clean up created entities
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: [carrierAdminId, warehouseAdminId, dispatcherUser?.id, foreignOrgDispatcher?.id] },
      },
    }).catch(() => {});
    await prisma.organization.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: [carrierOrgId, warehouseOrgId, foreignOrgDispatcher?.organizationId] },
      },
    }).catch(() => {});
  });

  describe('Part 1: Log Out of All Devices (POST /api/auth/logout-all)', () => {
    it('should allow an authenticated user to access protected endpoints before logout-all', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.data.id).toBe(dispatcherUser.id);
    });

    it('should successfully log out of all devices by incrementing token version in Redis', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/logout-all')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('logged out of all devices');

      // Verify Redis tokenVersion was incremented
      const newVersion = await redis.get(`user:${dispatcherUser.id}:tokenVersion`);
      expect(Number(newVersion)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    });

    it('should reject previous JWT with 401 Unauthorized after logout-all', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toBe('Account has been deactivated');
    });

    it('should allow access again when a new token with the updated tokenVersion is issued', async () => {
      const versionStr = await redis.get(`user:${dispatcherUser.id}:tokenVersion`);
      const currentVersion = parseInt(versionStr || '0', 10);

      const freshToken = jwt.sign(
        {
          userId: dispatcherUser.id,
          organizationId: carrierOrgId,
          role: dispatcherUser.role,
          email: dispatcherUser.email,
          tokenVersion: currentVersion,
        },
        securityConfig.jwtSecret,
        { expiresIn: '1h' }
      );

      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${freshToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('Part 2: Admin User Deactivation (PATCH /api/users/:id/deactivate)', () => {
    it('should reject deactivation if requester is not CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN (403)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/users/${dispatcherUser.id}/deactivate`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${foreignOrgDispatcherToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should reject deactivation if target user belongs to a different organization (403 Tenant Isolation)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/users/${foreignOrgDispatcher.id}/deactivate`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('another organization');
    });

    it('should return 404 if target user does not exist', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch('/api/users/9999999/deactivate')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return 400 if user ID is invalid', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch('/api/users/invalid-id/deactivate')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should allow CARRIER_ADMIN to deactivate a user in their organization', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/users/${dispatcherUser.id}/deactivate`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('deactivated successfully');
      expect(res.body.data.isActive).toBe(false);

      // Verify in MySQL
      const userInDb = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: dispatcherUser.id } });
      expect(userInDb?.isActive).toBe(false);

      // Verify in Redis
      const redisActive = await redis.get(`user:${dispatcherUser.id}:isActive`);
      expect(redisActive).toBe('0');
    });

    it('should immediately reject deactivated user requests with 403 Forbidden', async () => {
      const versionStr = await redis.get(`user:${dispatcherUser.id}:tokenVersion`);
      const currentVersion = parseInt(versionStr || '0', 10);

      // Even with updated tokenVersion, deactivated status in Redis/MySQL must return 403
      const tokenWithNewVersion = jwt.sign(
        {
          userId: dispatcherUser.id,
          organizationId: carrierOrgId,
          role: dispatcherUser.role,
          email: dispatcherUser.email,
          tokenVersion: currentVersion,
        },
        securityConfig.jwtSecret,
        { expiresIn: '1h' }
      );

      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${tokenWithNewVersion}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toBe('Account has been deactivated');
    });

    it('should allow organization admin to list users in organization (GET /api/users)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/users')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierAdminToken}`);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(Array.isArray(res.body.data)).toBe(true);
      const foundDispatcher = res.body.data.find((u: any) => u.id === dispatcherUser.id);
      expect(foundDispatcher).toBeDefined();
      expect(foundDispatcher.isActive).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import apiClient from './client';
import type { User } from '../types/user.types';

export interface InviteUserRequest {
  email: string;
}

export interface InviteUserResponse {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  data?: any;
}

export const userApi = {
  getUsers: async (): Promise<{ success: boolean; data: User[] }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.get<{ success: boolean; data: User[] }>('/users');
    return response.data;
  },

  deactivateUser: async (userId: number): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; data?: User }> => {
    const response = await apiClient.patch<{ success: boolean; message: string; data?: User }>(`/users/${userId}/deactivate`);
    return response.data;
  },

  inviteUser: async (data: InviteUserRequest): Promise<InviteUserResponse> => {
    const response = await apiClient.post<InviteUserResponse>('/users/invite', data);
    return response.data;
  },
};

export default userApi;

```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Users,
  UserX,
  UserCheck,
  UserPlus,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  RefreshCw,
  Shield,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { userApi } from '../api/user.api';
import type { User } from '../types/user.types';

interface TeamManagementModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentUserId: number;
  currentUserRole: string;
  organizationName?: string;
}

export const TeamManagementModal: React.FC<TeamManagementModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentUserId,
  currentUserRole,
  organizationName,
}) => {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<User[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [deactivatingId, setDeactivatingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [inviteEmail, setInviteEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [isInviting, setIsInviting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchUsers = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await userApi.getUsers();
      if (res?.data) {
        setUsers(res.data);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to load organization team members.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      fetchUsers();
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setSuccessMessage(null);
      setInviteEmail('');
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleDeactivate = async (targetUser: User) => {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to deactivate ${targetUser.email}? Their active sessions will be terminated immediately.`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDeactivatingId(targetUser.id);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await userApi.deactivateUser(targetUser.id);
      setSuccessMessage(res.message || `User ${targetUser.email} has been deactivated.`);
      await fetchUsers();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to deactivate user.');
    } finally {
      setDeactivatingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleInvite = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!inviteEmail.trim()) return;

    setIsInviting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await userApi.inviteUser({ email: inviteEmail.trim() });
      setSuccessMessage(res.message || `Invitation successfully sent to ${inviteEmail}.`);
      setInviteEmail('');
      await fetchUsers();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to send invitation.');
    } finally {
      setIsInviting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl max-w-2xl w-full max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold tracking-tight">Organization Team & Access Control</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-300">
                {organizationName || 'Workspace'} • {currentUserRole}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Banners */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 flex-1">
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 rounded-lg text-xs flex items-center space-x-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {successMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-xs flex items-center space-x-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{successMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Invite Section */}
          <div className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
              <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
              <span>Invite New Team Member</span>
            </h3>
            <form onSubmit={handleInvite} className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="email"
                placeholder="colleague@organization.com"
                value={inviteEmail}
                onChange={(e) => setInviteEmail(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isInviting || !inviteEmail.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-[#2F4F4F] hover:bg-[#1E3333] disabled:opacity-50 rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center space-x-1.5"
              >
                {isInviting && <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />}
                <span>Send Invite</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Users List Section */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                <span>Active & Deactivated Members</span>
              </h3>
              <button
                onClick={fetchUsers}
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="text-xs text-[#2F4F4F] hover:underline flex items-center space-x-1"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>Refresh</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {isLoading && users.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-gray-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto text-gray-400 mb-2" />
                Loading team members...
              </div>
            ) : users.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-gray-200">
                No users found.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg divide-y divide-gray-100 overflow-hidden">
                {users.map((u) => {
                  const isDeactivated = u.isActive === false;
                  const isSelf = u.id === currentUserId;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={u.id}
                      className="p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-gray-50/80 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                        <div
                          className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold ${
                            isDeactivated
                              ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
                              : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {u.email.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-900">{u.email}</span>
                            {isSelf && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                You
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mt-0.5">
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">{u.role}</span>
                            <span className="text-gray-300">•</span>
                            <span
                              className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center space-x-1 ${
                                isDeactivated
                                  ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200'
                                  : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {isDeactivated ? (
                                <>
                                  <UserX className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                  <span>Deactivated</span>
                                </>
                              ) : (
                                <>
                                  <UserCheck className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                  <span>Active</span>
                                </>
                              )}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        {isDeactivated ? (
                          <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 italic">Access Severed</span>
                        ) : isSelf ? (
                          <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Current Session</span>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDeactivate(u)}
                            disabled={deactivatingId === u.id}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 hover:text-red-700 border border-red-200 hover:border-red-300 hover:bg-red-50 rounded transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center space-x-1"
                          >
                            {deactivatingId === u.id ? (
                              <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                            ) : (
                              <UserX className="w-3 h-3" />
                            )}
                            <span>Deactivate</span>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="px-6 py-3 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-md transition-colors"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TeamManagementModal;

```

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Redis configuration and usage appear central to the backend, specifically for session management and potentially invitation flows. The presence of `ioredis` and related types suggests Redis is the primary caching or data store. "Log out of all devices" and "Admin User Deactivation" have been implemented across the backend and frontend using a high-performance Redis + JWT session control pattern, fully configured for local development without Docker.

---

### Key Implementations

#### 1. Redis Configuration with Zero-Docker Local Development Fallback
- [**`backend/src/config/redis.ts`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/config/redis.ts): Initialized an `ioredis` client with fast non-blocking retry strategy and an in-memory fallback store (`Map<string, string>`). If Redis is running locally, it connects; if offline or running without Docker, it seamlessly falls back to the in-memory store so that local development and test runs never fail or stall.
- Added `REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379` to [`backend/.env`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/.env).

#### 2. JWT & Session Version Generation
- [**`backend/src/services/auth.service.ts`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts):
  - Updated [`generateToken`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L69-L84) to encode `tokenVersion` into JWT payloads.
  - Implemented [`getUserTokenVersion`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L86-L92) and [`logoutAll`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L94-L98) (`INCR user:{userId}:tokenVersion`).
  - Updated `register` and `login` to fetch the current `tokenVersion` from Redis before issuing JWTs.
- [**`backend/src/services/invitation.service.ts`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/invitation.service.ts):
  - Updated `acceptInvitation` to fetch and embed the user's `tokenVersion` when issuing tokens upon account creation.

#### 3. 3-Step Authentication Middleware
- [**`backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts):
  - **Step 1 (Zero-Latency JWT Signature Check):** Cryptographically verifies the incoming bearer JWT.
  - **Step 2 (Active Status Check):** Checks Redis cache `user:{userId}:isActive` (falling back to MySQL `prisma.user.findUnique`). If `isActive === false || isActive === '0'`, immediately rejects with **`403 Forbidden`** (`"Account has been deactivated"`).
  - **Step 3 (Session Token Version Check):** Queries Redis `GET user:{userId}:tokenVersion`. Compares against `tokenVersion` inside the decoded JWT claim. If mismatched, rejects with **`401 Unauthorized`** (`"Account has been deactivated"`).

#### 4. Backend Endpoints
- **Log Out of All Devices (`POST /api/auth/logout-all`):**
  - Authenticated user endpoint in [`auth.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/auth.controller.ts#L196-L221) and [`auth.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/auth.routes.ts#L289-L318).
  - Increments `user:{userId}:tokenVersion` in Redis, invalidating all existing JWTs across all active browsers and devices.
- **Admin User Deactivation (`PATCH /api/users/:id/deactivate`):**
  - Restricted strictly to `CARRIER_ADMIN` or `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` in [`user.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/user.service.ts#L143-L206), [`user.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/user.controller.ts#L6-L45), and [`user.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/user.routes.ts#L112-L162).
  - Enforces tenant isolation (admin can only deactivate users in their own organization).
  - Updates MySQL (`isActive = false`) and sever access in Redis (`SET user:{id}:isActive = '0'` and `INCR user:{id}:tokenVersion`).
- **List Organization Users (`GET /api/users`):**
  - Allows organization admins to retrieve all team members with active/deactivated statuses.

#### 5. OpenAPI Specification Contract
- Updated [**`open-api.json`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/open-api.json#L1315-L1424) with complete OpenAPI 3.0 schemas for `/auth/logout-all`, `/users`, and `/users/{id}/deactivate`.

#### 6. Frontend Integration
- [**`frontend/src/api/auth.api.ts`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/auth.api.ts): Added `logoutAll()`.
- [**`frontend/src/api/user.api.ts`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/user.api.ts): Created client API with `getUsers()`, `deactivateUser(id)`, and `inviteUser(email)`.
- [**`frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx): Added `logoutAll` method that calls the backend and clears local storage.
- [**`frontend/src/components/TeamManagementModal.tsx`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/components/TeamManagementModal.tsx): Interactive admin modal allowing admins to list members, see Active / Deactivated badges, deactivate members, and invite new members.
- [**`frontend/src/App.tsx`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/App.tsx): Added "Log Out All Devices" button and "Team & Access" admin button to the top navbar.

```diff
+
```
```diff
+    if (!dock) {
+      throw { status: 404, message: 'Dock not found.' };
+    }
+
+    if (warehouseId && dock.warehouseId !== warehouseId) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Dock does not belong to the specified warehouse.' };

+
+    if (dock.warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
+      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to modify this dock.' };

+
+    const isNameChanging = data.name !== undefined && data.name.trim() !== dock.name;

+        throw {

+          message: `Cannot update dock name while there are active bookings with status 'BOOKED'.`,
+        };

+
+    const updatedDock = await prisma.dock.update({

+      },
+      include: {
+        warehouse: true,
+      },
+    });
+
+    return updatedDock;
+  }
```

```diff
+/**
+ * Updates dock details (name, and optional status).
+ * To avoid confusion with drivers, the name is only updatable if there are no active
+ * bookings with status 'BOOKED' for this dock.
+ * PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks/:dockId
+ * PATCH /api/warehouses/docks/:dockId
+ * PUT /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks/:dockId
+ * PUT /api/warehouses/docks/:dockId
+ */
+export const updateDock = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
+  try {
+    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
+    if (!organizationId) {
+      res.status(401).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const dockId = parseParamId(req.params.dockId);
+    if (isNaN(dockId)) {
+      res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Invalid dock ID.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const rawWarehouseId = req.params.warehouseId;
+    const warehouseId = rawWarehouseId ? parseParamId(rawWarehouseId) : undefined;
+    if (warehouseId !== undefined && isNaN(warehouseId)) {
+      res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const { name, status } = req.body;
+    if (name === undefined && status === undefined) {
+      res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'At least one field (name or status) must be provided to update.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const updatedDock = await warehouseService.updateDock(
+      dockId,
+      organizationId,
+      { name, status },
+      warehouseId
+    );
+
+    res.status(200).json({
+      success: true,
+      message: 'Dock updated successfully',
+      data: updatedDock,
+    });
+  } catch (error: any) {
+    const status = error.status || 500;
+    res.status(status).json({
+      success: false,
+      message: error.message || 'Internal server error while updating dock.',
+    });
+  }
+};
+
+export const updateDockName = updateDock;
```

```typescript
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole, DockStatus, BookingStatus } from '@prisma/client';

describe('Warehouse Admin Dock Name Update & Driver Confusion Prevention Tests', () => {
  let warehouseOrgAId: number;
  let warehouseAdminAToken: string;
  let dockManagerAToken: string;

  let warehouseOrgBId: number;
  let warehouseAdminBToken: string;

  let carrierOrgId: number;
  let carrierDispatcherToken: string;

  let testWarehouseAId: number;
  let testDock1Id: number;
  let testDock2Id: number;

  const testTimestamp = Date.now();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Warehouse Organization A
    const orgA = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Wh Org A Docks ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgAId = orgA.id;

    // Admin A
    const adminA = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        email: `wh_admin_a_${testTimestamp}@docktest.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminAToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: adminA.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        role: adminA.role,
        email: adminA.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // Dock Manager A
    const managerA = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        email: `dock_mgr_a_${testTimestamp}@docktest.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dockManagerAToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: managerA.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        role: managerA.role,
        email: managerA.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // Warehouse A
    const warehouseA = await prisma.warehouse.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgAId,
        name: `Colombo Port Terminal ${testTimestamp}`,
        address: '100 Port Rd, Colombo',
        timezone: 'Asia/Colombo',
        slotLengthMinutes: 60,
      },
    });
    testWarehouseAId = warehouseA.id;

    // Docks on Warehouse A
    const dock1 = await prisma.dock.create({
      data: {
        warehouseId: testWarehouseAId,
        name: 'Bay 01 - General Cargo',
        status: DockStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
    });
    testDock1Id = dock1.id;

    const dock2 = await prisma.dock.create({
      data: {
        warehouseId: testWarehouseAId,
        name: 'Bay 02 - Cold Storage',
        status: DockStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
    });
    testDock2Id = dock2.id;

    // 2. Warehouse Organization B (for tenant isolation tests)
    const orgB = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Wh Org B Docks ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgBId = orgB.id;

    const adminB = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgBId,
        email: `wh_admin_b_${testTimestamp}@docktest.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminBToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: adminB.id,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgBId,
        role: adminB.role,
        email: adminB.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 3. Carrier Organization & Dispatcher
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Fast Freight Logistics ${testTimestamp}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const dispatcher = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `dispatcher_${testTimestamp}@fastfreight.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy_hash',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    carrierDispatcherToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: dispatcher.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: dispatcher.role,
        email: dispatcher.email,
        tokenVersion: 0,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    // Cleanup bookings, docks, warehouses, users, orgs
    await prisma.booking.deleteMany({
      where: {
        dockId: { in: [testDock1Id, testDock2Id] },
      },
    }).catch(() => {});

    await prisma.dock.deleteMany({
      where: { id: { in: [testDock1Id, testDock2Id] } },
    }).catch(() => {});

    await prisma.warehouse.deleteMany({
      where: { id: testWarehouseAId },
    }).catch(() => {});

    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        organizationId: { in: [warehouseOrgAId, warehouseOrgBId, carrierOrgId] },
      },
    }).catch(() => {});

    await prisma.organization.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: [warehouseOrgAId, warehouseOrgBId, carrierOrgId] },
      },
    }).catch(() => {});
  });

  describe('Part 1: Successful Dock Name Update when no bookings exist', () => {
    it('should allow WAREHOUSE_ADMIN to update dock name via /warehouses/:warehouseId/docks/:dockId', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Bay 01 - Heavy Equipment Loading' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('Dock updated successfully');
      expect(res.body.data.name).toBe('Bay 01 - Heavy Equipment Loading');

      const inDb = await prisma.dock.findUnique({ where: { id: testDock1Id } });
      expect(inDb?.name).toBe('Bay 01 - Heavy Equipment Loading');
    });

    it('should allow WAREHOUSE_ADMIN to update dock name via /warehouses/docks/:dockId', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/docks/${testDock2Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Bay 02 - Deep Freeze Chamber' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.data.name).toBe('Bay 02 - Deep Freeze Chamber');

      const inDb = await prisma.dock.findUnique({ where: { id: testDock2Id } });
      expect(inDb?.name).toBe('Bay 02 - Deep Freeze Chamber');
    });
  });

  describe('Part 2: Driver Confusion Prevention - Block update when BOOKED bookings exist', () => {
    it('should reject dock name update with 400 when an active booking with status BOOKED exists', async () => {
      // Create a confirmed booking with status BOOKED on dock1
      const futureStart = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      const futureEnd = new Date(futureStart.getTime() + 60 * 60 * 1000);

      const booking = await prisma.booking.create({
        data: {
          dockId: testDock1Id,
          carrierId: carrierOrgId,
          truckLicensePlate: 'WP-CAB-1234',
          driverName: 'Saman Silva',
          driverPhone: '+94771234567',
          cargoNote: 'High value electronics',
          startTime: futureStart,
          endTime: futureEnd,
          status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
        },
      });

      // Attempt to update dock name
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Bay 01 - Completely New Name' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/active bookings with status 'BOOKED'/i);

      // Clean up this booking
      await prisma.booking.delete({ where: { id: booking.id } });
    });

    it('should allow dock name update if existing bookings are COMPLETED or CANCELLED (not BOOKED)', async () => {
      const pastStart = new Date(Date.now() - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      const pastEnd = new Date(pastStart.getTime() + 60 * 60 * 1000);

      // Create a COMPLETED booking
      const completedBooking = await prisma.booking.create({
        data: {
          dockId: testDock1Id,
          carrierId: carrierOrgId,
          truckLicensePlate: 'WP-CAB-1234',
          driverName: 'Saman Silva',
          driverPhone: '+94771234567',
          cargoNote: 'Past cargo',
          startTime: pastStart,
          endTime: pastEnd,
          status: BookingStatus.COMPLETED,
        },
      });

      // Create a CANCELLED booking
      const cancelledBooking = await prisma.booking.create({
        data: {
          dockId: testDock1Id,
          carrierId: carrierOrgId,
          truckLicensePlate: 'WP-CAB-5678',
          driverName: 'Kamal Perera',
          driverPhone: '+94771234568',
          cargoNote: 'Cancelled cargo',
          startTime: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
          endTime: new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
          status: BookingStatus.CANCELLED,
        },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Bay 01 - Dry Storage Express' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.data.name).toBe('Bay 01 - Dry Storage Express');

      // Cleanup
      await prisma.booking.deleteMany({
        where: { id: { in: [completedBooking.id, cancelledBooking.id] } },
      });
    });
  });

  describe('Part 3: RBAC & Tenant Isolation Enforcement', () => {
    it('should reject dock name update by DOCK_MANAGER (403 Forbidden)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dockManagerAToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Unauthorized Dock Name Change' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should reject dock name update by CARRIER DISPATCHER (403 Forbidden)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${carrierDispatcherToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Carrier Unauthorized Change' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should reject dock name update without authentication (401 Unauthorized)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .send({ name: 'Unauthenticated Change' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should reject dock name update by WAREHOUSE_ADMIN from another organization (403 Tenant Isolation)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminBToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Cross-Tenant Hijack' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(res.body.message).toMatch(/permission/i);
    });

    it('should return 404 if dock does not exist', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/9999999`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ name: 'Ghost Dock' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should return 400 if name is empty or blank', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseAId}/docks/${testDock1Id}`)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminAToken}`)
        .send({ name: '   ' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});
```

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Two new `PATCH` and `PUT` endpoints have been established for updating dock information; they are routed via `/:warehouseId/docks/:dockId` or `/docks/:dockId`. Access to these endpoints is strictly controlled, permitting only users with the `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` role and verified email addresses. A safeguard mechanism counts bookings with the specified `dockId` to mitigate driver confusion.
</details></think>

The endpoint for Warehouse Admins to update `dock.name` with driver confusion prevention has been implemented.

---

### Implementation Details

#### 1. Service Layer ([`backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L442-L508))
- Defined [`UpdateDockInput`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L44-L47):
  ```ts
  export interface UpdateDockInput {
    name?: string;
    status?: DockStatus;
  }
  ```
- Implemented [`updateDock(dockId, organizationId, data, warehouseId?)`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L447-L508):
  - **Validation & Tenant Isolation**: Verifies the dock exists, belongs to the caller's organization (`dock.warehouse.organizationId === organizationId`), and matches `warehouseId` (if passed in path).
  - **Driver Confusion Prevention**: Identical to `updateWarehouse`, if `name` is changing, it checks for active bookings:
    ```ts
    const isNameChanging = data.name !== undefined && data.name.trim() !== dock.name;

    if (isNameChanging) {
      const activeBookedCount = await prisma.booking.count({
        where: {
          dockId,
          status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
        },
      });

      if (activeBookedCount > 0) {
        throw {
          status: 400,
          message: `Cannot update dock name while there are active bookings with status 'BOOKED'.`,
        };
      }
    }
    ```
  - **Update**: Updates `name` (and optional `status`), returning the updated dock model with parent warehouse relation.

#### 2. Controller Layer ([`backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L347-L408))
- Implemented [`updateDock`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L347-L408) (and exported alias [`updateDockName`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/warehouse.controller.ts#L408)):
  - Parses `dockId` and optional `warehouseId`.
  - Ensures at least `name` or `status` is provided.
  - Calls `warehouseService.updateDock` and returns `200 OK` with `{ success: true, message: 'Dock updated successfully', data: updatedDock }`.

#### 3. Route Layer ([`backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts#L460-L536) & [`dock.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/dock.routes.ts#L9-L25))
- Mounted with authentication, email verification, and RBAC guards restricted to **`WAREHOUSE_ADMIN`**:
  - `PATCH /api/warehouses/:warehouseId/docks/:dockId`
  - `PATCH /api/warehouses/docks/:dockId`
  - `PATCH /api/docks/:dockId`
  - (Also supports `PUT` for complete RESTful client flexibility).

#### 4. OpenAPI Specification ([`open-api.json`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/open-api.json#L127-L175))
- Added OpenAPI 3.0 path specification for `/warehouses/docks/{dockId}` and `/warehouses/{warehouseId}/docks/{dockId}` documenting request payloads and response statuses (`200`, `400`, `403`, `404`).

---

### Verification & Testing

Created dedicated integration test suite [**`backend/tests/dock.name.update.test.ts`**](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/tests/dock.name.update.test.ts) covering all scenarios:
1. **Successful Update:** `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` updates dock name when no bookings exist (returns `200`).
2. **Driver Confusion Safeguard:** Rejects dock name update with `400 Bad Request` (`Cannot update dock name while there are active bookings with status 'BOOKED'.`) when confirmed bookings with `status = BOOKED` exist.
3. **Completed / Cancelled Bookings:** Allows dock name update if all existing bookings are `COMPLETED` or `CANCELLED`.
4. **RBAC Protection:** Rejects updates attempted by `DOCK_MANAGER` (`403`), `DISPATCHER` (`403`), or unauthenticated requests (`401`).
5. **Tenant Isolation:** Rejects update attempt by `WAREHOUSE_ADMIN` from another organization (`403 Forbidden`).

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Considering the frontend specification, need to create a dashboard layout for warehouse admins. The initial focus is the "Warehouses & Docks" tab. It appears this will involve displaying and likely managing warehouse and dock-related data. I must determine if the existing API endpoints are sufficient or if new endpoints will be required for this tab's functionality.


Analyzing the requirements for the `WarehouseAdminDashboard.tsx` frontend component.  The design necessitates a header with summary badges and a tab switcher, along with a warehouse selector for managing specific warehouse data. Tab 1, "Warehouses & Docks," will feature a selected warehouse card.


Focusing on the warehouse details section, the UI requires input fields for name, address, timezone (with a dropdown for common options), and slot length, along with a save button that updates warehouse data through the existing API. A note should alert the user about active bookings restricting certain updates. Dock management needs an interface to create, edit, and toggle the status of loading docks, using separate API calls for updates and creation. The second tab requires a slot interval selector and daily schedule configuration UI.


Examining the UI elements for the schedule configuration tab, a time picker to define operating hours, a 24-hour toggle, and a calculated daily slot capacity display are required. A save button with mock success notification completes this tab.

The booking policies tab needs form fields to configure concurrent bookings, advance booking horizon, and hard-lock window, pulling existing policies and using a dedicated update endpoint for policy modifications.

User management requires a table with user details, status indicators, and an action button to deactivate users, utilizing a confirmation dialog, loading indicator and dedicated API call.


Examined the component structure in `WarehouseDashboard.tsx` and `App.tsx` and confirmed the ability to render the new `WarehouseAdminDashboard` based on user role. This confirms the initial hypothesis that the admin dashboard can be integrated into the existing layout. Proposed a tabbed interface in `WarehouseDashboard.tsx` to switch between the existing view and the new admin console.
</details></think>
