```diff
+  /**
+   * Lists docks for a warehouse, enforcing strict tenant isolation for warehouse operators,
+   * using an optimized single-query with Prisma include to evaluate dynamic real-time effectiveStatus.
+   */
+  async getDocks(warehouseId: number, organizationId: number, isCarrier: boolean = false) {
+    return dockService.getDocksByWarehouse(warehouseId, organizationId, isCarrier);
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Updates dock status (e.g. toggling between ACTIVE and MAINTENANCE),
+   * enforcing strict tenant isolation through the parent warehouse.
+   */
+  async updateDockStatus(dockId: number, organizationId: number, status: DockStatus) {
+    if (!dockId || isNaN(dockId)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid dock ID.' };
+    }
+
+    if (!status || !Object.values(DockStatus).includes(status)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: `Invalid dock status: '${status}'. Must be ACTIVE or MAINTENANCE.` };
+    }
+
+    const dock = await prisma.dock.findUnique({
+      where: { id: dockId },
+      include: { warehouse: true },
+    });
+
+    if (!dock) {
+      throw { status: 404, message: 'Dock not found.' };
+    }
+
+    if (dock.warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
+      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to modify this dock.' };
+    }
+
+    const now = new Date();
+    const updatedDock = await prisma.dock.update({
+      where: { id: dockId },
+      data: { status },
+      include: {
+        closures: {
+          where: {
+            startTime: { lte: now },
+            endTime: { gte: now },
+          },
+        },
+      },
+    });
+
+    const isUnderClosure = updatedDock.closures && updatedDock.closures.length > 0;
+    const effectiveStatus: 'ACTIVE' | 'MAINTENANCE' = isUnderClosure
+      ? 'MAINTENANCE'
+      : (updatedDock.status as 'ACTIVE' | 'MAINTENANCE');
+
+    return {
+      ...updatedDock,
+      effectiveStatus,
+    };
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Updates a dock's name (and optional status), strictly verifying organization ownership.
+   * To prevent driver and carrier confusion, the dock name can only be updated if there are
+   * no active bookings with status 'BOOKED' for this dock.
+   */
+  async updateDock(dockId: number, organizationId: number, data: UpdateDockInput, warehouseId?: number) {
+    if (!dockId || isNaN(dockId)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid dock ID.' };
+    }
+
+    if (data.name !== undefined && (!data.name || typeof data.name !== 'string' || !data.name.trim())) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Dock name cannot be empty.' };
+    }
+
+    if (data.status && !Object.values(DockStatus).includes(data.status)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: `Invalid dock status: '${data.status}'. Must be ACTIVE or MAINTENANCE.` };
+    }
+
+    const dock = await prisma.dock.findUnique({
+      where: { id: dockId },
+      include: { warehouse: true },
+    });
+
+    if (!dock) {
+      throw { status: 404, message: 'Dock not found.' };
+    }
+
+    if (warehouseId && dock.warehouseId !== warehouseId) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Dock does not belong to the specified warehouse.' };
+    }
+
+    if (dock.warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
+      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to modify this dock.' };
+    }
+
+    const isNameChanging = data.name !== undefined && data.name.trim() !== dock.name;
+
+    if (isNameChanging) {
+      const activeBookedCount = await prisma.booking.count({
+        where: {
+          dockId,
+          status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
+        },
+      });
+
+      if (activeBookedCount > 0) {
+        throw {
+          status: 400,
+          message: `Cannot update dock name while there are active bookings with status 'BOOKED'.`,
+        };
+      }
+    }
+
+    const now = new Date();
+    const updatedDock = await prisma.dock.update({
+      where: { id: dockId },
+      data: {
+        ...(data.name !== undefined && { name: data.name.trim() }),
+        ...(data.status !== undefined && { status: data.status }),
+      },
+      include: {
+        warehouse: true,
+        closures: {
+          where: {
+            startTime: { lte: now },
+            endTime: { gte: now },
+          },
+        },
+      },
+    });
+
+    const isUnderClosure = updatedDock.closures && updatedDock.closures.length > 0;
+    const effectiveStatus: 'ACTIVE' | 'MAINTENANCE' = isUnderClosure
+      ? 'MAINTENANCE'
+      : (updatedDock.status as 'ACTIVE' | 'MAINTENANCE');
+
+    return {
+      ...updatedDock,
+      effectiveStatus,
+    };
+  }
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole, DockStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { JWT_SECRET } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { dockService } from '../src/services/dock.service';

describe('Real-Time Dynamic Dock Status Evaluation & Active Closure Enforcement Tests', () => {
  let warehouseOrgId: number;
  let warehouseId: number;
  let dockActiveId: number;
  let dockWithActiveClosureId: number;
  let dockBaseMaintenanceId: number;

  let warehouseAdminToken: string;
  let carrierOrgId: number;
  let dispatcherToken: string;

  const testSalt = Date.now();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Create Warehouse Operator Organization
    const warehouseOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Dynamic Status Warehouse Org ${testSalt}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgId = warehouseOrg.id;

    // 2. Create Warehouse Admin User
    const adminPasswordHash = await bcrypt.hash('SecurePass123!', 10);
    const adminUser = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: `dynamic_admin_${testSalt}@dockslot.local`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: adminPasswordHash,
        role: UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN,
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    warehouseAdminToken = jwt.sign(
      { userId: adminUser.id, email: adminUser.email, role: adminUser.role, organizationId: warehouseOrgId },
      JWT_SECRET,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 3. Create Carrier Org & Dispatcher User
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Dynamic Status Carrier Org ${testSalt}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const dispatcherUser = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: `dynamic_dispatcher_${testSalt}@carrier.local`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: adminPasswordHash,
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherToken = jwt.sign(
      { userId: dispatcherUser.id, email: dispatcherUser.email, role: dispatcherUser.role, organizationId: carrierOrgId },
      JWT_SECRET,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    // 4. Create Warehouse with 24/7 operating hours
    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        name: `Dynamic Evaluation Facility ${testSalt}`,
        address: '123 Harbor Parkway, Colombo',
        timezone: 'Asia/Colombo',
        slotLengthMinutes: 30,
        operatingHours: {
          create: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayOfWeek) => ({
            dayOfWeek,
            openTime: '00:00',
            closeTime: '23:59',
            slotLengthMinutes: 30,
          })),
        },
        policy: {
          create: {
            maxConcurrentBookings: 10,
            maxAdvanceDays: 30,
            bookingLockWindowHours: 1,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    warehouseId = warehouse.id;

    // 5. Create Docks:
    // Dock 1: Base ACTIVE, no closures
    const dock1 = await prisma.dock.create({
      data: {
        warehouseId,
        name: 'Bay 1 - Pure Active',
        status: DockStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
    });
    dockActiveId = dock1.id;

    // Dock 2: Base ACTIVE, but has active time-bounded maintenance closure right now
    const dock2 = await prisma.dock.create({
      data: {
        warehouseId,
        name: 'Bay 2 - Active Closure Target',
        status: DockStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
    });
    dockWithActiveClosureId = dock2.id;

    // Dock 3: Base MAINTENANCE in database
    const dock3 = await prisma.dock.create({
      data: {
        warehouseId,
        name: 'Bay 3 - Manual Maintenance',
        status: DockStatus.MAINTENANCE,
      },
    });
    dockBaseMaintenanceId = dock3.id;

    // 6. Schedule an ACTIVE maintenance closure on Dock 2 covering the current timestamp (now - 1 hour to now + 2 hours)
    const now = new Date();
    const activeStart = new Date(now.getTime() - 60 * 60 * 1000); // 1 hour ago
    const activeEnd = new Date(now.getTime() + 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 2 hours from now

    await prisma.dockClosure.create({
      data: {
        dockId: dockWithActiveClosureId,
        startTime: activeStart,
        endTime: activeEnd,
        reason: 'Emergency hydraulic lift inspection',
      },
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    // Cleanup
    await prisma.dockClosure.deleteMany({
      where: { dockId: { in: [dockActiveId, dockWithActiveClosureId, dockBaseMaintenanceId] } },
    });
    await prisma.booking.deleteMany({
      where: { dockId: { in: [dockActiveId, dockWithActiveClosureId, dockBaseMaintenanceId] } },
    });
    await prisma.dock.deleteMany({
      where: { id: { in: [dockActiveId, dockWithActiveClosureId, dockBaseMaintenanceId] } },
    });
    await prisma.operatingHour.deleteMany({ where: { warehouseId } });
    await prisma.warehousePolicy.deleteMany({ where: { warehouseId } });
    await prisma.warehouse.deleteMany({ where: { id: warehouseId } });
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({ where: { email: { contains: `dynamic_` } } });
    await prisma.organization.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: [warehouseOrgId, carrierOrgId] } } });
  });

  it('evaluates effectiveStatus in real-time when listing warehouse docks via GET /api/warehouses/:id/docks', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/warehouses/${warehouseId}/docks`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${warehouseAdminToken}`);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(Array.isArray(res.body.data)).toBe(true);

    const dock1 = res.body.data.find((d: any) => d.id === dockActiveId);
    expect(dock1).toBeDefined();
    expect(dock1.status).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(dock1.effectiveStatus).toBe('ACTIVE');

    // Dock 2 has base status ACTIVE in DB, but has an active closure right now -> MUST evaluate to MAINTENANCE
    const dock2 = res.body.data.find((d: any) => d.id === dockWithActiveClosureId);
    expect(dock2).toBeDefined();
    expect(dock2.status).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(dock2.effectiveStatus).toBe('MAINTENANCE');

    // Dock 3 has base status MAINTENANCE in DB -> MUST evaluate to MAINTENANCE
    const dock3 = res.body.data.find((d: any) => d.id === dockBaseMaintenanceId);
    expect(dock3).toBeDefined();
    expect(dock3.status).toBe('MAINTENANCE');
    expect(dock3.effectiveStatus).toBe('MAINTENANCE');
  });

  it('evaluates effectiveStatus directly using dockService.getDockEffectiveStatus helper', async () => {
    const status1 = await dockService.getDockEffectiveStatus(dockActiveId);
    expect(status1.effectiveStatus).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(status1.dock.status).toBe('ACTIVE');

    const status2 = await dockService.getDockEffectiveStatus(dockWithActiveClosureId);
    expect(status2.effectiveStatus).toBe('MAINTENANCE');
    expect(status2.dock.status).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(status2.activeClosure).toBeDefined();
    expect(status2.activeClosure.reason).toBe('Emergency hydraulic lift inspection');

    const status3 = await dockService.getDockEffectiveStatus(dockBaseMaintenanceId);
    expect(status3.effectiveStatus).toBe('MAINTENANCE');
    expect(status3.dock.status).toBe('MAINTENANCE');
  });

  it('slot generation (B1) automatically excludes docks currently undergoing active maintenance', async () => {
    // Generate target date for today in Colombo timezone (Asia/Colombo UTC+5:30)
    const now = new Date();
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Colombo',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
    });
    const targetDate = formatter.format(now);

    const res = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/warehouses/${warehouseId}/slots?targetDate=${targetDate}`)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);

    const dockIdsReturned = res.body.data.map((d: any) => d.dockId);

    // Dock 1 (Active) must have available slots returned
    expect(dockIdsReturned).toContain(dockActiveId);
    const dock1Slots = res.body.data.find((d: any) => d.dockId === dockActiveId);
    expect(dock1Slots.slots.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Dock 2 (currently undergoing maintenance) must be hidden / excluded from active slot generation
    expect(dockIdsReturned).not.toContain(dockWithActiveClosureId);

    // Dock 3 (base MAINTENANCE) must be hidden / excluded from active slot generation
    expect(dockIdsReturned).not.toContain(dockBaseMaintenanceId);
  });

  it('booking creation (B2) rejects booking attempt on a dock currently undergoing maintenance (400 Bad Request)', async () => {
    // Attempt to book Dock 2 while it is in active closure
    const slotStart = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000); // 30 mins from now (inside active closure)
    // Round to nearest 30 mins for slot length alignment
    slotStart.setMinutes(slotStart.getMinutes() >= 30 ? 30 : 0, 0, 0);
    const slotEnd = new Date(slotStart.getTime() + 30 * 60 * 1000);

    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/bookings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
      .send({
        dockId: dockWithActiveClosureId,
        slotStartTime: slotStart.toISOString(),
        slotEndTime: slotEnd.toISOString(),
        truckPlate: 'WP-CAD-8844',
        driverName: 'Saman Perera',
        driverPhone: '+94771234567',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Dock is currently under maintenance and cannot be booked.');
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { DockStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { DockWithEffectiveStatus } from '../models/dock.model';

export class DockService {
  /**
   * Retrieves all docks for a warehouse, fetching active closures in a single query
   * using Prisma's `include` filter to avoid N+1 query bottlenecks, and dynamically
   * evaluating the real-time `effectiveStatus`.
   */
  async getDocksByWarehouse(
    warehouseId: number,
    organizationId?: number,
    isCarrier: boolean = false
  ): Promise<DockWithEffectiveStatus[]> {
    if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
    }

    if (organizationId) {
      const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
        where: { id: warehouseId },
      });

      if (!warehouse) {
        throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
      }

      if (!isCarrier && warehouse.organizationId !== organizationId) {
        throw {
          status: 403,
          message: 'Forbidden. You do not have access to docks for this warehouse.',
        };
      }
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const docks = await prisma.dock.findMany({
      where: { warehouseId },
      include: {
        closures: {
          where: {
            startTime: { lte: now },
            endTime: { gte: now },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
    });

    return docks.map((dock) => {
      const isUnderClosure = dock.closures && dock.closures.length > 0;
      const effectiveStatus = isUnderClosure
        ? 'MAINTENANCE'
        : (dock.status as 'ACTIVE' | 'MAINTENANCE');

      return {
        ...dock,
        effectiveStatus,
      };
    });
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves the real-time dynamic effective status of a specific dock,
   * evaluating active closures at the specified timestamp (defaults to now).
   */
  async getDockEffectiveStatus(
    dockId: number,
    atTime: Date = new Date()
  ): Promise<{
    dock: any;
    effectiveStatus: 'ACTIVE' | 'MAINTENANCE';
    activeClosure?: any;
  }> {
    if (!dockId || isNaN(dockId)) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid dock ID.' };
    }

    const dock = await prisma.dock.findUnique({
      where: { id: dockId },
      include: {
        warehouse: true,
        closures: {
          where: {
            startTime: { lte: atTime },
            endTime: { gte: atTime },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!dock) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'Dock not found.' };
    }

    const activeClosure = dock.closures && dock.closures.length > 0 ? dock.closures[0] : undefined;
    const isUnderMaintenance = !!activeClosure || dock.status === DockStatus.MAINTENANCE;

    return {
      dock,
      effectiveStatus: isUnderMaintenance ? 'MAINTENANCE' : 'ACTIVE',
      activeClosure,
    };
  }
}

export const dockService = new DockService();
export default dockService;

```

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Reviewing the user request to confirm all aspects are addressed. The primary goal centers on optimizing database queries for time-range lookups within the `dock_closures` table. This involves adding a composite index to improve performance. Additionally, ensuring the schema definition is aligned with this index addition is necessary.


Added the composite index to the database schema and confirmed its presence. Next, updated the dock retrieval queries to use a single query with an `include` filter, addressing potential N+1 query issues. This query now fetches active closures, determining the `effectiveStatus` (MAINTENANCE if a closure exists, otherwise the base status) for each dock.

The slot generation and booking processes are updated to respect the `effectiveStatus` of each dock. This ensures that docks under maintenance are excluded from available slots and unavailable for booking.
</details></think>

Optimized, real-time dynamic dock status evaluation has been implemented across the database, backend services, booking enforcement logic, frontend dashboards, and OpenAPI documentation.

---

### Implementation Details

#### 1. Database Index Optimization
- **Prisma Schema ([`backend/prisma/schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma#L113-L126))**: Added composite index:
  ```prisma
  model DockClosure {
    // ...
    @@index([dockId])
    @@index([dockId, startTime, endTime], map: "dock_closures_active_check_idx")
    @@map("dock_closures")
  }
  ```
- **MySQL Execution**: Applied composite index `dock_closures_active_check_idx` on `(dockId, startTime, endTime)` to optimize time-range lookups and verified it in database index metadata.

---

#### 2. Real-Time Effective Status Service Logic
- **Dock Service ([`backend/src/services/dock.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/dock.service.ts))**:
  - Implemented [`getDocksByWarehouse`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/dock.service.ts#L16): Executes a single query with Prisma's `include` filter to fetch active closures covering `now()` (`startTime <= now <= endTime`), avoiding N+1 queries.
  - Dynamically computes `effectiveStatus`: returns `'MAINTENANCE'` if active closures exist or base database `status === 'MAINTENANCE'`, otherwise `'ACTIVE'`.
  - Implemented [`getDockEffectiveStatus`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/dock.service.ts#L67) for point-in-time dynamic status evaluation of individual dock bays.
- **Warehouse Service ([`backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts))**:
  - [`getDocks`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L457): Delegates to `dockService.getDocksByWarehouse`.
  - [`getWarehouses`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L135) & [`getWarehouseById`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L190): Fetch docks with active closures at `now()` and map `effectiveStatus`.
  - [`updateDockStatus`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L465) & [`updateDock`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L525): Return `effectiveStatus` in the response payload.

---

#### 3. Slot Search & Booking Enforcement
- **Slot Availability Engine (`B1`) ([`backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L765-L786))**:
  - In [`getAvailableSlots`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L735), evaluates effective dock statuses against `now()` and active `DockClosure` records.
  - Automatically excludes any dock currently undergoing maintenance (`effectiveStatus === 'MAINTENANCE'`), hiding its slots without requiring background worker tasks.
- **Booking Creation & Reschedule (`B2`) ([`backend/src/services/booking.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/booking.service.ts#L110-L135))**:
  - In [`createBooking`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/booking.service.ts#L85) and [`rescheduleBooking`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/booking.service.ts#L295), dynamically checks if the dock has an active maintenance closure at `now()`.
  - Rejects with `400 Bad Request` (`"Dock is currently under maintenance and cannot be booked."`) if the dock is currently undergoing maintenance.
  - Preserves checks rejecting bookings if the requested future slot overlaps a scheduled maintenance closure (`"The requested dock slot is unavailable due to scheduled dock maintenance."`).

---

#### 4. Frontend Dock Management UI
- **Type Definitions ([`frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/types/warehouse.types.ts#L7-L15))**: Added `effectiveStatus?: DockStatus;` to the `Dock` interface.
- **Warehouse Admin Dashboard ([`frontend/src/pages/WarehouseAdminDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/WarehouseAdminDashboard.tsx#L782-L806))**:
  - Updated dock list status badges to reflect `effectiveStatus`.
  - When a dock has base `status: ACTIVE` but is in an active closure window, displays a **"Maintenance"** badge with an `"Active Closure"` pulsing tag.
- **Dock Manager Dashboard ([`frontend/src/pages/DockManagerDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DockManagerDashboard.tsx#L628-L665))**:
  - Updated dock cards and modal dropdown to calculate real-time closure status and show **"Maintenance"** badge during active closure periods.

---

#### 5. OpenAPI Specification
- **[`open-api.json`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/open-api.json#L494-L535)**: Updated `GET /warehouses/{warehouseId}/docks` documentation and response schema to specify `effectiveStatus`.
- **[`backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/warehouse.routes.ts#L426-L445)**: Updated route OpenAPI JSDoc.

```text
55: export class InvitationService {
56:   /**
57:    * Helper to issue a signed JWT token containing user ID, organization ID, and role.
58:    */
59:   public generateToken(
60:     user: { id: number; organizationId: number; role: UserRole; email: string },
61:     tokenVersion: number = 0
62:   ): string {
63:     return jwt.sign(
64:       {
65:         userId: user.id,
66:         organizationId: user.organizationId,
67:         role: user.role,
68:         email: user.email,
69:         tokenVersion,
70:       },
71:       securityConfig.jwtSecret,
72:       { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn as any }
73:     );
74:   }
75: 
76:   /**
77:    * Create or refresh an invitation for a new team member.
78:    * - Restricted strictly to CARRIER_ADMIN or WAREHOUSE_ADMIN.
79:    * - CARRIER_ADMIN -> "DISPATCHER"
80:    * - WAREHOUSE_ADMIN -> "DOCK_MANAGER"
81:    * - Token expiration: 48 hours
82:    * - Rejects if email belongs to an existing user (409 Conflict)
83:    */
84:   public async createInvitation(
85:     requester: RequesterContext,
86:     input: CreateInvitationInput
87:   ): Promise<InvitationResponse> {
88:     const { email } = input;
89: 
90:     if (!email || typeof email !== 'string') {
91:       throw { status: 400, message: 'A valid email address is required.' };
92:     }
93: 
94:     const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
95:     const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
96:     if (!emailRegex.test(normalizedEmail)) {
97:       throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid email address format.' };
98:     }
99: 
100:     // Role mapping
101:     let targetRole: string;
102:     if (requester.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN') {
103:       targetRole = 'DISPATCHER';
104:     } else if (requester.role === 'WAREHOUSE_ADMIN') {
105:       targetRole = 'DOCK_MANAGER';
106:     } else {
107:       throw {
108:         status: 403,
109:         message: `Forbidden. Role '${requester.role}' cannot invite users. Only CARRIER_ADMIN and WAREHOUSE_ADMIN are authorized.`,
110:       };
111:     }
112: 
113:     // Check if user already exists
114:     const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
115:       where: { email: normalizedEmail },
116:     });
117: 
118:     if (existingUser) {
119:       throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
120:     }
121: 
122:     // Verify requester organization exists
123:     const organization = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
124:       where: { id: requester.organizationId },
125:     });
126: 
127:     if (!organization) {
128:       throw { status: 404, message: 'Requester organization not found.' };
129:     }
130: 
131:     // Generate secure random token and 48-hour expiration
132:     const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
133:     const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 48 hours
134: 
135:     // Upsert invitation record (handles fresh invites and resends)
136:     const invitation = await prisma.invitation.upsert({
137:       where: { email: normalizedEmail },
138:       create: {
139:         email: normalizedEmail,
140:         organizationId: requester.organizationId,
141:         role: targetRole,
142:         token,
143:         expiresAt,
144:         status: 'PENDING',
145:       },
146:       update: {
147:         organizationId: requester.organizationId,
148:         role: targetRole,
149:         token,
150:         expiresAt,
151:         status: 'PENDING',
152:       },
153:     });
154: 
155:     // Send invitation email asynchronously
156:     emailService
157:       .sendInvitationEmail(normalizedEmail, organization.name, targetRole, token)
158:       .catch((err) => {
159:         console.error('[InvitationService] Failed to dispatch invitation email:', err);
160:       });
161: 
162:     return {
163:       invitation,
164:       message: `Invitation successfully created for ${normalizedEmail} as ${targetRole}.`,
165:     };
166:   }
167: 
168:   /**
169:    * Accept an invitation and create user account.
170:    */
171:   public async acceptInvitation(input: AcceptInvitationInput): Promise<AcceptInvitationResponse> {
172:     const { token, [REDACTED:generic-password] } = input;
173: 
174:     if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
175:       throw { status: 400, message: 'Invitation token is required.' };
176:     }
177: 
178:     if (![REDACTED:generic-password] || typeof [REDACTED:generic-password] !== 'string' || [REDACTED:generic-password].length < 6) {
179:       throw { status: 400, message: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.' };
180:     }
181: 
182:     const invitation = await prisma.invitation.findUnique({
183:       where: { token },
184:       include: { organization: true },
185:     });
186: 
187:     if (!invitation) {
188:       throw { status: 404, message: 'Invalid or non-existent invitation token.' };
189:     }
190: 
191:     if (invitation.status !== 'PENDING') {
192:       throw { status: 400, message: `Invitation cannot be accepted. Current status is ${invitation.status}.` };
193:     }
194: 
195:     if (new Date(invitation.expiresAt) <= new Date()) {
196:       await prisma.invitation.update({
197:         where: { id: invitation.id },
198:         data: { status: 'EXPIRED' },
199:       }).catch(() => {});
200:       throw { status: 400, message: 'Invitation token has expired.' };
201:     }
202: 
203:     // Check if user with this email already exists
204:     const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
205:       where: { email: invitation.email },
206:     });
207: 
208:     if (existingUser) {
209:       throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
210:     }
211: 
212:     const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash([REDACTED:generic-password], securityConfig.saltRounds);
213: 
214:     const { user, organization } = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
215:       const newUser = await tx.user.create({
216:         data: {
217:           email: invitation.email,

229:       });

235:     const tokenVersion = version !== null ? parseInt(version, 10) : 0;
```

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Lock,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  X,
  ArrowRight,
  UserCheck,
  Building,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from './ui/button';
import { Input } from './ui/input';
import { Label } from './ui/label';
import { authApi } from '../api/auth.api';

export interface UserRegisterModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  token?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (registeredEmail?: string, message?: string) => void;
}

export const UserRegisterModal: React.FC<UserRegisterModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  token: propToken,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}) => {
  // Extract token from props or URL (?token=...)
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string>(propToken || '');
  const [[REDACTED:generic-password], setPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Invitation info
  const [invitationInfo, setInvitationInfo] = useState<{
    email: string;
    role: string;
    organizationName?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isVerifyingToken, setIsVerifyingToken] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Sync token from URL or props
  useEffect(() => {
    let activeToken = propToken || '';
    if (!activeToken && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      activeToken = searchParams.get('token') || '';
    }
    setToken(activeToken);

    if (isOpen && activeToken) {
      // Fetch invitation details to present context to user
      setIsVerifyingToken(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);
      authApi
        .getInvitationDetails(activeToken)
        .then((res) => {
          if (res?.data) {
            setInvitationInfo(res.data);
          }
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          const msg =
            err.response?.data?.message ||
            err.message ||
            'The invitation token is invalid or has expired.';
          setErrorMessage(msg);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          setIsVerifyingToken(false);
        });
    } else {
      setInvitationInfo(null);
    }

    if (isOpen) {
      setPassword('');
      setConfirmPassword('');
      setSuccessMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, propToken]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const activeToken =
      token.trim() ||
      (typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('token') || ''
        : '');

    if (!activeToken) {
      setErrorMessage(
        'Missing invitation token. Please ensure you clicked the full link from your invitation email.'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter a [REDACTED:generic-password].');
      return;
    }

    if ([REDACTED:generic-password].length < 6) {
      setErrorMessage('Password must be at least 6 characters long.');
      return;
    }

    if ([REDACTED:generic-password] !== confirmPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Passwords do not match. Please verify both fields.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const res = await authApi.acceptInvite(activeToken, [REDACTED:generic-password]);

      const msg =
        res.message || 'Account registered successfully! Redirecting to sign in...';
      setSuccessMessage(msg);

      // Brief delay to display the success confirmation, then redirect
      setTimeout(() => {
        onSuccess(
          invitationInfo?.email || res.user?.email,
          'Account created successfully! Please sign in with your [REDACTED:generic-password].'
        );
      }, 700);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const serverMessage =
        err.response?.data?.message ||
        err.message ||
        'Failed to complete registration. The invitation link may be invalid or expired.';
      setErrorMessage(serverMessage);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full overflow-hidden border border-gray-200 animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="p-1.5 bg-white/10 rounded-md">
              <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold tracking-tight">Complete User Registration</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-300">Set your [REDACTED:generic-password] to activate your account</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-gray-300 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
            title="Close and return to Sign In"
            type="button"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-4">
          {/* Organization & Role Badge (if fetched) */}
          {invitationInfo && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-gray-700 font-semibold">
                <Building className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                <span>{invitationInfo.organizationName || 'DockSlot Workspace'}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-gray-600">
                Registering account for <strong className="text-gray-900">{invitationInfo.email}</strong> as{' '}
                <span className="inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-[#2F4F4F]/10 text-[#2F4F4F] rounded font-medium">
                  {invitationInfo.role}
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Missing Token Alert */}
          {!token && (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 rounded-lg text-xs flex items-start space-x-2"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="flex-1">
                <strong>No invitation token found.</strong> Please make sure you accessed this page from the link in your invitation email.
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error Message */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 rounded-lg text-xs flex items-start space-x-2 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span className="flex-1 font-medium">{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Success Message */}
          {successMessage && (
            <div
              role="status"
              className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 rounded-lg text-xs flex items-center space-x-2 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
              <span className="flex-1 font-medium">{successMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Registration Form with Two Fields: Enter Password and Re-enter Password */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
            {/* Field 1: Enter Password */}
            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="register-[REDACTED:generic-password]-field" required>
                Enter Password
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="register-[REDACTED:generic-password]-field"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : '[REDACTED:generic-password]'}
                autoComplete="new-[REDACTED:generic-password]"
                required
                placeholder="Enter [REDACTED:generic-password]"
                icon={<Lock className="w-4 h-4" />}
                value={[REDACTED:generic-password]}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isLoading || isVerifyingToken}
                rightElement={
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide [REDACTED:generic-password]' : '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]'}
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                    className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </button>
                }
              />
              <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5 block">
                Must be at least 6 characters long
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Field 2: Re-enter Password */}
            <div>
              <Label htmlFor="register-confirm-[REDACTED:generic-password]-field" required>
                Re-enter Password
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="register-confirm-[REDACTED:generic-password]-field"
                type={showConfirmPassword ? 'text' : '[REDACTED:generic-password]'}
                autoComplete="new-[REDACTED:generic-password]"
                required
                placeholder="Re-enter [REDACTED:generic-password]"
                icon={<Lock className="w-4 h-4" />}
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isLoading || isVerifyingToken}
                rightElement={
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={showConfirmPassword ? 'Hide [REDACTED:generic-password]' : '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]'}
                    onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(!showConfirmPassword)}
                    className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {showConfirmPassword ? (
                      <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" />
                    ) : (
                      <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                }
              />
            </div>

            {/* Actions */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isLoading}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                variant="primary"
                isLoading={isLoading || isVerifyingToken}
              >
                <span>Register Account</span>
                {!isLoading && !isVerifyingToken && (
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1.5" />
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UserRegisterModal;

```

```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Truck,
  Users,
  UserPlus,
  UserX,
  UserCheck,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  X,
  Building2,
  CalendarCheck,
  ShieldCheck,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Mail,
  Shield,
  Layers,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { userApi } from '../api/user.api';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { DispatcherDashboard } from './DispatcherDashboard';
import type { User } from '../types/user.types';

export const CarrierAdminDashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  // Active Tab: 'users' | 'dispatch' | 'profile'
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'users' | 'dispatch' | 'profile'>('users');

  // User Management State
  const [organizationUsers, setOrganizationUsers] = useState<User[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingUsers, setIsLoadingUsers] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [deactivatingUserId, setDeactivatingUserId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [reactivatingUserId, setReactivatingUserId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Invite Modal State
  const [isInviteModalOpen, setIsInviteModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [inviteEmail, setInviteEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [isSendingInvite, setIsSendingInvite] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Filter & Search State
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState<string>('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'ACTIVE' | 'DEACTIVATED'>('ALL');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'CARRIER_ADMIN' | 'DISPATCHER'>('ALL');

  // Notifications / Banners
  const [errorBanner, setErrorBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successBanner, setSuccessBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const triggerSuccess = (msg: string) => {
    setSuccessBanner(msg);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSuccessBanner(null);
    }, 4500);
  };

  // Fetch Users belonging to the carrier organization
  const fetchUsers = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoadingUsers(true);
    setErrorBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await userApi.getUsers();
      if (res?.data) {
        setOrganizationUsers(res.data);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorBanner(
        err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to load organization team members.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingUsers(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUsers();
  }, [fetchUsers]);

  // Invite Dispatcher / Staff Handler
  const handleInviteUser = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!inviteEmail.trim()) return;

    setIsSendingInvite(true);
    setErrorBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await userApi.inviteUser({ email: inviteEmail.trim() });
      triggerSuccess(res.message || `Invitation successfully sent to ${inviteEmail}.`);
      setInviteEmail('');
      setIsInviteModalOpen(false);
      await fetchUsers();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorBanner(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to send invitation.');
    } finally {
      setIsSendingInvite(false);
    }
  };

  // Deactivate User Handler
  const handleDeactivateUser = async (targetUser: User) => {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to deactivate ${targetUser.email}? Their active sessions will be terminated immediately via Redis token revocation.`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setDeactivatingUserId(targetUser.id);
    setErrorBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await userApi.deactivateUser(targetUser.id);
      triggerSuccess(res.message || `User ${targetUser.email} has been deactivated.`);
      await fetchUsers();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorBanner(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to deactivate user.');
    } finally {
      setDeactivatingUserId(null);
    }
  };

  // Reactivate User Handler
  const handleReactivateUser = async (targetUser: User) => {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to reactivate ${targetUser.email}? They will be permitted to log in and resume booking activities.`
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setReactivatingUserId(targetUser.id);
    setErrorBanner(null);
    try {
      const res = await userApi.reactivateUser(targetUser.id);
      triggerSuccess(res.message || `User ${targetUser.email} has been reactivated.`);
      await fetchUsers();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorBanner(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to reactivate user.');
    } finally {
      setReactivatingUserId(null);
    }
  };

  // Filtered Users List
  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    return organizationUsers.filter((u) => {
      // Search
      const matchesSearch =
        u.email.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        u.role.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

      // Status Filter
      const isDeactivated = u.isActive === false;
      const matchesStatus =
        statusFilter === 'ALL'
          ? true
          : statusFilter === 'ACTIVE'
          ? !isDeactivated
          : isDeactivated;

      // Role Filter
      const matchesRole =
        roleFilter === 'ALL' ? true : u.role === roleFilter;

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && matchesRole;
    });
  }, [organizationUsers, searchTerm, statusFilter, roleFilter]);

  // Statistics Cards
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = organizationUsers.length;
    const active = organizationUsers.filter((u) => u.isActive !== false).length;
    const deactivated = organizationUsers.filter((u) => u.isActive === false).length;
    const dispatchers = organizationUsers.filter((u) => u.role === 'DISPATCHER').length;
    const admins = organizationUsers.filter((u) => u.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN').length;
    return { total, active, deactivated, dispatchers, admins };
  }, [organizationUsers]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 p-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 bg-[#2F4F4F]/10 rounded-lg">
              <Truck className="w-6 h-6 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
                Carrier Admin Management
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                Manage organization dispatchers, fleet personnel access, and live warehouse dock scheduling.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsInviteModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors"
          >
            <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Invite Dispatcher</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={fetchUsers}
            disabled={isLoadingUsers}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
            title="Refresh organization team list"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoadingUsers ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Refresh</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Global Alerts */}
      {errorBanner && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorBanner}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setErrorBanner(null)} className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {successBanner && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
            <span>{successBanner}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setSuccessBanner(null)} className="text-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-700">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-gray-200 bg-white rounded-t-xl px-4 pt-2 shadow-sm space-x-1 overflow-x-auto">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('users')}
          className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-bold border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
            activeTab === 'users'
              ? 'border-[#2F4F4F] text-[#2F4F4F]'
              : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
          }`}
        >
          <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>User Management</span>
          <span
            className={`ml-1 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
              activeTab === 'users'
                ? 'bg-[#2F4F4F]/10 text-[#2F4F4F]'
                : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
            }`}
          >
            {stats.total}
          </span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('dispatch')}
          className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-bold border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
            activeTab === 'dispatch'
              ? 'border-[#2F4F4F] text-[#2F4F4F]'
              : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
          }`}
        >
          <CalendarCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Dispatch & Bookings Console</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('profile')}
          className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-bold border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
            activeTab === 'profile'
              ? 'border-[#2F4F4F] text-[#2F4F4F]'
              : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
          }`}
        >
          <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Carrier Profile & Organization</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab Content 1: User Management */}
      {activeTab === 'users' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-b-xl shadow-sm border border-t-0 border-gray-200 p-6 space-y-6">
          {/* Quick Stats Grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Total Team Members
              </span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1 block">
                {stats.total}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Active Dispatchers
              </span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-800 mt-1 block">
                {stats.dispatchers}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Carrier Admins
              </span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-800 mt-1 block">
                {stats.admins}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-700 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Deactivated Accounts
              </span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-800 mt-1 block">
                {stats.deactivated}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section Header & Search / Filters */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                <span>Organization Members & Access Control</span>
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                Invite new dispatchers, monitor active accounts, and revoke credentials instantly using Redis token invalidation.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {/* Search Bar */}
              <div className="relative">

                <input

                  placeholder="Search by email..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Status Filter */}
              <select
                value={statusFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value as any)}

              >
                <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
                <option value="ACTIVE">Active Only</option>
                <option value="DEACTIVATED">Deactivated Only</option>
              </select>

              {/* Role Filter */}
              <select
                value={roleFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setRoleFilter(e.target.value as any)}
                className="py-1.5 px-3 text-xs bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Roles</option>
                <option value="CARRIER_ADMIN">Carrier Admins</option>
                <option value="DISPATCHER">Dispatchers</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* User List */}
          {isLoadingUsers ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center text-xs text-gray-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto text-gray-400 mb-2" />
              Loading carrier organization members...
            </div>
          ) : filteredUsers.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200">
              {organizationUsers.length === 0
                ? 'No organization users found.'
                : 'No users match your search and filter criteria.'}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden divide-y divide-gray-100">
              {filteredUsers.map((u) => {
                const isDeactivated = u.isActive === false;
                const isSelf = u.id === user?.id;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={u.id}
                    className="p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:bg-gray-50/70 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                      <div
                        className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold ${
                          isDeactivated
                            ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'
                            : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {u.email.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900">{u.email}</span>
                          {isSelf && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                              You
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mt-0.5">
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500">
                            {u.role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN' ? 'Carrier Admin' : 'Dispatcher'}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-gray-300">•</span>
                          <span
                            className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center space-x-1 ${
                              isDeactivated
                                ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200'
                                : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isDeactivated ? (
                              <>
                                <UserX className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                <span>Deactivated</span>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                <UserCheck className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                <span>Active</span>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Actions */}
                    <div>
                      {isSelf ? (
                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">Current Session</span>
                      ) : isDeactivated ? (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleReactivateUser(u)}
                          disabled={reactivatingUserId === u.id}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 hover:bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center space-x-1 disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                          {reactivatingUserId === u.id ? (
                            <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            <UserCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                          )}
                          <span>Reactivate</span>
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeactivateUser(u)}
                          disabled={deactivatingUserId === u.id}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 hover:text-red-700 border border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center space-x-1 disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                          {deactivatingUserId === u.id ? (
                            <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            <UserX className="w-3 h-3" />
                          )}
                          <span>Deactivate</span>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab Content 2: Live Dispatcher Operations */}
      {activeTab === 'dispatch' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-b-xl shadow-sm border border-t-0 border-gray-200 p-6">
          <DispatcherDashboard />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab Content 3: Carrier Organization Profile */}
      {activeTab === 'profile' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-b-xl shadow-sm border border-t-0 border-gray-200 p-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="border-b pb-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
              <span>Carrier Fleet & Organization Profile</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
              Review company details and security settings for this carrier workspace.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="p-5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center space-x-2">
                <Truck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                <span>Organization Details</span>
              </h4>

              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-gray-200">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Company Name:</span>
                  <strong className="text-gray-900">{user?.organization?.name || 'Carrier Fleet'}</strong>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-gray-200">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Organization Type:</span>
                  <span className="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#2F4F4F]/10 text-[#2F4F4F] font-bold rounded">
                    CARRIER
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-gray-200">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Administrator:</span>
                  <span className="text-gray-800">{user?.email}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
                  <span className="text-gray-500">Default Invite Role:</span>
                  <span className="text-emerald-700 font-semibold">DISPATCHER</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center space-x-2">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
                <span>Access & Security Architecture</span>
              </h4>

              <ul className="text-xs text-gray-600 space-y-2 leading-relaxed">
                <li className="flex items-start space-x-2">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#2F4F4F] mt-1.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span>
                    <strong>Redis Session Termination:</strong> Deactivating an account increments the token version in Redis, instantly invalidating active JWTs across all devices.
                  </span>
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-start space-x-2">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#2F4F4F] mt-1.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span>
                    <strong>Strict Multi-Tenant Isolation:</strong> Dispatchers can only manage bookings and loads bound to your carrier organization.
                  </span>
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-start space-x-2">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#2F4F4F] mt-1.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span>
                    <strong>Invitation Expiry:</strong> Secure 32-byte tokens expire after 48 hours to prevent unauthorized account creation.
                  </span>
                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal: Invite Team Member */}
      {isInviteModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl max-w-sm w-full overflow-hidden animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center space-x-2">
                <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>Invite Team Member</span>
              </h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsInviteModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-gray-300 hover:text-white"
                type="button"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleInviteUser} className="p-6 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="carrier-invite-email" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Team Member Email Address
                </label>
                <input
                  id="carrier-invite-email"
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="dispatcher@swiftlogistics.com"
                  value={inviteEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setInviteEmail(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F] focus:outline-none"
                />
                <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  Invited users to a Carrier organization will automatically be designated the{' '}
                  <strong>DISPATCHER</strong> role.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end space-x-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsInviteModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSendingInvite}
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-[#2F4F4F] hover:bg-[#1E3333] disabled:opacity-50 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center space-x-1.5"
                >
                  {isSendingInvite && <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />}
                  <span>Send Invitation</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { CarrierAdminDashboard } from './CarrierAdminDashboard';
import { DispatcherDashboard } from './DispatcherDashboard';
import { Settings, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';

export const CarrierDashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'admin' | 'operations'>('admin');

  // If user is a standard DISPATCHER, render DispatcherDashboard directly
  if (user?.role === 'DISPATCHER') {
    return <DispatcherDashboard />;
  }

  // If user is CARRIER_ADMIN, render CarrierAdminDashboard with view switcher
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* View Switcher Sub-header for Carrier Admins */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-2.5 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 pl-2">
            Carrier View:
          </span>
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-md shadow-sm">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode('admin')}
              className={`inline-flex items-center px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-l-md text-xs font-medium border transition-colors ${
                viewMode === 'admin'
                  ? 'bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white border-[#2F4F4F]'
                  : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50'
              }`}
            >
              <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              Carrier Administration Console
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode('operations')}
              className={`inline-flex items-center px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-r-md text-xs font-medium border-t border-b border-r transition-colors ${
                viewMode === 'operations'
                  ? 'bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white border-[#2F4F4F]'
                  : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50'
              }`}
            >
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              Live Yard Dispatch & Bookings
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 hidden sm:block pr-2">
          {viewMode === 'admin'
            ? 'Manage carrier dispatchers, access credentials & organization profile'
            : 'Search available warehouse slots and manage dock appointments'}
        </div>
      </div>

      {viewMode === 'admin' ? <CarrierAdminDashboard /> : <DispatcherDashboard />}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CarrierDashboard;

```

   - **Tab 1: User Management**:
     - **Organization Summary Cards**: Displays metrics for Total Team Members, Active Dispatchers, Carrier Admins, and Deactivated Accounts.
     - **Search & Filters**: Search users by email or role, and filter by status (`Active`, `Deactivated`) and role (`CARRIER_ADMIN`, `DISPATCHER`).
     - **Member Table**: Displays user avatars, email, role badge, active/deactivated status badge, and self identifier (`You`).
     - **Instant Account Deactivation**: Calls [`userApi.deactivateUser`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/user.api.ts#L20), terminating all active user JWT sessions immediately via Redis token invalidation.
     - **Account Reactivation**: Calls [`userApi.reactivateUser`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/api/user.api.ts#L25) to restore platform access.
     - **Invite Dispatcher Modal**: Allows inviting new team members by email. Any user invited to a carrier organization is automatically assigned the `DISPATCHER` role.
   - **Tab 2: Dispatch & Bookings Console**:
     - Directly integrates [`DispatcherDashboard`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx) so Carrier Admins can seamlessly search warehouse slots, manage dock appointments, and review bookings without logging into a separate account.
   - **Tab 3: Carrier Profile & Security**:

```diff
+    try {
+      const tz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || "Local";
+      const offsetMinutes = -new Date().getTimezoneOffset();
+      const sign = offsetMinutes >= 0 ? "+" : "-";
+      const absMinutes = Math.abs(offsetMinutes);
+      const hours = String(Math.floor(absMinutes / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
+      const mins = String(absMinutes % 60).padStart(2, "0");
+      return `${tz} (UTC${sign}${hours}:${mins})`;
+    } catch {
+      return "UTC";
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  // Format IANA timezone string with UTC offset
+  const formatTimezoneLabel = useCallback((tz?: string): string => {
+    if (!tz) return "UTC";
+    try {
+      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
+        timeZone: tz,
+        timeZoneName: "shortOffset",
+      }).formatToParts(new Date());
+      const offsetPart = parts.find((p) => p.type === "timeZoneName")?.value;
+      if (offsetPart && offsetPart !== tz) {
+        return `${tz} (${offsetPart.replace("GMT", "UTC")})`;
+      }
+      return tz;
+    } catch {
+      return tz;
+    }
+  }, []);
```

```text
961:                 type="submit"

974:           {isSearchingSlots ? (

977:               <p className="text-xs font-medium">
978:                 Querying warehouse schedule and calculating available slots...
979:               </p>

998:               {totalSlotsCount === 0 ? (

1012:                   {searchedSlots.map((dockGroup) => (

1015:                       className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 bg-gray-50/50 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"

1018:                         <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
1019:                           <WarehouseIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />

1021:                             {dockGroup.dockName}
1022:                           </h4>
1023:                         </div>
1024:                         <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
1025:                           {dockGroup.slots.length} available
1026:                         </span>
1027:                       </div>
1028: 
1029:                       {dockGroup.slots.length === 0 ? (
1030:                         <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic py-2">
1031:                           No open intervals
1032:                         </p>
1033:                       ) : (
1034:                         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
1035:                           {dockGroup.slots.map((slot, index) => {
1036:                             const timeLabel = `${formatDateTime(
1037:                               slot.slotStartTime,
1038:                               "h:mm a",
1039:                             )} - ${formatDateTime(slot.slotEndTime, "h:mm a")}`;
1040: 
1041:                             return (
1042:                               <button
1043:                                 key={`${dockGroup.dockId}-${slot.slotStartTime}-${index}`}
1044:                                 type="button"
1045:                                 onClick={() =>
1046:                                   handleOpenBookingModal(
1047:                                     {
1048:                                       id: dockGroup.dockId,
1049:                                       name: dockGroup.dockName,
1050:                                     },
1051:                                     slot,
1052:                                   )
1053:                                 }
1054:                                 className="group flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-[#2F4F4F] hover:bg-[#2F4F4F] hover:text-white transition-all shadow-xs text-center"
1055:                               >
1056:                                 <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-white">
1057:                                   {timeLabel}
1058:                                 </span>
1059:                                 <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gray-200 mt-0.5 flex items-center space-x-0.5">
1060:                                   <span>Book</span>
1061:                                   <ArrowRight className="w-2.5 h-2.5 ml-0.5" />
1062:                                 </span>
1063:                               </button>
1064:                             );
1065:                           })}
1066:                         </div>
1067:                       )}
1068:                     </div>
1069:                   ))}
1070:                 </div>
1071:               )}
1072:             </div>
1073:           ) : (
1074:             <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-gray-400 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
1075:               Select your warehouse and date above, then click{" "}
1076:               <strong>"Find Free Slots"</strong> to view available booking
1077:               intervals.
1078:             </div>
1079:           )}
1080:         </CardContent>
1081:       </Card>
```
