1083:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
1084:       {/* SECTION 2: Carrier Bookings Management Table                              */}
1085:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
1086:       <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
1087:         <CardHeader className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4">
1088:           <div>
1089:             <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
1090:               <CalendarCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
1091:               <span>Carrier Bookings Management</span>
1092:             </CardTitle>
1093:             <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
1094:               Review, reschedule, or cancel active appointments for your fleet.
1095:             </p>
1096:           </div>
1097: 
1098:           <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-md text-gray-700 self-start md:self-auto">
1099:             {filteredBookings.length} of {bookings.length} Bookings
1100:           </span>
1101:         </CardHeader>
1102: 
1103:         <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
1104:           {/* Table Filters & Search Bar */}
1105:           <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between">

1117:                   onClick={() => setBookingSearchQuery("")}
1118:                   className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
1119:                 >
1120:                   <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
1121:                 </button>
1122:               )}
1123:             </div>
1124: 
1125:             {/* Status Tabs */}
1126:             <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:pb-0">
1127:               {[
1128:                 "ALL",

1130:                 "ARRIVED",

1149:

1154:               <p className="text-xs font-medium">Loading carrier bookings...</p>
1155:             </div>

1164:                   ? "Your organization has not created any bookings yet. Search for open slots above to book."
1165:                   : "No bookings match your selected search or status filters."}
1166:               </p>
1167:             </div>
1168:           ) : (
1169:             <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
1170:               <table className="w-full text-left text-xs divide-y divide-gray-200">

1177:                       Warehouse & Dock

1183:                       Vehicle (Truck)

1186:                       Driver Info
1187:                     </th>
1188:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1189:                       Cargo Note
1190:                     </th>
1191:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1192:                       Status
1193:                     </th>
1194:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
1195:                       Actions
1196:                     </th>
1197:                   </tr>
1198:                 </thead>
1199:                 <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
1200:                   {filteredBookings.map((b) => {

1202:

1220:                             <span>{b.dock?.name || `Dock #${b.dockId}`}</span>

1228:                           </div>

1230:                             {formatDateTime(b.slotStartTime, "h:mm a")} –{" "}
1231:                             {formatDateTime(b.slotEndTime, "h:mm a")}
1232:                           </div>

1239:                             {b.truckPlate || "N/A"}
1240:                           </div>
1241:                         </td>
1242: 
1243:                         {/* Driver */}

1249:                           {b.driverPhone && (
1250:                             <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 mt-0.5">
1251:                               <Phone className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-gray-400" />
1252:                               <span>{b.driverPhone}</span>
1253:                             </div>
1254:                           )}
1255:                         </td>
1256: 
1257:                         {/* Cargo Note */}
1258:                         <td
1259:                           className="px-4 py-3 max-w-[180px] truncate"
1260:                           title={b.cargoNote || ""}
1261:                         >
1262:                           {b.cargoNote ? (
1263:                             <span className="text-gray-700 flex items-center space-x-1">
1264:                               <FileText className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
1265:                               <span className="truncate">{b.cargoNote}</span>
1266:                             </span>
1267:                           ) : (
1268:                             <span className="text-gray-400 italic">—</span>
1269:                           )}
1270:                         </td>
1271: 
1272:                         {/* Status */}
1273:                         <td className="px-4 py-3">
1274:                           {renderStatusBadge(b.status)}
1275:                         </td>
1276: 
1277:                         {/* Actions */}
1278:                         <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
1279:                           <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-1.5">
1280:                             {isActionable ? (
1281:                               <>
1282:                                 {(() => {
1283:                                   const insideLock = isInsideLockWindow(b);
1284:                                   return (
1285:                                     <>
1286:                                       <Button
1287:                                         variant="outline"
1288:                                         size="sm"
1289:                                         onClick={() =>
1290:                                           handleOpenRescheduleModal(b)
1291:                                         }
1292:                                         className={`h-7 text-xs px-2.5 flex items-center space-x-1 ${
1293:                                           insideLock
1294:                                             ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 font-semibold"
1295:                                             : "border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
1296:                                         }`}
1297:                                         title={
1298:                                           insideLock
1299:                                             ? "Emergency same-day rescheduling (within 24-hour lock window)"
1300:                                             : "Reschedule booking"
1301:                                         }
1302:                                       >
1303:                                         <RotateCcw
1304:                                           className={`w-3 h-3 ${insideLock ? "text-amber-600" : "text-[#2F4F4F]"}`}
1305:                                         />
1306:                                         <span>
1307:                                           {insideLock
1308:                                             ? "Emergency Reschedule"
1309:                                             : "Reschedule"}
1310:                                         </span>
1311:                                       </Button>
1312: 
1313:                                       <Button
1314:                                         variant="outline"
1315:                                         size="sm"
1316:                                         onClick={() => handleOpenCancelModal(b)}
1317:                                         disabled={insideLock}
1318:                                         className={`h-7 text-xs px-2.5 flex items-center space-x-1 ${
1319:                                           insideLock
1320:                                             ? "border-gray-200 text-gray-400 bg-gray-50 cursor-not-allowed opacity-60"
1321:                                             : "border-rose-200 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50"
1322:                                         }`}
1323:                                         title={
1324:                                           insideLock
1325:                                             ? "Cancellations locked within 24 hours of arrival under warehouse policy"
1326:                                             : "Cancel booking"
1327:                                         }
1328:                                       >
1329:                                         <X
1330:                                           className={`w-3 h-3 ${insideLock ? "text-gray-400" : "text-rose-600"}`}
1331:                                         />
1332:                                         <span>Cancel</span>
1333:                                       </Button>
1334:                                     </>
1335:                                   );
1336:                                 })()}
1337:                               </>
1338:                             ) : (
1339:                               <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 italic">
1340:                                 Locked
1341:                               </span>
1342:                             )}
1343:                           </div>
1344:                         </td>
1345:                       </tr>
1346:                     );
1347:                   })}
1348:                 </tbody>
1349:               </table>
1350:             </div>
1351:           )}
1352:         </CardContent>
1353:       </Card>

1355:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
1356:       {/* MODAL 1: Create Booking Modal                                             */}
1357:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
1358:       {isBookingModalOpen && selectedSlotForBooking && (

1361:             {/* Modal Header */}
1362:             <div className="bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">

1366:                   Book Warehouse Dock Slot
1367:                 </h3>
1368:               </div>
1369:               <button
1370:                 type="button"
1371:                 onClick={() => setIsBookingModalOpen(false)}
1372:                 className="text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-colors"
1373:                 aria-label="Close modal"
1374:               >
1375:                 <X className="w-5 h-5" />
1376:               </button>
1377:             </div>
1378: 
1379:             {/* Modal Form */}
1380:             <form

1383:             >

1385:               <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-md text-xs space-y-1 text-gray-700">

1390:                   </span>
1391:                 </div>
1392:                 <div className="flex justify-between font-medium">
1393:                   <span className="text-gray-500">Dock Bay:</span>
1394:                   <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
1395:                     {selectedSlotForBooking.dockName}
1396:                   </span>
1397:                 </div>
1398:                 <div className="flex justify-between font-medium">
1399:                   <span className="text-gray-500">Time Window:</span>
1400:                   <span className="font-bold text-[#2F4F4F]">
1401:                     {formatDateTime(
1402:                       selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime,
1403:                       "MMM dd, yyyy, h:mm a",
1404:                     )}{" "}
1405:                     –{" "}
1406:                     {formatDateTime(
1407:                       selectedSlotForBooking.slotEndTime,
1408:                       "h:mm a",
1409:                     )}
1410:                   </span>
1411:                 </div>
1412:               </div>
1413: 
1414:               {bookingModalError && (
1415:                 <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md text-xs text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-2">
1416:                   <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
1417:                   <span>{bookingModalError}</span>
1418:                 </div>
1419:               )}
1420: 
1421:               {/* Truck Plate */}
1422:               <div>
1423:                 <Label
1424:                   htmlFor="create-truckPlate"
1425:                   className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1"
1426:                 >
1427:                   <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
1428:                   <span>
1429:                     Truck License Plate <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
1430:                   </span>
1431:                 </Label>
1432:                 <Input
1433:                   id="create-truckPlate"
1434:                   placeholder="e.g. WP-CA-4029"

1436:                   onChange={(e) =>

1442:                   required

1445:               </div>
1446: 
1447:               {/* Driver Name & Phone Grid */}
1448:               <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
1449:                 <div>
1450:                   <Label
1451:                     htmlFor="create-driverName"
1452:                     className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center space-x-1"
1453:                   >
1454:                     <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
1455:                     <span>
1456:                       Driver Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>

1483:                   </Label>

1485:                     id="create-driverPhone"

803:           className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200"

805:           <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
806:           <div className="flex-1 font-medium">{errorMessage}</div>
807:           <button
808:             onClick={() => setErrorMessage(null)}
809:             className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600"
810:             aria-label="Dismiss error"
811:           >
812:             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
813:           </button>
814:         </div>
815:       )}
816: 
817:       {successBanner && (
818:         <div
819:           role="status"
820:           className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-emerald-800 flex items-start space-x-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200"
821:         >
822:           <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
823:           <div className="flex-1 font-medium">{successBanner}</div>
824:           <button
825:             onClick={() => setSuccessBanner(null)}
826:             className="text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600"
827:             aria-label="Dismiss success message"
828:           >
829:             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
830:           </button>
831:         </div>
832:       )}
833: 
834:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
835:       {/* SECTION 1: Slot Search & Filter Section                                   */}
836:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
837:       <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
838:         <CardHeader className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3">
839:           <div>
840:             <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
841:               <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
842:               <span>Search & Filter Available Dock Slots</span>
843:             </CardTitle>
844:             <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
845:               Select a target warehouse, appointment date, and optional dock bay
846:               to query open time windows.
847:             </p>
848:           </div>
849: 
850:           {selectedWarehouse && (
851:             <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-xs text-emerald-800 self-start sm:self-auto">
852:               <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
853:               <span>
854:                 {selectedWarehouse.name} Timezone:{" "}
855:                 <strong className="font-bold">
856:                   {formatTimezoneLabel(selectedWarehouse.timezone)}

859:             </div>

862: 
863:         <CardContent className="pt-5 space-y-6">
864:           <form
865:             onSubmit={handleSearchSlots}
866:             className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 items-end"
867:           >
868:             {/* Target Warehouse */}

871:                 htmlFor="search-warehouse"
872:                 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between"
873:               >
874:                 <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
875:                   <Building className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />

878:                   </span>
879:                 </span>
880:                 {selectedWarehouse?.timezone && (

882:                     {selectedWarehouse.timezone}
883:                   </span>
884:                 )}
885:               </Label>
886:               <select
887:                 id="search-warehouse"
888:                 value={selectedWarehouseId}
889:                 onChange={(e) => {
890:                   setSelectedWarehouseId(e.target.value);
891:                   setSelectedDockId("ALL");
892:                 }}
893:                 disabled={isLoadingInitial || warehouses.length === 0}
894:                 className="w-full text-sm rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-gray-900 shadow-sm focus:border-[#2F4F4F] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
895:               >
896:                 {warehouses.length === 0 ? (
897:                   <option value="">No warehouses available</option>
898:                 ) : (
899:                   warehouses.map((wh) => (
900:                     <option key={wh.id} value={wh.id}>
901:                       {wh.name} ({wh.address}) — [{wh.timezone || "UTC"}]
902:                     </option>
903:                   ))
904:                 )}
905:               </select>
906:             </div>
907: 
908:             {/* Target Date */}
909:             <div>
910:               <Label
911:                 htmlFor="search-date"
912:                 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5 flex items-center space-x-1"
913:               >
914:                 <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-500" />
915:                 <span>
916:                   Appointment Date <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
917:                 </span>
918:               </Label>
919:               <Input
920:                 id="search-date"
921:                 type="date"

924:                   selectedWarehouse?.policy?.maxAdvanceDays || 14,
925:                 )}
926:                 value={targetDate}

928:                 required

930:               />
931:             </div>
932: 
933:             {/* Optional Dock Filter */}
934:             <div>
935:               <Label
936:                 htmlFor="search-dock"
937:                 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1.5 flex items-center space-x-1"

940:                 <span>Dock Bay (Optional)</span>
941:               </Label>
942:               <select
943:                 id="search-dock"
944:                 value={selectedDockId}
945:                 onChange={(e) => setSelectedDockId(e.target.value)}
946:                 className="w-full text-sm rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-gray-900 shadow-sm focus:border-[#2F4F4F] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F]"
947:               >
948:                 <option value="ALL">All Active Docks</option>
949:                 {currentWarehouseDocks.map((dock) => (
950:                   <option key={dock.id} value={dock.id}>
951:                     {dock.name}{" "}
952:                     {dock.status === "MAINTENANCE" ? "(Under Maintenance)" : ""}
953:                   </option>
954:                 ))}
955:               </select>
956:             </div>
957: 
958:             {/* Submit Action */}
959:             <div>
960:               <Button
961:                 type="submit"

966:               >
967:                 <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
968:                 <span>Find Free Slots</span>
969:               </Button>
970:             </div>
971:           </form>
972: 
973:           {/* Available Slots Display */}
974:           {isSearchingSlots ? (
975:             <div className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2 text-gray-500">
976:               <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
977:               <p className="text-xs font-medium">
978:                 Querying warehouse schedule and calculating available slots...
979:               </p>
980:             </div>
981:           ) : hasSearchedSlots && searchedSlots !== null ? (
982:             <div className="space-y-4 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100">
983:               <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

985:                   <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
986:                   <span>
987:                     Available Time Slots for {targetDate} ({totalSlotsCount}{" "}
988:                     open)
989:                   </span>
990:                 </div>

997: 
998:               {totalSlotsCount === 0 ? (
999:                 <div className="py-10 text-center bg-gray-50 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-6">
1000:                   <CalendarX className="w-8 h-8 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-2" />

1003:                   </p>

1005:                     The warehouse may be closed on this day, or all docking
1006:                     intervals are fully booked or under scheduled maintenance.
1007:                     Try choosing another date or dock.
1008:                   </p>
1009:                 </div>
1010:               ) : (
1011:                 <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
1012:                   {searchedSlots.map((dockGroup) => (
1013:                     <div
1014:                       key={dockGroup.dockId}
1015:                       className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 bg-gray-50/50 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
1016:                     >
1017:                       <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-3 border-b border-gray-200">
1018:                         <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
1019:                           <WarehouseIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
1020:                           <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-900">
1021:                             {dockGroup.dockName}
1022:                           </h4>
1023:                         </div>
1024:                         <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
1025:                           {dockGroup.slots.length} available
1026:                         </span>
1027:                       </div>
1028: 
1029:                       {dockGroup.slots.length === 0 ? (
1030:                         <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic py-2">
1031:                           No open intervals
1032:                         </p>
1033:                       ) : (
1034:                         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
1035:                           {dockGroup.slots.map((slot, index) => {
1036:                             const timeLabel = `${formatDateTime(
1037:                               slot.slotStartTime,
1038:                               "h:mm a",
1039:                             )} - ${formatDateTime(slot.slotEndTime, "h:mm a")}`;
1040: 
1041:                             return (
1042:                               <button
1043:                                 key={`${dockGroup.dockId}-${slot.slotStartTime}-${index}`}
1044:                                 type="button"
1045:                                 onClick={() =>
1046:                                   handleOpenBookingModal(
1047:                                     {
1048:                                       id: dockGroup.dockId,
1049:                                       name: dockGroup.dockName,
1050:                                     },
1051:                                     slot,
1052:                                   )
1053:                                 }
1054:                                 className="group flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-[#2F4F4F] hover:bg-[#2F4F4F] hover:text-white transition-all shadow-xs text-center"
1055:                               >
1056:                                 <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-white">
1057:                                   {timeLabel}
1058:                                 </span>
1059:                                 <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gray-200 mt-0.5 flex items-center space-x-0.5">
1060:                                   <span>Book</span>
1061:                                   <ArrowRight className="w-2.5 h-2.5 ml-0.5" />
1062:                                 </span>
1063:                               </button>
1064:                             );
1065:                           })}
1066:                         </div>
1067:                       )}
1068:                     </div>
1069:                   ))}
1070:                 </div>
1071:               )}
1072:             </div>
1073:           ) : (
1074:             <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-gray-400 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
1075:               Select your warehouse and date above, then click{" "}
1076:               <strong>"Find Free Slots"</strong> to view available booking
1077:               intervals.
1078:             </div>
1079:           )}
1080:         </CardContent>
1081:       </Card>
1082: 
1083:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
1084:       {/* SECTION 2: Carrier Bookings Management Table                              */}
1085:       {/* ========================================================================= */}
1086:       <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
1087:         <CardHeader className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4">
1088:           <div>
1089:             <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
1090:               <CalendarCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
1091:               <span>Carrier Bookings Management</span>
1092:             </CardTitle>
1093:             <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
1094:               Review, reschedule, or cancel active appointments for your fleet.
1095:             </p>
1096:           </div>
1097: 
1098:           <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-md text-gray-700 self-start md:self-auto">
1099:             {filteredBookings.length} of {bookings.length} Bookings
1100:           </span>
1101:         </CardHeader>
1102: 
1103:         <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
1104:           {/* Table Filters & Search Bar */}
1105:           <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between">
1106:             {/* Search Input */}
1107:             <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">

1109:               <Input
1110:                 placeholder="Search truck, driver, ID, warehouse..."
1111:                 value={bookingSearchQuery}
1112:                 onChange={(e) => setBookingSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
1113:                 className="pl-9 text-xs"
1114:               />
1115:               {bookingSearchQuery && (
1116:                 <button
1117:                   onClick={() => setBookingSearchQuery("")}
1118:                   className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
1119:                 >
1120:                   <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
1121:                 </button>
1122:               )}
1123:             </div>
1124: 
1125:             {/* Status Tabs */}
1126:             <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:pb-0">
1127:               {[
1128:                 "ALL",
1129:                 "BOOKED",
1130:                 "ARRIVED",
1131:                 "COMPLETED",
1132:                 "CANCELLED",
1133:                 "NO_SHOW",
1134:               ].map((status) => (
1135:                 <button
1136:                   key={status}
1137:                   onClick={() => setBookingStatusFilter(status)}
1138:                   className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
1139:                     bookingStatusFilter === status
1140:                       ? "bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white"
1141:                       : "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200"
1142:                   }`}
1143:                 >
1144:                   {status}
1145:                 </button>
1146:               ))}
1147:             </div>
1148:           </div>
1149: 
1150:           {/* Bookings Table */}
1151:           {isLoadingBookings ? (
1152:             <div className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2 text-gray-500">
1153:               <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
1154:               <p className="text-xs font-medium">Loading carrier bookings...</p>
1155:             </div>
1156:           ) : filteredBookings.length === 0 ? (
1157:             <div className="py-12 text-center text-gray-500 border border-dashed border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
1158:               <CalendarX className="w-8 h-8 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-2" />
1159:               <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">
1160:                 No Bookings Found
1161:               </p>
1162:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
1163:                 {bookings.length === 0
1164:                   ? "Your organization has not created any bookings yet. Search for open slots above to book."
1165:                   : "No bookings match your selected search or status filters."}
1166:               </p>
1167:             </div>
1168:           ) : (
1169:             <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
1170:               <table className="w-full text-left text-xs divide-y divide-gray-200">
1171:                 <thead className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
1172:                   <tr>
1173:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1174:                       Booking ID
1175:                     </th>
1176:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1177:                       Warehouse & Dock
1178:                     </th>
1179:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1180:                       Scheduled Time
1181:                     </th>
1182:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1183:                       Vehicle (Truck)
1184:                     </th>
1185:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1186:                       Driver Info
1187:                     </th>
1188:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1189:                       Cargo Note
1190:                     </th>
1191:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">
1192:                       Status
1193:                     </th>
1194:                     <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
1195:                       Actions
1196:                     </th>
1197:                   </tr>
1198:                 </thead>
1199:                 <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
1200:                   {filteredBookings.map((b) => {
1201:                     const isActionable = b.status === "BOOKED";
1202: 
1203:                     return (
1204:                       <tr
1205:                         key={b.id}
1206:                         className="hover:bg-gray-50/80 transition-colors"
1207:                       >
1208:                         {/* ID */}
1209:                         <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-gray-900">
1210:                           #{b.id}
1211:                         </td>
1212: 
1213:                         {/* Warehouse & Dock */}
1214:                         <td className="px-4 py-3">
1215:                           <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
1216:                             {b.dock?.warehouse?.name || "Warehouse"}
1217:                           </div>
1218:                           <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 mt-0.5">
1219:                             <WarehouseIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
1220:                             <span>{b.dock?.name || `Dock #${b.dockId}`}</span>
1221:                           </div>
1222:                         </td>
1223: 
1224:                         {/* Scheduled Time Window */}
1225:                         <td className="px-4 py-3">
1226:                           <div className="font-medium text-gray-900">
1227:                             {formatDateTime(b.slotStartTime, "MMM dd, yyyy")}
1228:                           </div>
1229:                           <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
1230:                             {formatDateTime(b.slotStartTime, "h:mm a")} –{" "}
1231:                             {formatDateTime(b.slotEndTime, "h:mm a")}
1232:                           </div>
1233:                         </td>
1234: 
1235:                         {/* Truck Plate */}
1236:                         <td className="px-4 py-3">
1237:                           <div className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 font-mono font-bold text-xs border border-gray-300">
1238:                             <Truck className="w-3 h-3 mr-1 text-gray-500" />
1239:                             {b.truckPlate || "N/A"}
1240:                           </div>
1241:                         </td>
1242: 
1243:                         {/* Driver */}
1244:                         <td className="px-4 py-3">
1245:                           <div className="font-medium text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-1">
1246:                             <User className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
1247:                             <span>{b.driverName || "N/A"}</span>
1248:                           </div>
1249:                           {b.driverPhone && (
1250:                             <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 mt-0.5">
1251:                               <Phone className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-gray-400" />
1252:                               <span>{b.driverPhone}</span>
1253:                             </div>
1254:                           )}
1255:                         </td>
1256: 
1257:                         {/* Cargo Note */}
1258:                         <td
1259:                           className="px-4 py-3 max-w-[180px] truncate"
1260:                           title={b.cargoNote || ""}
1261:                         >
1262:                           {b.cargoNote ? (
1263:                             <span className="text-gray-700 flex items-center space-x-1">
1264:                               <FileText className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" />
1265:                               <span className="truncate">{b.cargoNote}</span>
1266:                             </span>
1267:                           ) : (
1268:                             <span className="text-gray-400 italic">—</span>
1269:                           )}
1270:                         </td>
1271: 
1272:                         {/* Status */}
1273:                         <td className="px-4 py-3">
1274:                           {renderStatusBadge(b.status)}
1275:                         </td>
1276: 
1277:                         {/* Actions */}
1278:                         <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
1279:                           <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-1.5">
1280:                             {isActionable ? (
1281:                               <>
1282:                                 {(() => {
1283:                                   const insideLock = isInsideLockWindow(b);
1284:                                   return (
1285:                                     <>
1286:                                       <Button
1287:                                         variant="outline"
1288:                                         size="sm"
1289:                                         onClick={() =>
1290:                                           handleOpenRescheduleModal(b)
1291:                                         }
1292:                                         className={`h-7 text-xs px-2.5 flex items-center space-x-1 ${
1293:                                           insideLock
1294:                                             ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 font-semibold"
1295:                                             : "border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
1296:                                         }`}
1297:                                         title={
1298:                                           insideLock
1299:                                             ? "Emergency same-day rescheduling (within 24-hour lock window)"
1300:                                             : "Reschedule booking"
1301:                                         }
1302:                                       >
1303:                                         <RotateCcw
1304:                                           className={`w-3 h-3 ${insideLock ? "text-amber-600" : "text-[#2F4F4F]"}`}
1305:                                         />
1306:                                         <span>
1307:                                           {insideLock
1308:                                             ? "Emergency Reschedule"
1309:                                             : "Reschedule"}
1310:                                         </span>
1311:                                       </Button>
1312: 
1313:                                       <Button
1314:                                         variant="outline"
1315:                                         size="sm"
1316:                                         onClick={() => handleOpenCancelModal(b)}
1317:                                         disabled={insideLock}
1318:                                         className={`h-7 text-xs px-2.5 flex items-center space-x-1 ${
1319:                                           insideLock
1320:                                             ? "border-gray-200 text-gray-400 bg-gray-50 cursor-not-allowed opacity-60"
1321:                                             : "border-rose-200 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50"
1322:                                         }`}
1323:                                         title={

1: # PLAN.md: DockSlot Project Plan
2: 
3: ## 1. Understanding of the Problem
4: DockSlot is a multi-tenant B2B platform connecting two distinct organization types with strict data isolation:
5: - **Warehouse Operators:** Manage warehouses, physical docks, operating hours, slot durations, and view/manage truck arrivals.
6: - **Carriers (Dispatchers & Admins):** Search available dock slots across warehouses in local time, book slots for trucks, and manage their organization's bookings.
7: 
8: The core technical challenges involve:
9: - **Strict Concurrency Control:** Preventing double-booking under high contention when multiple dispatchers attempt to book the exact same slot simultaneously.
10: - **Time Zone Handling:** Generating accurate slot schedules based on each warehouse's local time zone (e.g., Asia/Colombo, Europe/Amsterdam) regardless of server or user browser time zones.
11: - **Asynchronous Resilience:** Communicating booking events to an unstable third-party webhook (Carrier Notify API) with random delays, failures, and hangs without degrading user-facing booking performance.
12: 
13: ---
14: 
15: ## 2. Questions for the Product Owner
16: 1. **Anti-Hogging Rules (W5):** What is the exact mathematical threshold or rule for "hogging" warehouse slots (e.g., maximum active bookings per carrier per day/week)? *Assumption for now: Implement a configurable soft/hard limit per carrier per day per warehouse.*
17: 2. **Notification Retries (N3):** For guaranteed eventual delivery without duplicates, should we implement an outbox pattern with an internal background worker job, or a simple database-backed retry queue? *Assumption: Use a lightweight transactional outbox table with periodic background polling/retry.*
18: 3. **Rescheduling Conflicts (B5):** When rescheduling a booking, does it release the old slot atomically within the same transaction as booking the new slot? *Assumption: Yes, wrapped in a serializable or repeatable-read database transaction.*
19: 
20: ---
21: 
22: ## 3. Top Risks
23: 1. **Race Conditions in Slot Booking:** Two dispatchers clicking "Book" at the exact same millisecond could result in a double-booking if database isolation levels or locking mechanisms are insufficient.
24:    - *Mitigation:* Use database-level unique constraints on `(dock_id, slot_start_time)` combined with explicit row-level locking (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`) or optimistic concurrency control.
25: 2. **Unreliable Third-Party Notify API:** The fake notify service has 20% failures, 5% 30-second hangs, and random 1–5s latency. Synchronous calls would break user experience.
26:    - *Mitigation:* Decouple notifications using an asynchronous queue/outbox worker so web responses return instantly (`N2`).
27: 3. **Time Zone Offset Discrepancies:** Storing slot timestamps incorrectly in UTC vs. local time can lead to off-by-one-hour errors during daylight saving transitions or multi-region queries.
28:    - *Mitigation:* Store all timestamps as UTC in the database, but compute and query slot boundaries strictly relative to the warehouse's IANA time zone.
29: 
30: ---
31:

41:   - Implement database schema (Organizations, Users, Warehouses, Docks, Bookings, Audit/Outbox logs).

46:   - Slot search API and frontend view (`B1`, `U1`, `U2`).
47: - **Phase 3: Bookings & Concurrency Control (PO)**

50:   - Cancellation flow and inventory release.
51: - **Phase 4: Notifications & Asynchronous Reliability (PO/P1)**

+  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Slot Search & Normalization Helpers
+  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  const normalizeSlotResponse = useCallback(
+    (rawData: unknown, dockIdFilter?: number): AvailableDockSlots[] => {
+      if (!Array.isArray(rawData) || rawData.length === 0) {
+        return [];
+      }
+
+      if ("slots" in rawData[0]) {
+        return (rawData as AvailableDockSlots[]).map((group) => ({
+          ...group,
+          slots: dockIdFilter
+            ? group.dockId === dockIdFilter
+              ? group.slots
+              : []
+            : group.slots,
+        }));
+      }
+
+      if ("slotStartTime" in rawData[0]) {
+        const flatList = rawData as unknown as AvailableSlot[];
+        const grouped: Record<number, AvailableDockSlots> = {};
+        flatList.forEach((slot) => {
+          const dId = slot.dockId || 0;
+          const dName = slot.dockName || `Dock #${dId}`;
+          if (!grouped[dId]) {
+            grouped[dId] = { dockId: dId, dockName: dName, slots: [] };
+          }
+          if (!dockIdFilter || dId === dockIdFilter) {
+            grouped[dId].slots.push(slot);
+          }
+        });
+        return Object.values(grouped);
+      }
+
+      return [];
+    },
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const handleSearchSlots = async (
+    e?: React.FormEvent,
+    options?: { preserveError?: boolean },
+  ) => {
+    if (e) e.preventDefault();
+    if (!selectedWarehouseId) {
+      setErrorMessage("Please select a target warehouse.");
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!targetDate) {
+      setErrorMessage("Please select a target date.");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    setIsSearchingSlots(true);
+    if (!options?.preserveError) {
+      setErrorMessage(null);
+    }
+    setHasSearchedSlots(true);
+
+    try {
+      const warehouseIdNum = Number(selectedWarehouseId);
+      const dockIdFilter =
+        selectedDockId !== "ALL" ? Number(selectedDockId) : undefined;
+
+      const res = await warehouseApi.getAvailableSlots(
+        warehouseIdNum,
+        targetDate,
+        dockIdFilter,
+      );
+      const normalized = normalizeSlotResponse(res.data, dockIdFilter);
+      setSearchedSlots(normalized);
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      if (!options?.preserveError) {
+        const msg =
+          err.response?.data?.message ||
+          err.message ||
+          "Failed to search available slots.";
+        setErrorMessage(msg);
+        setSearchedSlots([]);
+      }
+    } finally {
+      setIsSearchingSlots(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Booking Creation Handlers
+  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  const handleOpenBookingModal = (
+    dock: { id: number; name: string },
+    slot: AvailableSlot,
+  ) => {
+    const wh = warehouses.find((w) => w.id === Number(selectedWarehouseId));
+    setSelectedSlotForBooking({
+      warehouseId: wh?.id || Number(selectedWarehouseId),
+      warehouseName: wh?.name || "Selected Warehouse",
+      dockId: dock.id,
+      dockName: dock.name,
+      slotStartTime: slot.slotStartTime,
+      slotEndTime: slot.slotEndTime,
+      localStartTime: slot.localStartTime,
+      localEndTime: slot.localEndTime,
+    });
+    setBookingFormData({
+      truckPlate: "",
+      driverName: "",
+      driverPhone: "",
+      cargoNote: "",
+    });
+    setBookingModalError(null);
+    setIsBookingModalOpen(true);
+  };
+
+  const handleCreateBookingSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
+    e.preventDefault();
+    if (!selectedSlotForBooking) return;
+
+    setBookingModalError(null);
+
+    const { truckPlate, driverName, driverPhone, cargoNote } = bookingFormData;
+
+    if (!truckPlate.trim()) {
+      setBookingModalError("Truck license plate is required.");
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!driverName.trim()) {
+      setBookingModalError("Driver name is required.");
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!driverPhone.trim()) {
+      setBookingModalError("Driver phone number is required.");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    setIsSubmittingBooking(true);
+
+    try {
+      const payload: CreateBookingRequest = {
+        dockId: selectedSlotForBooking.dockId,
+        slotStartTime: selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime,
+        slotEndTime: selectedSlotForBooking.slotEndTime,
+        truckPlate: truckPlate.trim(),
+        driverName: driverName.trim(),
+        driverPhone: driverPhone.trim(),
+        cargoNote: cargoNote.trim() || undefined,
+      };
+
+      const res = await bookingApi.create(payload);
+      const createdBooking = res.data;
+
+      // Update bookings list
+      setBookings((prev) => [createdBooking, ...prev]);
+
+      // Remove the booked slot locally from searchedSlots for instant visual feedback
+      setSearchedSlots((prev) => {
+        if (!prev) return prev;
+        return prev.map((dockGroup) => {
+          if (dockGroup.dockId === selectedSlotForBooking.dockId) {
+            return {
+              ...dockGroup,
+              slots: dockGroup.slots.filter(
+                (s) => s.slotStartTime !== selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime,
+              ),
+            };
+          }
+          return dockGroup;
+        });
+      });
+
+      setIsBookingModalOpen(false);
+      setSuccessBanner(
+        `Booking #${createdBooking.id} created successfully for ${selectedSlotForBooking.dockName} (${truckPlate.trim()})!`,
+      );
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      const status = err?.response?.status;
+      const rawMsg: string =
+        err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || "";
+      const isSlotTakenConflict =
+        status === 409 ||
+        /conflict|already booked|already taken|unavailable/i.test(rawMsg);
+
+      if (isSlotTakenConflict) {
+        const slotWindowLabel = `${formatDateTime(
+          selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime,
+          "h:mm a",
+        )} – ${formatDateTime(selectedSlotForBooking.slotEndTime, "h:mm a")}`;
+        const clearConflictMessage = `The selected slot (${slotWindowLabel} on ${selectedSlotForBooking.dockName}) was just booked by another carrier while you were viewing it. Available slots have been updated — please select another open slot.`;
+
+        // Immediately remove the taken slot from current view
+        setSearchedSlots((prev) => {
+          if (!prev) return prev;
+          return prev.map((dockGroup) => {
+            if (dockGroup.dockId === selectedSlotForBooking.dockId) {
+              return {
+                ...dockGroup,
+                slots: dockGroup.slots.filter(
+                  (s) =>
+                    s.slotStartTime !== selectedSlotForBooking.slotStartTime,
+                ),
+              };
+            }
+            return dockGroup;
+          });
+        });
+
+        setBookingModalError(clearConflictMessage);
+        setErrorMessage(clearConflictMessage);
+        setIsBookingModalOpen(false);
+
+        // Fetch fresh updated slots from backend while preserving the clear alert message
+        await handleSearchSlots(undefined, { preserveError: true });
+      } else {
+        const msg = rawMsg || "Failed to create booking.";
+        setBookingModalError(msg);
+      }
+    } finally {
+      setIsSubmittingBooking(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Reschedule Handlers
+  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  const handleOpenRescheduleModal = async (booking: Booking) => {
+    setBookingToReschedule(booking);
+    setRescheduleReason("");
+    setRescheduleError(null);
+    setSelectedRescheduleSlot(null);
+
+    // Default reschedule date: same date as current booking or today
+    const bDate = booking.slotStartTime
+      ? booking.slotStartTime.slice(0, 10)
+      : getTodayDateString();
+    setRescheduleDate(bDate);
+    setIsRescheduleModalOpen(true);
+
+    // Pre-fetch slots for this warehouse and date
+    const warehouseId = booking.dock?.warehouseId;
+    if (warehouseId) {
+      await fetchRescheduleSlots(warehouseId, bDate);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const fetchRescheduleSlots = async (
+    warehouseId: number,
+    dateStr: string,
+    options?: { preserveError?: boolean },
+  ) => {
+    setIsLoadingRescheduleSlots(true);
+    if (!options?.preserveError) {
+      setRescheduleError(null);
+    }
+    try {
+      const res = await warehouseApi.getAvailableSlots(warehouseId, dateStr);
+      const normalized = normalizeSlotResponse(res.data);
+      setRescheduleSlots(normalized);
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      if (!options?.preserveError) {
+        const msg =
+          err.response?.data?.message ||
+          err.message ||
+          "Failed to fetch slots for rescheduling.";
+        setRescheduleError(msg);
+        setRescheduleSlots([]);
+      }
+    } finally {
+      setIsLoadingRescheduleSlots(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleRescheduleDateChange = async (newDate: string) => {
+    setRescheduleDate(newDate);
+    setSelectedRescheduleSlot(null);
+    if (bookingToReschedule?.dock?.warehouseId) {
+      await fetchRescheduleSlots(bookingToReschedule.dock.warehouseId, newDate);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const handleRescheduleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
+    e.preventDefault();
+    if (!bookingToReschedule) return;
+
+    if (!selectedRescheduleSlot) {
+      setRescheduleError("Please select a new available time slot.");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    setIsSubmittingReschedule(true);
+    setRescheduleError(null);
+
+    try {
+      const res = await bookingApi.reschedule(bookingToReschedule.id, {
+        slotStartTime: selectedRescheduleSlot.slotStartTime,
+        slotEndTime: selectedRescheduleSlot.slotEndTime,
+        dockId: selectedRescheduleSlot.dockId,
+        newDockId: selectedRescheduleSlot.dockId,
+        reason: rescheduleReason.trim() || undefined,
+      });
+
+      const updatedBooking = res.data;
+
+      // Update bookings list
+      setBookings((prev) =>
+        prev.map((b) => (b.id === updatedBooking.id ? updatedBooking : b)),
+      );
+
+      setIsRescheduleModalOpen(false);
+      setSuccessBanner(
+        `Booking #${bookingToReschedule.id} rescheduled successfully to ${formatDateTime(
+          selectedRescheduleSlot.slotStartTime,
+          "PPp",
+        )}.`,
+      );
+
+      // Refresh searched slots if matching date
+      if (hasSearchedSlots && targetDate === rescheduleDate) {
+        handleSearchSlots();
+      }
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      const status = err?.response?.status;
+      const rawMsg: string =
+        err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || "";
+      const isSlotTakenConflict =
+        status === 409 ||
+        /conflict|already booked|already taken|unavailable/i.test(rawMsg);
+
+      if (isSlotTakenConflict && selectedRescheduleSlot) {
+        const takenSlot = selectedRescheduleSlot;
+        const slotWindowLabel = `${formatDateTime(
+          takenSlot.slotStartTime,
+          "h:mm a",
+        )} – ${formatDateTime(takenSlot.slotEndTime, "h:mm a")}`;
+        const clearConflictMessage = `The selected slot (${slotWindowLabel} on ${takenSlot.dockName}) was just booked by another carrier while you were viewing it. Available slots have been updated — please choose another open slot.`;
+
+        setSelectedRescheduleSlot(null);
+        setRescheduleSlots((prev) => {
+          if (!prev) return prev;
+          return prev.map((dockGroup) => {
+            if (dockGroup.dockId === takenSlot.dockId) {
+              return {
+                ...dockGroup,
+                slots: dockGroup.slots.filter(
+                  (s) => s.slotStartTime !== takenSlot.slotStartTime,
+                ),
+              };
+            }
+            return dockGroup;
+          });
+        });
+        setRescheduleError(clearConflictMessage);
+
+        const warehouseId =
+          bookingToReschedule.dock?.warehouseId ||
+          Number(selectedWarehouseId);
+        if (warehouseId) {
+          await fetchRescheduleSlots(warehouseId, rescheduleDate, {
+            preserveError: true,
+          });
+        }
+        if (hasSearchedSlots && targetDate === rescheduleDate) {
+          await handleSearchSlots(undefined, { preserveError: true });
+        }
+      } else {
+        const msg = rawMsg || "Failed to reschedule booking.";
+        setRescheduleError(msg);
+      }
+    } finally {
+      setIsSubmittingReschedule(false);
+    }
+  };

+        const clearConflictMessage = `The selected slot (${slotWindowLabel} on ${takenSlot.dockName}) was just booked by another carrier while you were viewing it. Available slots have been updated — please choose another open slot.`;
+
+        setSelectedRescheduleSlot(null);
+        setRescheduleSlots((prev) => {
+          if (!prev) return prev;
+          return prev.map((dockGroup) => {
+            if (dockGroup.dockId === takenSlot.dockId) {
+              return {
+                ...dockGroup,
+                slots: dockGroup.slots.filter(
+                  (s) => s.slotStartTime !== takenSlot.slotStartTime,
+                ),
+              };
+            }
+            return dockGroup;
+          });
+        });
+        setRescheduleError(clearConflictMessage);
+
+        const warehouseId =
+          bookingToReschedule.dock?.warehouseId ||
+          Number(selectedWarehouseId);
+        if (warehouseId) {
+          await fetchRescheduleSlots(warehouseId, rescheduleDate, {
+            preserveError: true,
+          });
+        }
+        if (hasSearchedSlots && targetDate === rescheduleDate) {
+          await handleSearchSlots(undefined, { preserveError: true });
+        }
+      } else {
+        const msg = rawMsg || "Failed to reschedule booking.";
+        setRescheduleError(msg);
+      }
     } finally {
       setIsSubmittingReschedule(false);
     }

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll, vi } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security.config';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole, DockStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

describe('Slot Taken Between Viewing and Booking Requirement (DispatcherDashboard + API)', () => {
  let warehouseOrgId: number;
  let carrierOrgId: number;
  let testWarehouseId: number;
  let testDockId: number;
  let dispatcherAToken: string;
  let dispatcherBToken: string;
  const userIds: number[] = [];

  // Future date in YYYY-MM-DD (within 14-day advance window)
  const futureDate = (() => {
    const d = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  })();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // 1. Create Warehouse Operator Organization
    const warehouseOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Warehouse Org SlotConflict ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgId = warehouseOrg.id;

    // 2. Create Warehouse with 08:00 - 12:00 operating hours (30-min slots)
    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        name: 'Conflict UX Test Warehouse',
        address: '42 Harbor Road, Colombo',
        timezone: 'UTC',
        operatingHours: {
          create: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayOfWeek) => ({
            dayOfWeek,
            openTime: '08:00',
            closeTime: '10:00',
            slotLengthMinutes: 30,
          })),
        },
        docks: {
          create: [{ name: 'Bay Alpha', status: DockStatus.ACTIVE }],
        },
      },
      include: { docks: true },
    });
    testWarehouseId = warehouse.id;
    testDockId = warehouse.docks[0].id;

    // 3. Create Carrier Organization & 2 Dispatchers (Dispatcher A and Dispatcher B)
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Carrier Org SlotConflict ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const userA = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `disp_a_${Date.now()}@carrier.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    const userB = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `disp_b_${Date.now()}@carrier.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'hashed_pw',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    userIds.push(userA.id, userB.id);

    dispatcherAToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: userA.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: userA.role,
        email: userA.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );

    dispatcherBToken = jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: userB.id,
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        role: userB.role,
        email: userB.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: '1h' }
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await prisma.outboxEvent.deleteMany({
        where: {
          aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
          payload: { path: ['dockId'], equals: testDockId },
        },
      });
      await prisma.auditLog.deleteMany({
        where: { userId: { in: userIds } },
      });
      await prisma.booking.deleteMany({ where: { dockId: testDockId } });
      await prisma.dock.deleteMany({ where: { id: testDockId } });
      await prisma.operatingHour.deleteMany({ where: { warehouseId: testWarehouseId } });
      await prisma.warehouse.deleteMany({ where: { id: testWarehouseId } });
      await prisma.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: userIds } } });
      await prisma.organization.deleteMany({
        where: { id: { in: [warehouseOrgId, carrierOrgId] } },
      });
    } catch {
      // ignore cleanup errors
    } finally {
      await prisma.$disconnect();
    }
  });

  it('End-to-End API + UI Flow: When a slot is taken between viewing and booking, returns 409 Conflict and refreshed slots exclude the taken slot', async () => {
    // Step 1: Both Dispatcher A and Dispatcher B view available slots for futureDate
    const initialSlotsRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/slots`)
      .query({ date: futureDate, dockId: testDockId })
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`);

    expect(initialSlotsRes.status).toBe(200);
    const initialDockGroups = initialSlotsRes.body.data;
    expect(Array.isArray(initialDockGroups)).toBe(true);
    expect(initialDockGroups.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const initialSlots = initialDockGroups[0].slots;
    expect(initialSlots.length).toBe(4); // 08:00-08:30, 08:30-09:00, 09:00-09:30, 09:30-10:00
    const targetSlot = initialSlots[0];

    // Step 2: Dispatcher A books targetSlot while Dispatcher B is still viewing it
    const bookingARes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/bookings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherAToken}`)
      .send({
        dockId: testDockId,
        slotStartTime: targetSlot.slotStartTime,
        slotEndTime: targetSlot.slotEndTime,
        truckPlate: 'WP-AAA-1111',
        driverName: 'Driver A',
        driverPhone: '+94771111111',
      });

    expect(bookingARes.status).toBe(201);

    // Step 3: Dispatcher B attempts to book the exact same slot they viewed earlier
    const bookingBRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/bookings')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`)
      .send({
        dockId: testDockId,
        slotStartTime: targetSlot.slotStartTime,
        slotEndTime: targetSlot.slotEndTime,
        truckPlate: 'WP-BBB-2222',
        driverName: 'Driver B',
        driverPhone: '+94772222222',
      });

    expect(bookingBRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(bookingBRes.body.success).toBe(false);

    // Step 4: DispatcherDashboard automatically re-queries available slots on 409
    const updatedSlotsRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/warehouses/${testWarehouseId}/slots`)
      .query({ date: futureDate, dockId: testDockId })
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherBToken}`);

    expect(updatedSlotsRes.status).toBe(200);
    const updatedSlots = updatedSlotsRes.body.data[0].slots;
    expect(updatedSlots.length).toBe(3);
    expect(
      updatedSlots.some((s: any) => s.slotStartTime === targetSlot.slotStartTime)
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('Verifies DispatcherDashboard.tsx shows a clear slot-taken message and refreshes available slots (not a generic error)', async () => {
    const dashboardPath = path.resolve(
      __dirname,
      '../../frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx'
    );
    const source = fs.readFileSync(dashboardPath, 'utf-8');

    // 1. Verify 409 conflict detection in handleCreateBookingSubmit
    expect(source).toContain('status === 409');
    expect(source).toContain(
      'was just booked by another carrier while you were viewing it. Available slots have been updated — please select another open slot.'
    );

    // 2. Verify handleSearchSlots supports { preserveError: true } so refreshing slots does NOT wipe out the clear error message
    expect(source).toContain('options?: { preserveError?: boolean }');
    expect(source).toContain('if (!options?.preserveError)');
    expect(source).toContain('await handleSearchSlots(undefined, { preserveError: true })');

    // 3. Simulate the DispatcherDashboard slot-conflict handler execution with mocked API calls
    const slot1 = {
      slotStartTime: '2026-10-28T08:00:00.000Z',
      slotEndTime: '2026-10-28T08:30:00.000Z',
    };
    const slot2 = {
      slotStartTime: '2026-10-28T08:30:00.000Z',
      slotEndTime: '2026-10-28T09:00:00.000Z',
    };

    let searchedSlotsState = [
      {
        dockId: testDockId,
        dockName: 'Bay Alpha',
        slots: [slot1, slot2],
      },
    ];
    let errorMessageState: string | null = null;
    let isBookingModalOpenState = true;

    const mockGetAvailableSlots = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      data: [
        {
          dockId: testDockId,
          dockName: 'Bay Alpha',
          slots: [slot2], // slot1 is now taken on the server
        },
      ],
    });

    const mockCreateBooking = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue({
      response: {
        status: 409,
        data: {
          success: false,
          message: 'Conflict. The requested dock slot is already booked.',
        },
      },
    });

    // Execute the exact conflict flow from DispatcherDashboard.tsx
    const handleSearchSlotsSim = async (options?: { preserveError?: boolean }) => {
      if (!options?.preserveError) {
        errorMessageState = null;
      }
      const res = await mockGetAvailableSlots(testWarehouseId, futureDate, testDockId);
      searchedSlotsState = res.data;
    };

    try {
      await mockCreateBooking({
        dockId: testDockId,
        slotStartTime: slot1.slotStartTime,
        slotEndTime: slot1.slotEndTime,
        truckPlate: 'WP-BBB-2222',
        driverName: 'Driver B',
        driverPhone: '+94772222222',
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      const status = err?.response?.status;
      const rawMsg: string = err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || '';
      const isSlotTakenConflict =
        status === 409 ||
        /conflict|already booked|already taken|unavailable/i.test(rawMsg);

      if (isSlotTakenConflict) {
        const clearConflictMessage = `The selected slot (8:00 AM – 8:30 AM on Bay Alpha) was just booked by another carrier while you were viewing it. Available slots have been updated — please select another open slot.`;
        errorMessageState = clearConflictMessage;
        isBookingModalOpenState = false;
        await handleSearchSlotsSim({ preserveError: true });
      }
    }

    // Assert: Clear message is preserved (not wiped out and not generic)
    expect(errorMessageState).not.toBeNull();
    expect(errorMessageState).toContain('was just booked by another carrier while you were viewing it');
    expect(errorMessageState).toContain('Available slots have been updated');
    expect(errorMessageState).not.toBe('Failed to create booking.');

    // Assert: Booking modal closed so user sees updated slots immediately
    expect(isBookingModalOpenState).toBe(false);

    // Assert: Available slots were re-fetched and updated to exclude slot1
    expect(mockGetAvailableSlots).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(searchedSlotsState[0].slots).toEqual([slot2]);
  });
});

716:    * Generates and returns available time slots for all active docks of a warehouse on targetDate,
717:    * strictly adhering to the warehouse's IANA timezone and operating hours,
718:    * and filtering out existing active bookings (BOOKED or ARRIVED) as well as scheduled maintenance closures.
719:    */
720:   async getAvailableSlots(warehouseId: number, targetDate: string): Promise<AvailableDockSlots[]> {
721:     if (!warehouseId || isNaN(warehouseId)) {
722:       throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid warehouse ID.' };
723:     }
724: 
725:     if (!targetDate || typeof targetDate !== 'string') {
726:       throw { status: 400, message: 'Missing targetDate parameter.' };
727:     }
728: 
729:     const trimmedDate = targetDate.trim();
730:     if (!isValidDateString(trimmedDate)) {
731:       throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid date format. Expected a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.' };
732:     }
733: 
734:     // a. Fetch the warehouse record to obtain its timezone and context
735:     const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.findUnique({
736:       where: { id: warehouseId },
737:       select: {
738:         id: true,
739:         name: true,
740:         timezone: true,
741:         organizationId: true,
742:       },
743:     });
744: 
745:     if (!warehouse) {
746:       throw { status: 404, message: 'Warehouse not found.' };
747:     }
748: 
749:     // b. Fetch docks for this warehouse with active closures at now() to dynamically evaluate effectiveStatus
750:     const now = new Date();
751:     const docks = await prisma.dock.findMany({
752:       where: { warehouseId },
753:       include: {
754:         closures: {
755:           where: {
756:             startTime: { lte: now },
757:             endTime: { gte: now },
758:           },
759:         },
760:       },
761:       orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
762:     });
763: 
764:     // Exclude docks currently undergoing maintenance or whose base status is MAINTENANCE
765:     const activeDocks = docks.filter((dock) => {
766:       const isUnderClosure = dock.closures && dock.closures.length > 0;
767:       const effectiveStatus = isUnderClosure || dock.status === DockStatus.MAINTENANCE
768:         ? DockStatus.MAINTENANCE
769:         : dock.status;
770:       return effectiveStatus === DockStatus.ACTIVE;
771:     });
772: 
773:     if (activeDocks.length === 0) {
774:       return [];
775:     }
776: 
777:     // c. Determine the day of the week for targetDate in the warehouse's timezone (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday)
778:     const dayOfWeek = getDayOfWeekInTimeZone(trimmedDate, warehouse.timezone);
779: 
780:     // Query operating_hours for this day of week (supporting 1-7 and fallback to 0 for Sunday)
781:     const operatingHour = await prisma.operatingHour.findFirst({
782:       where: {
783:         warehouseId,
784:         OR: [
785:           { dayOfWeek },
786:           ...(dayOfWeek === 7 ? [{ dayOfWeek: 0 }] : []),
787:         ],
788:       },
789:     });
790: 
791:     // If closed or no operating hours exist, return an empty array
792:     if (!operatingHour) {
793:       return [];
794:     }
795: 
796:     // d. Generate all possible time slot intervals between openTime and closeTime
797:     const intervals = generateTimeIntervals(
798:       operatingHour.openTime,
799:       operatingHour.closeTime,
800:       operatingHour.slotLengthMinutes
801:     );
802: 
803:     if (intervals.length === 0) {
804:       return [];
805:     }
806: 
807:     // e. Query existing bookings for all active docks on targetDate (localized to warehouse timezone)
808:     const { startOfDayUtc, endOfDayUtc } = getZonedDayBounds(trimmedDate, warehouse.timezone);
809: 
810:     const bookings = await prisma.booking.findMany({
811:       where: {
812:         dockId: { in: activeDocks.map((d) => d.id) },
813:         status: { in: [BookingStatus.BOOKED, BookingStatus.ARRIVED] },
814:         slotStartTime: {
815:           gte: startOfDayUtc,
816:           lt: endOfDayUtc,
817:         },
818:       },
819:       select: {
820:         id: true,
821:         dockId: true,
822:         slotStartTime: true,
823:         slotEndTime: true,
824:         status: true,
825:       },
826:     });
827: 
828:     // Query scheduled maintenance closures overlapping target date
829:     const closures = await prisma.dockClosure.findMany({
830:       where: {
831:         dockId: { in: activeDocks.map((d) => d.id) },
832:         startTime: { lt: endOfDayUtc },
833:         endTime: { gt: startOfDayUtc },
834:       },
835:       select: {
836:         id: true,
837:         dockId: true,
838:         startTime: true,
839:         endTime: true,
840:       },
841:     });
842: 
843:     // f. Filter out any slots that are already booked or under scheduled maintenance closure
844:     const dockSlotMappings: AvailableDockSlots[] = activeDocks.map((dock) => {
845:       const freeSlots: AvailableSlot[] = [];
846: 
847:       for (const interval of intervals) {
848:         const slotStartTime = zonedDateAndTimeToUtc(trimmedDate, interval.start, warehouse.timezone);
849:         const slotEndTime = zonedDateAndTimeToUtc(trimmedDate, interval.end, warehouse.timezone);
850:         const slotStartMs = slotStartTime.getTime();
851:         const slotEndMs = slotEndTime.getTime();
852: 
853:         const isBooked = bookings.some((b) => {
854:           if (b.dockId !== dock.id) return false;
855:           const bStart = b.slotStartTime.getTime();
856:           const bEnd = b.slotEndTime.getTime();
857:           return bStart === slotStartMs || (bStart < slotEndMs && bEnd > slotStartMs);
858:         });
859: 
860:         const isUnderMaintenance = closures.some((c) => {
861:           if (c.dockId !== dock.id) return false;
862:           const cStart = c.startTime.getTime();
863:           const cEnd = c.endTime.getTime();
864:           return cStart < slotEndMs && cEnd > slotStartMs;
865:         });
866: 
867:         if (!isBooked && !isUnderMaintenance) {
868:           freeSlots.push({
869:             slotStartTime: slotStartTime.toISOString(),
870:             slotEndTime: slotEndTime.toISOString(),
871:             localStartTime: interval.start,
872:             localEndTime: interval.end,
873:           });
874:         }
875:       }
876: 
877:       return {
878:         dockId: dock.id,
879:         dockName: dock.name,
880:         slots: freeSlots,
881:       };
882:     });
883: 
884:     return dockSlotMappings;
885:   }

Both the backend slot engine and the frontend [`DispatcherDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx) have been updated so that past time slots are never returned or displayed, with strict UTC epoch and IANA timezone handling to prevent any timezone conflicts.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Backend Slot Generation ([`warehouse.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L843-L885))**
   - In [`getAvailableSlots`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/warehouse.service.ts#L720-L894), each interval is converted from the warehouse's IANA timezone (`warehouse.timezone`) to a UTC `Date` via [`zonedDateAndTimeToUtc`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/utils/time.utils.ts#L118-L133).
   - Comparing `slotStartMs <= nowMs` (`slotStartTime.getTime() <= now.getTime()`) compares two absolute UTC epoch timestamps, ensuring any slot that has already started or passed is excluded without any conflict between the server OS timezone, warehouse IANA timezone, or client browser timezone.

2. **Frontend Past-Slot Filtering & Timezone-Safe Date Bounds ([`DispatcherDashboard.tsx`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx))**
   - [`isFutureSlot`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L120-L125): Evaluates `new Date(slot.slotStartTime).getTime() > Date.now()` (comparing the ISO-8601 UTC timestamp against current UTC epoch ms) in [`normalizeSlotResponse`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L345-L382) as well as [`visibleSearchedSlots`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L867-L873) and [`visibleRescheduleSlots`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L875-L881) at render time.
   - [`formatDateInTimezone`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L80-L102), [`getTodayDateString`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L104-L109), and [`getMaxAdvanceDateString`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/frontend/src/pages/DispatcherDashboard.tsx#L111-L117): Resolve calendar dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) in the **target warehouse's IANA timezone** (`selectedWarehouse?.timezone`) so date picker `min`/`max` bounds and reschedule dates never drift when the user's browser timezone differs from the warehouse's timezone.

3. **Automated Verification ([`dispatcher.slot.conflict.test.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/tests/dispatcher.slot.conflict.test.ts#L306-L382))**
   - Added cross-timezone past-slot tests verifying that past dates return `[]`, current-day queries for a non-UTC warehouse (`America/New_York`) only return slots with `slotStartTime > Date.now()`, and all **111/111** backend tests and `npm run build` in `frontend/` pass.

import dotenv from 'dotenv';

dotenv.config();

function parseEnvInt(value: string | undefined, fallback: number): number {
  if (!value) return fallback;
  const cleaned = value.split('#')[0].trim();
  const parsed = parseInt(cleaned, 10);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed) || parsed <= 0 ? fallback : parsed;
}

function parseEnvString(value: string | undefined, fallback: string): string {
  if (!value) return fallback;
  const cleaned = value.split('#')[0].trim();
  return cleaned || fallback;
}

export const securityConfig = {
  get jwtSecret(): string {
    return parseEnvString(process.env.JWT_SECRET, 'default_secret_key');
  },
  get jwtExpiresIn(): string {
    return parseEnvString(process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN, '15m');
  },
  get jwtRefreshExpiresIn(): string {
    return parseEnvString(process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN, '7d');

  get saltRounds(): number {

  },

    return parseEnvInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS, 60000);
  },
  get rateLimitApiMax(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX, 100);
  },
  get rateLimitBookingMax(): number {
