```typescript
  },
  get maxFailedLoginAttempts(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS, 5);
  },
  get loginLockoutDurationMinutes(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES, 15);
  },

  // Uppercase aliases matching .env variable names
  get JWT_SECRET(): string {
    return this.jwtSecret;
  },
  get JWT_EXPIRES_IN(): string {
    return this.jwtExpiresIn;
  },
```

```typescript
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security';

export interface JwtUserPayload {
  userId: number;
  organizationId: number;
  role: string;
  email: string;
  tokenVersion?: number;
  type?: 'access' | 'refresh';
}

/**
 * Signs an access JWT using `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` from securityConfig.
 */
export function signAccessToken(payload: JwtUserPayload): string {
  return jwt.sign(
    {
      userId: payload.userId,
      organizationId: payload.organizationId,
      role: payload.role,
      email: payload.email,
      tokenVersion: payload.tokenVersion ?? 0,
    },
    securityConfig.jwtSecret,
    { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn as any }
  );
}

/**
 * Signs a refresh JWT using `JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN` from securityConfig.
 */
export function signRefreshToken(payload: JwtUserPayload): string {
  return jwt.sign(
    {
      userId: payload.userId,
      organizationId: payload.organizationId,
      role: payload.role,
      email: payload.email,
      tokenVersion: payload.tokenVersion ?? 0,
      type: 'refresh',
    },
    securityConfig.jwtSecret,
    { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtRefreshExpiresIn as any }
  );
}

/**
 * Verifies a JWT signature and expiration against `securityConfig.jwtSecret`.
 */
export function verifyJwtToken<T = JwtUserPayload>(token: string): T {
  return jwt.verify(token, securityConfig.jwtSecret) as T;
}
```

```typescript
import Redis from 'ioredis';
import crypto from 'crypto';

const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL || 'redis://localhost:6379';

// In-memory fallback maps for zero-dependency local development / testing without Docker
const inMemoryStore = new Map<string, string>();
const inMemoryExpiry = new Map<string, number>();
const inMemoryScripts = new Map<string, string>();
let isRedisConnected = false;

function getInMemoryPttl(key: string): number {
  if (!inMemoryStore.has(key)) {
    inMemoryExpiry.delete(key);
    return -2;
  }
  const exp = inMemoryExpiry.get(key);
  if (exp === undefined) {
    return -1;
  }
  const remaining = exp - Date.now();
  if (remaining <= 0) {
    inMemoryStore.delete(key);
    inMemoryExpiry.delete(key);
    return -2;
  }
  return remaining;
}

function executeInMemoryCommand(args: string[]): any {
  const cmd = (args[0] || '').toUpperCase();

  if (cmd === 'SCRIPT' && (args[1] || '').toUpperCase() === 'LOAD') {
    const script = args[2] || '';
    const sha = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(script).digest('hex');
    inMemoryScripts.set(sha, script);
    return sha;
  }

  if (cmd === 'EVALSHA') {
    const sha = args[1] || '';
    const script = inMemoryScripts.get(sha);
    if (!script) {
      throw new Error('NOSCRIPT No matching script. Please use EVAL.');
    }
    const key = args[3] || '';
    const argv1 = args[4];

    // rate-limit-redis increment script contains "INCR" and "SET" with "PX"
    if (script.includes('INCR') && script.includes('PX')) {
      const windowMs = Number(argv1) || 60000;
      const pttl = getInMemoryPttl(key);
      if (pttl <= 0) {
        inMemoryStore.set(key, '1');
        inMemoryExpiry.set(key, Date.now() + windowMs);
        return [1, windowMs];
      }
      const totalHits = parseInt(inMemoryStore.get(key) || '0', 10) + 1;
      inMemoryStore.set(key, String(totalHits));
      return [totalHits, pttl];
    }

    // rate-limit-redis get script
    const pttl = getInMemoryPttl(key);
    if (pttl === -2) {
      return [false, -2];
    }
    const rawVal = inMemoryStore.get(key);
    const totalHits = rawVal !== undefined ? parseInt(rawVal, 10) : false;
    return [totalHits, pttl];
  }

  if (cmd === 'DECR') {
    const key = args[1] || '';
    const current = parseInt(inMemoryStore.get(key) || '0', 10);
    const next = Math.max(0, current - 1);
    inMemoryStore.set(key, String(next));
    return next;
  }

  if (cmd === 'INCR') {
    const key = args[1] || '';
    const current = parseInt(inMemoryStore.get(key) || '0', 10);
    const next = current + 1;
    inMemoryStore.set(key, String(next));
    return next;
  }

  if (cmd === 'DEL') {
    let deleted = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {
      const key = args[i];
      if (inMemoryStore.has(key)) {
        deleted++;
      }
      inMemoryStore.delete(key);
      inMemoryExpiry.delete(key);
    }
    return deleted;
  }

  if (cmd === 'GET') {
    const key = args[1] || '';
    const pttl = getInMemoryPttl(key);
    if (pttl === -2) return null;
    return inMemoryStore.get(key) ?? null;
  }

  if (cmd === 'SET') {
    const key = args[1] || '';
    const val = String(args[2] ?? '');
    inMemoryStore.set(key, val);
    for (let i = 3; i < args.length; i++) {
      const opt = (args[i] || '').toUpperCase();
      if (opt === 'PX' && args[i + 1]) {
        inMemoryExpiry.set(key, Date.now() + Number(args[i + 1]));
        i++;
      } else if (opt === 'EX' && args[i + 1]) {
        inMemoryExpiry.set(key, Date.now() + Number(args[i + 1]) * 1000);
        i++;
      }
    }
    return 'OK';
  }

  if (cmd === 'PTTL') {
    const key = args[1] || '';
    return getInMemoryPttl(key);
  }

  if (cmd === 'PING') {
    return 'PONG';
  }

  if (cmd === 'FLUSHALL' || cmd === 'FLUSHDB') {
    inMemoryStore.clear();
    inMemoryExpiry.clear();
    return 'OK';
  }

  return 'OK';
}

export const rawRedis = new Redis(redisUrl, {
  maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
  lazyConnect: true,
  enableOfflineQueue: false,
  retryStrategy(times) {
    if (times > 2) return null; // Stop retrying quickly in local dev without docker
    return Math.min(times * 100, 300);
  },
});

rawRedis.on('connect', () => {
  isRedisConnected = true;
  console.log('[Redis] Connected to Redis server.');
});

rawRedis.on('ready', () => {
  isRedisConnected = true;
});

rawRedis.on('error', () => {
  isRedisConnected = false;
  // Non-fatal warning for local development without Docker
});

rawRedis.on('close', () => {
  isRedisConnected = false;
});

// Attempt background connection if Redis is running locally
rawRedis.connect().catch(() => {
  // Silently fall back to in-memory store if Redis server is not running
});

/**
 * High-performance Redis client with graceful in-memory fallback
 * for local development without Docker.
 */
export const redis = {
  /**
   * Executes a raw Redis command (used by rate-limit-redis RedisStore).
   */
  async call(...args: string[]): Promise<any> {
    // Always register SCRIPT LOAD in memory so SHA1 is known if fallback is needed
    if ((args[0] || '').toUpperCase() === 'SCRIPT' && (args[1] || '').toUpperCase() === 'LOAD') {
      executeInMemoryCommand(args);
    }

    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        const [command, ...rest] = args;
        return await (rawRedis as any).call(command, ...rest);
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err instanceof Error && /^NOSCRIPT(?:\s|$)/.test(err.message)) {
          throw err;
        }
        // Fall back to in-memory execution if Redis connection dropped
      }
    }

    return executeInMemoryCommand(args);
  },

  /**
   * Alias for call() to support sendCommand conventions.
   */
  async sendCommand(args: string[]): Promise<any> {
    return this.call(...args);
  },

  /**
   * Retrieves the string value associated with key.
   */
  async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await rawRedis.get(key);
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store if Redis command fails
      }
    }
    return executeInMemoryCommand(['GET', key]);
  },

  /**
   * Sets key to hold the string value.
   */
  async set(key: string, value: string | number, ...args: any[]): Promise<'OK' | string | null> {
    const strVal = String(value);
    executeInMemoryCommand(['SET', key, strVal, ...args.map(String)]);
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await (rawRedis as any).set(key, strVal, ...args);
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store
      }
    }
    return 'OK';
  },

  /**
   * Increments the number stored at key by one.
   * If key does not exist, it is set to 0 before performing the operation.
   */
  async incr(key: string): Promise<number> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        const val = await rawRedis.incr(key);
        inMemoryStore.set(key, String(val));
        return val;
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store
      }
    }
    return executeInMemoryCommand(['INCR', key]);
  },

  /**
   * Removes the specified key.
   */
  async del(key: string): Promise<number> {
    const existed = executeInMemoryCommand(['DEL', key]);
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await rawRedis.del(key);
      } catch {
        // Fall back to in-memory store
      }
    }
    return existed;
  },

  /**
   * Returns PONG if client/fallback is ready.
   */
  async ping(): Promise<string> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        return await rawRedis.ping();
      } catch {
        // Fall back
      }
    }
    return 'PONG';
  },

  /**
   * Clears the store.
   */
  async flushall(): Promise<'OK'> {
    inMemoryStore.clear();
    inMemoryExpiry.clear();
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        await rawRedis.flushall();
      } catch {
        // Fall back
      }
    }
    return 'OK';
  },

  /**
   * Quits connection.
   */
  async quit(): Promise<'OK'> {
    if (isRedisConnected) {
      try {
        await rawRedis.quit();
      } catch {
        // Suppress
      }
    }
    return 'OK';
  },

  /**
   * Disconnects client.
   */
  async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      rawRedis.disconnect();
    } catch {
      // Suppress
    }
  },

  get isConnected(): boolean {
    return isRedisConnected;
  },
};

export default redis;

```

```typescript
import { Request } from 'express';
import rateLimit, { ipKeyGenerator } from 'express-rate-limit';
import { RedisStore } from 'rate-limit-redis';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import redis from '../config/redis';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security';

/**
 * Dynamic RedisStore that always reads the current `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS`
 * from `securityConfig` on each increment operation.
 */
class ConfigurableRedisStore extends RedisStore {
  override async increment(key: string) {
    this.windowMs = securityConfig.rateLimitWindowMs;
    return super.increment(key);
  }
}

/**
 * Extracts user identifier from authenticated request (`req.user`) or Bearer token,
 * falling back to normalized client IP address (`ipKeyGenerator`).
 */
function resolveRateLimitKey(req: Request): string {
  if (req.user?.userId) {
    return `user:${req.user.userId}`;
  }

  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
  if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];
    try {
      const decoded = jwt.decode(token) as { userId?: number; id?: number } | null;
      const uid = decoded?.userId ?? decoded?.id;
      if (uid) {
        return `user:${uid}`;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore malformed token and fall back to IP
    }
  }

  const rawIp = req.ip || req.socket?.remoteAddress || '127.0.0.1';
  return `ip:${ipKeyGenerator(rawIp)}`;
}

/**
 * Global API Rate Limiter:
 * Restricts general API requests per user/IP to `RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX`
 * within the `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS` window using RedisStore.
 */
export const apiRateLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: securityConfig.rateLimitWindowMs,
  limit: () => securityConfig.rateLimitApiMax,
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: true,
  statusCode: 429,
  keyGenerator: (req: Request) => resolveRateLimitKey(req),
  store: new ConfigurableRedisStore({
    sendCommand: (...args: string[]) => redis.call(...args),
    prefix: 'rl:api:',
  }),
  validate: false,
  message: {
    success: false,
    message: 'Too many API requests. Please try again later.',
  },
});

export const globalRateLimiter = apiRateLimiter;

/**
 * Booking Rate Limiter:
 * Restricts booking creation (`POST /api/bookings`) to `RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX`
 * per user within the `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS` window using RedisStore.
 */
export const bookingRateLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: securityConfig.rateLimitWindowMs,
  limit: () => securityConfig.rateLimitBookingMax,
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: true,
  statusCode: 429,
  keyGenerator: (req: Request) => resolveRateLimitKey(req),
  store: new ConfigurableRedisStore({
    sendCommand: (...args: string[]) => redis.call(...args),
    prefix: 'rl:booking:',
  }),
  validate: false,
  message: {
    success: false,
    message: 'Too many booking requests. Please wait before creating more bookings.',
  },
});

/**
 * Authentication Rate Limiter (backward-compatible export backed by RedisStore and securityConfig).
 */
export const authRateLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: securityConfig.rateLimitWindowMs,
  limit: () => securityConfig.rateLimitApiMax,
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: true,
  statusCode: 429,
  keyGenerator: (req: Request) => {
    const rawIp = req.ip || req.socket?.remoteAddress || '127.0.0.1';
    return `ip:${ipKeyGenerator(rawIp)}`;
  },
  store: new ConfigurableRedisStore({
    sendCommand: (...args: string[]) => redis.call(...args),
    prefix: 'rl:auth:',
  }),
  validate: false,
  message: {
    success: false,
    message: 'Too many authentication attempts from this IP address. Please try again later.',
  },
});

export default apiRateLimiter;

```

```diff
+import {
+  requireCarrierDispatcher,
+  requireCarrierRole,
+  requireDockManager,
+} from '../middleware/rbac.middleware';
+import { idempotencyMiddleware } from '../middleware/idempotency.middleware';
+import { bookingRateLimiter } from '../middleware/rateLimit.middleware';
+
+const router = Router();
+
+/**
+ * @openapi
+ * /bookings:
+ *   get:
+ *     summary: List bookings for the authenticated user's organization
+ *     description: Returns bookings filtered by carrier organization or warehouse operator organization.
+ *     tags:
+ *       - Bookings
+ *     security:
+ *       - bearerAuth: []
+ *     responses:
+ *       200:
+ *         description: List of bookings
+ *       401:
+ *         description: Authentication required
+ *       429:
+ *         description: Too many API requests (rate limit exceeded)
+ */
+router.get('/', authMiddleware, getBookings);
+
+/**
+ * @openapi
+ * /bookings:
+ *   post:
+ *     summary: Create a confirmed dock booking
+ *     description: |
+ *       Atomically reserves a dock time slot and schedules an asynchronous outbox event.
+ *       Protected against concurrent double-booking and mobile network retries via Idempotency-Key.
+ *       Restricted to users with DISPATCHER role in a CARRIER organization.
+ *       Protected by a Redis-backed per-user booking rate limiter (RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX per RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS).
+ *     tags:
+ *       - Bookings
+ *     security:
+ *       - bearerAuth: []
+ *     parameters:
+ *       - in: header
+ *         name: Idempotency-Key
+ *         required: false
+ *         schema:
+ *           type: string
+ *         description: Unique key to ensure idempotent booking requests across retries
+ *         example: 7f8a1b2c-3d4e-5f6a-7b8c-9d0e1f2a3b4c
+ *     requestBody:
+ *       required: true
+ *       content:
+ *         application/json:
+ *           schema:
+ *             type: object
+ *             required:
+ *               - dockId
+ *               - slotStartTime
+ *               - slotEndTime
+ *               - truckPlate
+ *               - driverName
+ *               - driverPhone
+ *             properties:
+ *               dockId:
+ *                 type: integer
+ *                 example: 1
+ *               slotStartTime:
+ *                 type: string
+ *                 format: date-time
+ *                 example: '2026-11-15T04:00:00.000Z'
+ *               slotEndTime:
+ *                 type: string
+ *                 format: date-time
+ *                 example: '2026-11-15T04:30:00.000Z'
+ *               truckPlate:
+ *                 type: string
+ *                 example: WP-CA-4029
+ *               driverName:
+ *                 type: string
+ *                 example: Nuwan Perera
+ *               driverPhone:
+ *                 type: string
+ *                 example: '+94771234567'
+ *               cargoNote:
+ *                 type: string
+ *                 example: 20ft Container electronics
+ *     responses:
+ *       201:
+ *         description: Booking confirmed and outbox event created
+ *       400:
+ *         description: Slot out of operating hours, past date, or invalid payload
+ *       401:
+ *         description: Authentication required
+ *       403:
+ *         description: Only carrier dispatchers with verified emails can create bookings
+ *       409:
+ *         description: Slot already booked or maintenance closure active (Concurrency conflict)
+ *       429:
+ *         description: Too many booking requests (booking rate limit exceeded)
+ */
+router.post(
+  '/',
+  authMiddleware,
+  bookingRateLimiter,
+  requireVerifiedEmail,
+  requireCarrierDispatcher,
+  idempotencyMiddleware,
+  createBooking
+);
```

```diff
+ *               orgName:

+ */
+router.post('/register', register);
+

+ *       Tracks consecutive failed login attempts and locks the account for LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES after MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS failures.
+ *     tags:

+ *                 example: SecurePass123!
+ *     responses:
+ *       200:
+ *         description: Login successful, returns JWT token
+ *       401:

+ *       403:

+ *       423:
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import app from '../src/index';
import { prisma } from '../src/config/db.config';
import { securityConfig } from '../src/config/security';
import { authService } from '../src/services/auth.service';
import redis from '../src/config/redis';
import { OrganizationType, UserRole, DockStatus } from '@prisma/client';

describe('Configurable Security Controls Integration Tests', () => {
  let warehouseOrgId: number;
  let carrierOrgId: number;
  let warehouseId: number;
  let dockId: number;
  let dispatcherId: number;
  let dispatcherToken: string;

  const originalEnv = { ...process.env };

  beforeAll(async () => {
    await redis.flushall();

    // Create Warehouse Operator Org, Warehouse, and Dock for booking rate limit tests
    const whOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Sec Controls WH Org ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR,
      },
    });
    warehouseOrgId = whOrg.id;

    const warehouse = await prisma.warehouse.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: warehouseOrgId,
        name: 'Security Rate Limit Warehouse',
        address: '1 Security Way',
        timezone: 'UTC',
        slotLengthMinutes: 30,
        operatingHours: {
          create: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((dayOfWeek) => ({
            dayOfWeek,
            openTime: '00:00',
            closeTime: '24:00',
            slotLengthMinutes: 30,
          })),
        },
        docks: {
          create: [{ name: 'Sec Dock 1', status: DockStatus.ACTIVE }],
        },
      },
      include: { docks: true },
    });
    warehouseId = warehouse.id;
    dockId = warehouse.docks[0].id;

    // Create Carrier Org and Dispatcher
    const carrierOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
      data: {
        name: `Sec Controls Carrier Org ${Date.now()}`,
        type: OrganizationType.CARRIER,
      },
    });
    carrierOrgId = carrierOrg.id;

    const dispatcher = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        organizationId: carrierOrgId,
        email: `sec_dispatcher_${Date.now()}@test.com`,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash: 'dummy',
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
      },
    });
    dispatcherId = dispatcher.id;
    dispatcherToken = authService.generateToken(dispatcher, 0);
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // Restore default security env vars and flush Redis before each test
    process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN = originalEnv.JWT_EXPIRES_IN || '15m';
    process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN = originalEnv.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN || '7d';
    process.env.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS = originalEnv.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS || '60000';
    process.env.RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX = originalEnv.RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX || '100';
    process.env.RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX = originalEnv.RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX || '10';
    process.env.MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS = originalEnv.MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS || '5';
    process.env.LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES = originalEnv.LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES || '15';
    await redis.flushall();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    process.env = { ...originalEnv };
    await redis.flushall();
    try {
      await prisma.booking.deleteMany({ where: { dockId } });
      await prisma.dock.deleteMany({ where: { id: dockId } });
      await prisma.operatingHour.deleteMany({ where: { warehouseId } });
      await prisma.warehouse.deleteMany({ where: { id: warehouseId } });
      await prisma.user.deleteMany({ where: { organizationId: { in: [warehouseOrgId, carrierOrgId] } } });
      await prisma.organization.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: [warehouseOrgId, carrierOrgId] } } });
    } catch {
      // Ignore cleanup errors
    }
  });

  describe('1. Environment Configuration & Configurable JWT Lifetimes', () => {
    it('loads security configuration defaults and respects dynamic process.env overrides', () => {
      expect(securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn).toBe('15m');
      expect(securityConfig.jwtRefreshExpiresIn).toBe('7d');
      expect(securityConfig.rateLimitWindowMs).toBe(60000);
      expect(securityConfig.rateLimitApiMax).toBe(100);
      expect(securityConfig.rateLimitBookingMax).toBe(10);
      expect(securityConfig.maxFailedLoginAttempts).toBe(5);
      expect(securityConfig.loginLockoutDurationMinutes).toBe(15);

      process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN = '30m';
      process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN = '14d';
      expect(securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn).toBe('30m');
      expect(securityConfig.jwtRefreshExpiresIn).toBe('14d');
    });

    it('signs access and refresh JWT tokens using JWT_EXPIRES_IN (15m) and JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN (7d)', () => {
      const mockUser = {
        id: 999,
        organizationId: 1,
        role: UserRole.DISPATCHER,
        email: 'jwt_test@dockslot.com',
      };

      const accessToken = authService.generateToken(mockUser, 0);
      const refreshToken = authService.generateRefreshToken(mockUser, 0);

      const decodedAccess = jwt.decode(accessToken) as { iat: number; exp: number };
      const decodedRefresh = jwt.decode(refreshToken) as { iat: number; exp: number; type: string };

      // 15 minutes = 900 seconds
      expect(decodedAccess.exp - decodedAccess.iat).toBe(15 * 60);
      // 7 days = 604800 seconds
      expect(decodedRefresh.exp - decodedRefresh.iat).toBe(7 * 24 * 60 * 60);
      expect(decodedRefresh.type).toBe('refresh');
    });
  });

  describe('2. Brute-Force Login Protection & Account Lockout', () => {
    it('locks account for LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES after MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS consecutive failures and resets on valid login', async () => {
      const testEmail = `lockout_user_${Date.now()}@dockslot.com`;
      const [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]] = '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]';

      // Register user
      const regRes = await request(app).post('/api/auth/register').send({
        email: testEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]],
        organizationName: `Lockout Test Carrier ${Date.now()}`,
        organizationType: 'CARRIER',
      });
      expect(regRes.status).toBe(201);

      // Non-consecutive test: 2 wrong attempts followed by 1 valid login should reset counter to 0
      for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
        const res = await request(app).post('/api/auth/login').send({
          email: testEmail,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
        });
        expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      }

      const validRes = await request(app).post('/api/auth/login').send({
        email: testEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]],
      });
      expect(validRes.status).toBe(200);

      let userRecord = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: testEmail } });
      expect(userRecord?.failedLoginAttempts).toBe(0);
      expect(userRecord?.lockUntil).toBeNull();

      // Now 5 consecutive failed attempts -> 5th triggers 423 lockout for 15 minutes
      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 4; attempt++) {
        const failRes = await request(app).post('/api/auth/login').send({
          email: testEmail,
          [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
        });
        expect(failRes.status).toBe(401);
        expect(failRes.body.message).toContain(`${5 - attempt} attempt(s) remaining`);
      }

      const fifthFailRes = await request(app).post('/api/auth/login').send({
        email: testEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
      });
      expect(fifthFailRes.status).toBe(423);
      expect(fifthFailRes.body.message).toContain('5 consecutive failed login attempts');
      expect(fifthFailRes.body.message).toContain('15 minutes');

      userRecord = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: testEmail } });
      expect(userRecord?.failedLoginAttempts).toBe(5);
      expect(userRecord?.lockUntil).not.toBeNull();

      // Verify lock duration is ~15 minutes in the future
      const lockDiffMinutes = Math.round(
        ((userRecord!.lockUntil!.getTime() - Date.now()) / (60 * 1000))
      );
      expect(lockDiffMinutes).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(14);
      expect(lockDiffMinutes).toBeLessThanOrEqual(15);

      // Even with valid [REDACTED:generic-password], login is rejected with 423 while locked
      const lockedLoginRes = await request(app).post('/api/auth/login').send({
        email: testEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]],
      });
      expect(lockedLoginRes.status).toBe(423);

      // Clean up test user & org
      if (userRecord) {
        await prisma.user.delete({ where: { id: userRecord.id } });
        await prisma.organization.delete({ where: { id: userRecord.organizationId } });
      }
    });
  });

  describe('3. Redis-Backed Rate Limiting Middleware', () => {
    it('restricts POST /api/bookings to RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX per user within RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS and returns 429 with rate-limit headers', async () => {
      // Configure booking limit to 3 for fast deterministic testing
      process.env.RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX = '3';
      process.env.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS = '60000';

      // Requests 1..3 hit the booking endpoint (they can fail validation with 400 and still count against the rate limit)
      for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        const res = await request(app)
          .post('/api/bookings')
          .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
          .send({});

        expect(res.status).toBe(400);
        expect(res.headers['ratelimit-limit'] || res.headers['x-ratelimit-limit']).toBe('3');
        expect(res.headers['ratelimit-remaining'] || res.headers['x-ratelimit-remaining']).toBe(
          String(3 - i)
        );
      }

      // 4th booking request within window must be blocked with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
      const exceededRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`)
        .send({});

      expect(exceededRes.status).toBe(429);
      expect(exceededRes.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(exceededRes.headers['ratelimit-limit'] || exceededRes.headers['x-ratelimit-limit']).toBe('3');
      expect(
        exceededRes.headers['ratelimit-remaining'] || exceededRes.headers['x-ratelimit-remaining']
      ).toBe('0');
      expect(exceededRes.headers['retry-after']).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('restricts general /api/* requests to RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX within RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS and returns 429 with rate-limit headers', async () => {
      // Configure general API limit to 4 for fast deterministic testing
      process.env.RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX = '4';
      process.env.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS = '60000';

      for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
        const res = await request(app)
          .get('/api/bookings')
          .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

        expect(res.status).toBe(200);
        expect(res.headers['ratelimit-limit'] || res.headers['x-ratelimit-limit']).toBe('4');
        expect(res.headers['ratelimit-remaining'] || res.headers['x-ratelimit-remaining']).toBe(
          String(4 - i)
        );
      }

      // 5th general API request within window must return 429 Too Many Requests
      const exceededRes = await request(app)
        .get('/api/bookings')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${dispatcherToken}`);

      expect(exceededRes.status).toBe(429);
      expect(exceededRes.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(exceededRes.headers['ratelimit-limit'] || exceededRes.headers['x-ratelimit-limit']).toBe('4');
      expect(
        exceededRes.headers['ratelimit-remaining'] || exceededRes.headers['x-ratelimit-remaining']
      ).toBe('0');
      expect(exceededRes.headers['retry-after']).toBeDefined();
    });
  });
});
```

- **[`backend/src/config/security.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/config/security.ts)** (and re-exported via [`security.config.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/config/security.config.ts)): Created the central [`securityConfig`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/config/security.ts#L19-L73) module that parses and exports all security variables from `process.env`.

### 2. Configurable JWT Token Generation
- **[`backend/src/utils/jwt.utils.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/utils/jwt.utils.ts)**: Implemented [`signAccessToken`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/utils/jwt.utils.ts#L16-L28), [`signRefreshToken`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/utils/jwt.utils.ts#L33-L46), and [`verifyJwtToken`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/utils/jwt.utils.ts#L51-L53) pulling `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` and `JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN` from [`securityConfig`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/config/security.ts#L19-L73).
- Updated [`AuthService`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L67-L103), [`InvitationService`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/invitation.service.ts#L56-L86), and [`authenticate`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts#L28-L45) to use these configurable JWT utilities.

### 3. Brute-Force Login Protection & Account Lockout
- **[`AuthService.login`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L366-L461)**: Replaced hard-coded lockout values with `securityConfig.maxFailedLoginAttempts` (`MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS`) and `securityConfig.loginLockoutDurationMinutes` (`LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES`).
- Tracks consecutive failed login attempts, locks the account for the configured duration upon reaching the threshold, and resets `failedLoginAttempts` and `lockUntil` upon a valid login.

### 4. Redis-Backed Rate Limiting Middleware & OpenAPI Specification
- **[`backend/src/middleware/rateLimit.middleware.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/rateLimit.middleware.ts)** & **[`backend/src/config/redis.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/config/redis.ts#L180-L209)**:
  - [`apiRateLimiter`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/rateLimit.middleware.ts#L51-L67): Restricts general `/api/*` requests per user/IP to `RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX` per `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS` window via `rate-limit-redis` (`RedisStore`), mounted in [`app.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/app.ts#L33-L34).
  - [`bookingRateLimiter`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/rateLimit.middleware.ts#L76-L92): Restricts `POST /api/bookings` to `RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX` per user per `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS` window, applied in [`booking.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/booking.routes.ts#L108-L116).
  - Returns HTTP `429 Too Many Requests` with `RateLimit-*`, `X-RateLimit-*`, and `Retry-After` headers when exceeded.

```typescript
import dotenv from 'dotenv';

dotenv.config();

function parseEnvInt(value: string | undefined, fallback: number): number {
  if (!value) return fallback;
  const cleaned = value.split('#')[0].trim();
  const parsed = parseInt(cleaned, 10);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed) || parsed <= 0 ? fallback : parsed;
}

function parseEnvString(value: string | undefined, fallback: string): string {
  if (!value) return fallback;
  const cleaned = value.split('#')[0].trim();
  return cleaned || fallback;
}

export const securityConfig = {
  get jwtSecret(): string {
    return parseEnvString(process.env.JWT_SECRET, 'default_secret_key');
  },
  get jwtExpiresIn(): string {
    return parseEnvString(process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN, '15m');
  },
  get jwtRefreshExpiresIn(): string {
    return parseEnvString(process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN, '7d');
  },
  get saltRounds(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.BCRYPT_SALT_ROUNDS, 10);
  },
  get rateLimitWindowMs(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS, 60000);
  },
  get rateLimitApiMax(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX, 100);
  },
  get rateLimitBookingMax(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX, 10);
  },
  get maxFailedLoginAttempts(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS, 5);
  },
  get loginLockoutDurationMinutes(): number {
    return parseEnvInt(process.env.LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES, 15);
  },

  // Uppercase aliases matching .env variable names
  get JWT_SECRET(): string {
    return this.jwtSecret;
  },
  get JWT_EXPIRES_IN(): string {
    return this.jwtExpiresIn;
  },
  get JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN(): string {
    return this.jwtRefreshExpiresIn;
  },
  get RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS(): number {
    return this.rateLimitWindowMs;
  },
  get RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX(): number {
    return this.rateLimitApiMax;
  },
  get RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX(): number {
    return this.rateLimitBookingMax;
  },
  get MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS(): number {
    return this.maxFailedLoginAttempts;
  },
  get LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES(): number {
    return this.loginLockoutDurationMinutes;
  },
};

export const JWT_SECRET = securityConfig.jwtSecret;
export const JWT_EXPIRES_IN = securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn;
export const JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN = securityConfig.jwtRefreshExpiresIn;
export const RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS = securityConfig.rateLimitWindowMs;
export const RATE_LIMIT_API_MAX = securityConfig.rateLimitApiMax;
export const RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_MAX = securityConfig.rateLimitBookingMax;
export const MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS = securityConfig.maxFailedLoginAttempts;
export const LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES = securityConfig.loginLockoutDurationMinutes;

export default securityConfig;
```

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Analyzing the automatic `NO_SHOW` functionality, specifically how it triggers 20 minutes after the scheduled start time. The focus will be on the interaction between backend processes and the `DispatcherDashboard.tsx` frontend component. Initial observation indicates the need to clarify how a booking transition to status `NO_SHOW` when the conditions are met.


The system should introduce a new method within the booking service to automatically mark bookings as "NO_SHOW" if the scheduled start time has passed by at least 20 minutes and the booking status is still "BOOKED." This method will update the booking status in the database and ensure persistence through the recording of an outbox event. Furthermore, it should handle audit logging related to the change, integrating it with the user or organization-level context.


The backend should consistently check for overdue bookings within the `getBookings` process and other booking interactions, automatically updating statuses to "NO_SHOW" if the `slotStartTime` has passed by 20 minutes. The frontend's `DispatcherDashboard.tsx` can also use a helper to identify and visually highlight potentially overdue bookings in the current loaded state. Allowing authorized roles to trigger this status update manually through a dedicated endpoint or `getBookings` refresh will provide added flexibility.


The backend logic for detecting and marking `NO_SHOW` bookings involves a time-based check against the `slotStartTime` plus a grace period. This grace period is defined as 20 minutes. A timer in the frontend dashboard component will periodically and immediately after bookings are loaded, check if the conditions for `NO_SHOW` are met, updating the front-end state and triggering a backend synchronization. This also allows the designated roles to manually update a booking status to "NO_SHOW".


The core logic centers around a backend service checking for overdue bookings when data is fetched, automatically updating their status to "NO_SHOW" if the time threshold is crossed and persistently recording this change. The frontend dashboard needs a mechanism to trigger this change if the same booking is loaded and active in the user session. The authorization should only permit certain roles to change a booking to "NO_SHOW".

Periodic checks in the frontend will identify eligible bookings, triggering an API call to synchronize the booking status. This approach ensures immediate updates for active users while maintaining data consistency. The backend acts as the authoritative source.
</details></think>

```diff
+  /**
+   * Automatically transitions any BOOKED booking whose scheduled slotStartTime has passed
+   * by 20 or more minutes without arrival to NO_SHOW.
+   */
+  async autoMarkOverdueBookingsAsNoShow(userId?: number): Promise<number> {
+    const AUTO_NO_SHOW_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000;
+    const cutoffTime = new Date(Date.now() - AUTO_NO_SHOW_MS);
+
+    const overdueBookings = await prisma.booking.findMany({
+      where: {
+        status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
+        slotStartTime: {
+          lte: cutoffTime,
+        },
+      },
+      include: {
+        dock: {
+          include: {
+            warehouse: true,
+          },
+        },
+      },
+    });
+
+    if (overdueBookings.length === 0) {
+      return 0;
+    }
+
+    let updatedCount = 0;
+    for (const overdue of overdueBookings) {
+      try {
+        await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+          const current = await tx.booking.findUnique({ where: { id: overdue.id } });
+          if (!current || current.status !== BookingStatus.BOOKED) {
+            return;
+          }
+
+          await tx.booking.update({
+            where: { id: overdue.id },
+            data: {
+              status: BookingStatus.NO_SHOW,
+            },
+          });
+
+          // Resolve a valid user ID for audit logging if not explicitly provided
+          let auditUserId = userId;
+          if (!auditUserId) {
+            const fallbackUser = await tx.user.findFirst({
+              where: {
+                OR: [
+                  { organizationId: overdue.carrierOrgId },
+                  { organizationId: overdue.dock.warehouse.organizationId },
+                ],
+              },
+              select: { id: true },
+            });
+            auditUserId = fallbackUser?.id;
+          }
+
+          if (auditUserId) {
+            await tx.auditLog.create({
+              data: {
+                bookingId: overdue.id,
+                userId: auditUserId,
+                action: 'STATUS_CHANGED',
+                details: {
+                  oldStatus: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
+                  newStatus: BookingStatus.NO_SHOW,
+                  reason: 'Automatically marked as NO_SHOW after 20 minutes past scheduled slot start time',
+                  updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+                },
+              },
+            });
+          }
+
+          await tx.outboxEvent.create({
+            data: {
+              aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
+              aggregateId: String(overdue.id),
+              payload: {
+                action: 'STATUS_CHANGED',
+                bookingId: overdue.id,
+                carrierOrgId: overdue.carrierOrgId,
+                dockId: overdue.dockId,
+                oldStatus: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
+                newStatus: BookingStatus.NO_SHOW,
+                reason: 'Automatically marked as NO_SHOW after 20 minutes past scheduled slot start time',
+                updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+              },
+              status: OutboxStatus.PENDING,
+            },
+          });
+
+          updatedCount++;
+        });
+      } catch {
+        // Ignore concurrent transition error
+      }
+    }
+
+    return updatedCount;
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Retrieves bookings for the user's organization.
+   * Automatically marks any BOOKED bookings overdue by >= 20 minutes as NO_SHOW before returning.
+   */
+  async getBookings(organizationId: number, role: string, userId?: number) {
+    if (!organizationId) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Organization ID is required.' };
+    }
+
+    await this.autoMarkOverdueBookingsAsNoShow(userId);
+
+    if (role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN' || role === 'DISPATCHER') {
+      return prisma.booking.findMany({
+        where: { carrierOrgId: organizationId },
+        include: {
+          dock: {
+            include: {
+              warehouse: true,
+            },
+          },
+        },
+        orderBy: { slotStartTime: 'desc' },
+      });
+    }
+
+    // Warehouse Operator
+    return prisma.booking.findMany({
+      where: {
+        dock: {
+          warehouse: {
+            organizationId,
+          },
+        },
+      },
+      include: {
+        dock: {
+          include: {
+            warehouse: true,
+          },
+        },
+        carrierOrg: true,
+      },
+      orderBy: { slotStartTime: 'desc' },
+    });
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Updates booking status (ARRIVED, NO_SHOW, COMPLETED).
+   * - Warehouse operators (DOCK_MANAGER / WAREHOUSE_ADMIN) can update status for their warehouse's bookings after slotStartTime.
+   * - Carrier users (DISPATCHER / CARRIER_ADMIN) can transition their own BOOKED booking to NO_SHOW when >= 20 minutes have elapsed past slotStartTime.
+   * Records an audit log entry tracking the status change.
+   */
+  async updateBookingStatus(
+    bookingId: number,
+    requesterOrgId: number,
+    userId: number,
+    status: 'ARRIVED' | 'NO_SHOW' | 'COMPLETED',
+    requesterRole?: string
+  ) {
+    if (!bookingId || isNaN(bookingId)) {
+      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid booking ID.' };
+    }
+
+    const validStatuses = ['ARRIVED', 'NO_SHOW', 'COMPLETED'];
+    if (!status || !validStatuses.includes(status)) {
+      throw {
+        status: 400,
+        message: `Invalid status '${status}'. Allowed statuses are: ${validStatuses.join(', ')}.`,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const booking = await prisma.booking.findUnique({
+      where: { id: bookingId },
+      include: {
+        dock: {
+          include: {
+            warehouse: true,
+          },
+        },
+        carrierOrg: true,
+      },
+    });
+
+    if (!booking) {
+      throw { status: 404, message: 'Booking not found.' };
+    }
+
+    const isCarrierRole = requesterRole === 'DISPATCHER' || requesterRole === 'CARRIER_ADMIN';
+    const now = new Date();
+    const slotStartMs = new Date(booking.slotStartTime).getTime();
+
+    if (isCarrierRole) {
+      if (booking.carrierOrgId !== requesterOrgId) {
+        throw {
+          status: 403,
+          message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to update this booking.',
+        };
+      }
+      if (status !== 'NO_SHOW') {
+        throw {
+          status: 403,
+          message: 'Forbidden. Only Dock Managers can mark bookings as ARRIVED or COMPLETED.',
+        };
+      }
+      if (now.getTime() - slotStartMs < 20 * 60 * 1000) {
+        throw {
+          status: 400,
+          message: 'Booking can only be automatically marked as NO_SHOW after 20 minutes past the scheduled slot start time.',
+        };
+      }
+      if (booking.status === BookingStatus.NO_SHOW) {
+        return booking;
+      }
+      if (booking.status !== BookingStatus.BOOKED) {
+        throw {
+          status: 400,
+          message: `Cannot mark booking as NO_SHOW when current status is ${booking.status}.`,
+        };
+      }
+    } else {
+      if (booking.dock.warehouse.organizationId !== requesterOrgId) {
+        throw {
+          status: 403,
+          message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage bookings for this warehouse.',
+        };
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.CANCELLED) {
+      throw {
+        status: 400,
+        message: 'Cannot update status of a cancelled booking.',
+      };
+    }
+
+    // Validation: Booking status can only be changed after the scheduled slot start time has passed
+    if (now < new Date(booking.slotStartTime)) {
+      throw {
+        status: 400,
+        message: 'Booking status can only be changed after the scheduled slot start time has passed.',
+      };
+    }
+
+    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const updatedBooking = await tx.booking.update({
+        where: { id: bookingId },
+        data: {
+          status: status as BookingStatus,
+        },
+        include: {
+          dock: {
+            include: {
+              warehouse: true,
+            },
+          },
+          carrierOrg: true,
+        },
+      });
+
+      // Record AuditLog entry tracking the status change
+      await tx.auditLog.create({
+        data: {
+          bookingId,
+          userId,
+          action: 'STATUS_CHANGED',
+          details: {
+            oldStatus: booking.status,
+            newStatus: status,
+            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+          },
+        },
+      });
+
+      // Simultaneously create OutboxEvent
+      await tx.outboxEvent.create({
+        data: {
+          aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
+          aggregateId: String(booking.id),
+          payload: {
+            action: 'STATUS_CHANGED',
+            bookingId: booking.id,
+            carrierOrgId: booking.carrierOrgId,
+            dockId: booking.dockId,
+            oldStatus: booking.status,
+            newStatus: status,
+            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+          },
+          status: OutboxStatus.PENDING,
+        },
+      });
+
+      return updatedBooking;
+    });
+
+    return result;
+  }
+}
+
+export const bookingService = new BookingService();
+
```

```diff
   /**
+   * Automatically transitions any BOOKED booking whose scheduled slotStartTime has passed
+   * by 20 or more minutes without arrival to NO_SHOW.
+   */
+  async autoMarkOverdueBookingsAsNoShow(userId?: number): Promise<number> {
+    const AUTO_NO_SHOW_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000;
+    const cutoffTime = new Date(Date.now() - AUTO_NO_SHOW_MS);
+
+    const overdueBookings = await prisma.booking.findMany({
+      where: {
+        status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
+        slotStartTime: {
+          lte: cutoffTime,
+        },
+      },
+      include: {
+        dock: {
+          include: {
+            warehouse: true,
+          },
+        },
+      },
+    });
+
+    if (overdueBookings.length === 0) {
+      return 0;
+    }
+
+    let updatedCount = 0;
+    for (const overdue of overdueBookings) {
+      try {
+        await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+          const current = await tx.booking.findUnique({ where: { id: overdue.id } });
+          if (!current || current.status !== BookingStatus.BOOKED) {
+            return;
+          }
+
+          await tx.booking.update({
+            where: { id: overdue.id },
+            data: {
+              status: BookingStatus.NO_SHOW,
+            },
+          });
+
+          // Resolve a valid user ID for audit logging if not explicitly provided
+          let auditUserId = userId;
+          if (!auditUserId) {
+            const fallbackUser = await tx.user.findFirst({
+              where: {
+                OR: [
+                  { organizationId: overdue.carrierOrgId },
+                  { organizationId: overdue.dock.warehouse.organizationId },
+                ],
+              },
+              select: { id: true },
+            });
+            auditUserId = fallbackUser?.id;
+          }
+
+          if (auditUserId) {
+            await tx.auditLog.create({
+              data: {
+                bookingId: overdue.id,
+                userId: auditUserId,
+                action: 'STATUS_CHANGED',
+                details: {
+                  oldStatus: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
+                  newStatus: BookingStatus.NO_SHOW,
+                  reason: 'Automatically marked as NO_SHOW after 20 minutes past scheduled slot start time',
+                  updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+                },
+              },
+            });
+          }
+

+                updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+              },
+              status: OutboxStatus.PENDING,
+            },
+          });
+
+          updatedCount++;
+        });

+        // Ignore concurrent transition error
+      }

+
```

```diff
+export const getBookings = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
+  try {
+    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
+    if (!organizationId) {
+      res.status(401).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Unauthorized. Organization context required.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const bookings = await bookingService.getBookings(
+      organizationId,
+      req.user!.role,
+      req.user?.userId
+    );
+    res.status(200).json({
+      success: true,
+      data: bookings,
+    });
+  } catch (error: any) {
+    const status = error.status || 500;
+    res.status(status).json({
+      success: false,
+      message: error.message || 'An error occurred while fetching bookings.',
+    });
+  }
+};
+
+/**
+ * Updates booking operational status (ARRIVED, NO_SHOW, COMPLETED).
+ * Status can only be changed after the booking's scheduled slot start time has passed.
+ * PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status
+ */
+export const updateBookingStatus = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
+  try {
+    const organizationId = req.user?.organizationId;
+    const userId = req.user?.userId;
+    if (!organizationId || !userId) {
+      res.status(401).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Unauthorized. Authentication context required.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const rawId = Array.isArray(req.params.id) ? req.params.id[0] : req.params.id;
+    const bookingId = parseInt(rawId, 10);
+    if (isNaN(bookingId)) {
+      res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Invalid booking ID.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const { status } = req.body;
+    if (!status) {
+      res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: 'Status is required.',
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const updatedBooking = await bookingService.updateBookingStatus(
+      bookingId,
+      organizationId,
+      userId,
+      status,
+      req.user?.role
+    );
+
+    res.status(200).json({
+      success: true,
+      message: 'Booking status updated successfully',
+      data: updatedBooking,
+    });
+  } catch (error: any) {
+    const status = error.status || 500;
+    res.status(status).json({
+      success: false,
+      message: error.message || 'An error occurred while updating booking status.',
+    });
+  }
+};
```

```text
246:         const d = new Date(b.slotStartTime);
247:         const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
248:         const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
249:         const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
250:         const dateStr = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
251:         datesMap.set(dateStr, (datesMap.get(dateStr) || 0) + 1);
252:       }
253:     });
254: 
255:     return datesMap;
256:   }, [bookings, selectedDockForClosure]);
257: 
258:   // Generate next 14 calendar days starting from today for quick selection
259:   const upcomingDays = useMemo(() => {
260:     const days: {
261:       dateStr: string;
262:       dayOfWeekShort: string;
263:       dayOfMonth: number;
264:       monthShort: string;
265:     }[] = [];
266: 
267:     const today = new Date();
268:     today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
269: 
270:     for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
271:       const d = new Date(today);
272:       d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
273: 
274:       const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
275:       const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
276:       const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
277:       const dateStr = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
278: 
279:       days.push({
280:         dateStr,
281:         dayOfWeekShort: d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short' }),
282:         dayOfMonth: d.getDate(),
283:         monthShort: d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short' }),
284:       });
285:     }
286: 
287:     return days;
288:   }, []);
289: 
290:   const isSelectedDateBooked = useMemo(() => {
291:     if (!selectedClosureDate) return false;
292:     return bookedDatesForSelectedDock.has(selectedClosureDate);
293:   }, [selectedClosureDate, bookedDatesForSelectedDock]);
294: 
295:   const hasBookingConflict = useMemo(() => {
296:     if (isSelectedDateBooked) return true;
297:     if (!closureStartTime || !closureEndTime || !selectedDockForClosure) return false;
298: 
299:     const startDate = new Date(closureStartTime);
300:     const endDate = new Date(closureEndTime);
301:     if (isNaN(startDate.getTime()) || isNaN(endDate.getTime())) return false;
302: 
303:     const cur = new Date(startDate);
304:     cur.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
305:     const end = new Date(endDate);
306:     end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
307: 
308:     while (cur <= end) {
309:       const yyyy = cur.getFullYear();
310:       const mm = String(cur.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
311:       const dd = String(cur.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
312:       const dateStr = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
313:       if (bookedDatesForSelectedDock.has(dateStr)) {
314:         return true;
315:       }
316:       cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);
317:     }
318:     return false;
319:   }, [isSelectedDateBooked, closureStartTime, closureEndTime, selectedDockForClosure, bookedDatesForSelectedDock]);
320: 
321:   // Open Closure Modal (optionally preselecting a dock)
322:   const handleOpenClosureModal = (dockId?: number) => {
323:     setClosureError(null);
324:     const targetDockId = dockId !== undefined ? dockId : allDocks[0]?.id || '';
325:     setSelectedDockForClosure(targetDockId);
326: 
327:     // Compute booked dates for targetDockId
328:     const targetBookedDates = new Set<string>();
329:     bookings.forEach((b) => {
330:       const bDockId = b.dockId ?? b.dock?.id;
331:       if (
332:         bDockId === Number(targetDockId) &&
333:         (b.status === 'BOOKED' || b.status === 'ARRIVED')
334:       ) {
335:         const d = new Date(b.slotStartTime);
336:         const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
337:         const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
338:         const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
339:         targetBookedDates.add(`${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`);
340:       }
341:     });
342: 
343:     const today = new Date();
344:     today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
345:     let chosenDate = '';
346:     for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
347:       const d = new Date(today);
348:       d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
349:       const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
350:       const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
351:       const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
352:       const dateStr = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
353:       if (!targetBookedDates.has(dateStr)) {
354:         chosenDate = dateStr;
355:         break;
356:       }
357:     }
358:     if (!chosenDate) {
359:       const yyyy = today.getFullYear();
360:       const mm = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
361:       const dd = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
362:       chosenDate = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
363:     }
364: 
365:     setSelectedClosureDate(chosenDate);
366:     setClosureStartTimeOnly('08:00');
367:     setClosureEndTimeOnly('18:00');
368:     setClosureStartTime(`${chosenDate}T08:00`);
369:     setClosureEndTime(`${chosenDate}T18:00`);
370:     setClosureReason('');
371:     setIsClosureModalOpen(true);
372:   };
373: 
374:   const handleSelectClosureDate = (dateStr: string) => {
375:     setSelectedClosureDate(dateStr);
376:     setClosureStartTime(`${dateStr}T${closureStartTimeOnly}`);
377:     setClosureEndTime(`${dateStr}T${closureEndTimeOnly}`);
378:     if (closureError) setClosureError(null);
379:   };
380: 
381:   const handleStartTimeChange = (timeStr: string) => {
382:     setClosureStartTimeOnly(timeStr);
383:     if (selectedClosureDate) {
384:       setClosureStartTime(`${selectedClosureDate}T${timeStr}`);
385:     }
386:   };
387: 
388:   const handleEndTimeChange = (timeStr: string) => {
389:     setClosureEndTimeOnly(timeStr);
390:     if (selectedClosureDate) {
391:       setClosureEndTime(`${selectedClosureDate}T${timeStr}`);
392:     }
393:   };
394: 
395:   // Submit Closure Modal
396:   const handleSubmitClosure = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
397:     e.preventDefault();
398:     setClosureError(null);
399: 
400:     if (!selectedDockForClosure) {
401:       setClosureError('Please select a dock to schedule maintenance.');
402:       return;
403:     }
404: 
405:     if (hasBookingConflict) {
406:       setClosureError(
407:         'Cannot schedule maintenance closure: an active booking exists on this dock for that day.'
408:       );
409:       return;
410:     }
411: 
412:     const trimmedReason = closureReason.trim();
413:     if (!trimmedReason) {
414:       setClosureError('Maintenance reason is required and cannot be blank.');
415:       return;
416:     }
417: 
418:     if (!closureStartTime || !closureEndTime) {
419:       setClosureError('Both start time and end time are required.');
420:       return;
421:     }
422: 
423:     const startDate = new Date(closureStartTime);
424:     const endDate = new Date(closureEndTime);
425: 
426:     if (isNaN(startDate.getTime()) || isNaN(endDate.getTime())) {
427:       setClosureError('Please enter valid start and end dates.');
428:       return;
429:     }
430: 
431:     // Client-side validation: start time cannot be in the past
432:     const now = new Date();
433:     if (startDate < now) {
434:       setClosureError(
435:         'Closure start time cannot be in the past. Please select a current or future time.'
436:       );
437:       return;
438:     }
439: 
440:     if (endDate <= startDate) {
441:       setClosureError('End time must be after the start time.');
442:       return;
443:     }
444: 
445:     try {
446:       setIsSubmittingClosure(true);
447: 
448:       const res = await warehouseApi.createDockClosure(Number(selectedDockForClosure), {
449:         startTime: startDate.toISOString(),
450:         endTime: endDate.toISOString(),
451:         reason: trimmedReason,
452:       });
453: 
454:       const newClosure = res.data;
455:       const targetDock = allDocks.find((d) => d.id === Number(selectedDockForClosure));
456: 
457:       setClosures((prev) => [{ ...newClosure, dock: targetDock }, ...prev]);
458:       setSuccessBanner(
459:         `Maintenance closure scheduled successfully for Dock ${
460:           targetDock?.name || selectedDockForClosure
461:         }.`
462:       );
463:       setIsClosureModalOpen(false);
464: 
465:       // Refresh data in background
466:       fetchData();
467:     } catch (err: any) {
468:       const serverMessage =
469:         err.response?.data?.message ||
470:         err.message ||
471:         'Failed to schedule dock closure. Please check for scheduling conflicts.';
472:       setClosureError(serverMessage);
473:     } finally {
474:       setIsSubmittingClosure(false);
475:     }
476:   };
477: 
478:   // Helper for Status Badge styling
479:   const renderStatusBadge = (status: BookingStatus) => {
480:     switch (status) {
481:       case 'BOOKED':
482:         return (
483:           <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200">
484:             <Clock className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
485:             BOOKED
486:           </span>
487:         );
488:       case 'ARRIVED':
489:         return (
490:           <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
491:             <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
492:             ARRIVED
493:           </span>
494:         );
495:       case 'COMPLETED':
496:         return (
497:           <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200">
498:             <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
499:             COMPLETED
500:           </span>
501:         );
502:       case 'NO_SHOW':
503:         return (
504:           <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200">
505:             <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
506:             NO-SHOW
507:           </span>
508:         );
509:       case 'CANCELLED':
510:         return (
511:           <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border border-gray-300">
512:             <XCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
513:             CANCELLED
514:           </span>
515:         );
516:       default:
517:         return (
518:           <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border border-gray-300">
519:             {status}
520:           </span>
521:         );
522:     }
523:   };
524: 
525:   return (
526:     <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
527:       {/* Page Header */}
528:       <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 border-b border-gray-200 pb-5">
529:         <div>
530:           <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
531:             <div className="p-2 bg-[#2F4F4F] text-white rounded-lg shadow-sm">
532:               <WarehouseIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
533:             </div>
534:             <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900">
535:               Dock Manager Dashboard
536:             </h1>
537:           </div>
538:           <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
539:             Real-time yard check-ins, dock availability tracking, and maintenance closure management.
540:           </p>
541:         </div>
542: 
543:         <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
544:           <Button
545:             variant="outline"
546:             size="sm"
547:             onClick={fetchData}
548:             isLoading={isLoadingBookings || isLoadingWarehouses}
549:             className="flex items-center space-x-1.5"
550:           >
551:             <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
552:             <span>Refresh</span>
553:           </Button>
554: 
555:           <Button
556:             variant="primary"
557:             size="sm"
558:             onClick={() => handleOpenClosureModal()}
559:             className="flex items-center space-x-1.5"
560:           >
561:             <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
562:             <span>Close Dock / Maintenance</span>
563:           </Button>
564:         </div>
565:       </div>
566: 
567:       {/* Global Alert Banners */}
568:       {errorMessage && (
569:         <div
570:           role="alert"
571:           className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-red-800 flex items-start space-x-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200"
572:         >
573:           <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
574:           <div className="flex-1 font-medium">{errorMessage}</div>
575:           <button
576:             onClick={() => setErrorMessage(null)}
577:             className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600"
578:           >
579:             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
580:           </button>
581:         </div>
582:       )}
583: 
584:       {successBanner && (
585:         <div
586:           role="status"
587:           className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-emerald-800 flex items-start space-x-3 animate-in fade-in duration-200"
588:         >
589:           <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
590:           <div className="flex-1 font-medium">{successBanner}</div>
591:           <button
592:             onClick={() => setSuccessBanner(null)}
593:             className="text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600"
594:           >
595:             <X className="w-4 h-4" />
596:           </button>
597:         </div>
598:       )}
599: 
600:       {/* Section 1: Dock Bay Operational Status Overview */}
601:       <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
602:         <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between pb-3">
603:           <div>
604:             <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
605:               <Wrench className="w-4 h-4 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
606:               <span>Dock Bays & Operational Status</span>
607:             </CardTitle>
608:             <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
609:               Active loading bays and ongoing scheduled maintenance closures.
610:             </p>
611:           </div>
612:           <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-md text-gray-700">
613:             {allDocks.length} {allDocks.length === 1 ? 'Bay' : 'Bays'} Total
614:           </span>
615:         </CardHeader>
616: 
617:         <CardContent>
618:           {isLoadingWarehouses ? (
619:             <div className="py-8 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 text-gray-500 text-sm">
620:               <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
621:               <span>Loading docks...</span>
622:             </div>
623:           ) : allDocks.length === 0 ? (
624:             <div className="text-center py-6 text-sm text-gray-500">
625:               No docks registered in your warehouse facilities.
626:             </div>
627:           ) : (
628:             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5">
629:               {allDocks.map((dock) => {
630:                 const now = new Date();
631:                 const activeClosureNow = closures.find(
632:                   (c) =>
633:                     c.dockId === dock.id &&
634:                     new Date(c.startTime) <= now &&
635:                     new Date(c.endTime) >= now
636:                 );
637:                 const hasActiveClosureNow = !!activeClosureNow;
638:                 const isUnderMaintenance =
639:                   (dock.effectiveStatus || dock.status) === 'MAINTENANCE' || hasActiveClosureNow;
640:                 // Check if dock has active/upcoming closures
641:                 const dockClosures = closures.filter((c) => c.dockId === dock.id);
642:                 const hasUpcomingClosures = dockClosures.length > 0;
643: 
644:                 return (

646:                     key={dock.id}
647:                     className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border transition-all ${
648:                       isUnderMaintenance
649:                         ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/50'
650:                         : 'border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-300 shadow-xs'
651:                     }`}
652:                   >
653:                     <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
654:                       <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-900 truncate">
655:                         {dock.name}
656:                       </div>
657:                       <span
658:                         className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center space-x-1 ${
659:                           isUnderMaintenance
660:                             ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200'
661:                             : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200'
662:                         }`}
663:                       >
664:                         {isUnderMaintenance ? (
665:                           <>
666:                             {hasActiveClosureNow && (
667:                               <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse inline-block mr-1"></span>
668:                             )}
669:                             <span>Maintenance</span>
670:                           </>
671:                         ) : (
672:                           'Active'
673:                         )}
674:                       </span>
675:                     </div>
676: 
677:                     <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 flex items-center space-x-1 truncate mb-3">
678:                       <WarehouseIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" />
679:                       <span className="truncate">{dock.warehouseName}</span>
680:                     </div>
681: 
682:                     {hasUpcomingClosures && (
683:                       <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-900 bg-amber-100/70 p-1.5 rounded mb-2 flex items-start space-x-1">
684:                         <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
685:                         <span className="truncate">

687:                         </span>
688:                       </div>
689:                     )}
690: 
691:                     <div className="pt-1 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-end">
692:                       <button
693:                         type="button"
694:                         onClick={() => handleOpenClosureModal(dock.id)}
695:                         className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#2F4F4F] hover:underline inline-flex items-center"
696:                       >
697:                         <PlusCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
698:                         <span>Schedule Closure</span>
699:                       </button>
700:                     </div>
701:                   </div>
702:                 );
703:               })}
704:             </div>
705:           )}
706:         </CardContent>
707:       </Card>
708: 
709:       {/* Section 2: Warehouse Bookings Table */}
710:       <Card className="bg-white shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
711:         <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-gray-100">
712:           <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-3">
713:             <div>
714:               <CardTitle className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
715:                 <Truck className="w-5 h-5 text-[#2F4F4F]" />
716:                 <span>Warehouse Bookings & Yard Activity</span>
717:               </CardTitle>
718:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
719:                 Incoming truck appointments, carrier dispatch manifests, and quick check-in actions.
720:               </p>
721:             </div>
722: 
723:             {/* Total Count Pill */}
724:             <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
725:               <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
726:                 Showing{' '}
727:                 <strong className="text-gray-900">{filteredBookings.length}</strong> of{' '}
728:                 <strong className="text-gray-900">{bookings.length}</strong> bookings
729:               </span>
730:             </div>
731:           </div>
732: 
733:           {/* Search & Filter Toolbar */}
734:           <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 pt-4">
735:             {/* Search Bar */}
736:             <div className="sm:col-span-2">
737:               <Input
738:                 type="text"
739:                 placeholder="Search by ID, truck plate, driver, carrier..."
740:                 value={searchQuery}
741:                 onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
742:                 icon={<Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />}
743:               />
744:             </div>
745: 
746:             {/* Warehouse Filter */}
747:             <div>
748:               <div className="relative">
749:                 <select
750:                   value={selectedWarehouseId}
751:                   onChange={(e) => setSelectedWarehouseId(e.target.value)}
752:                   className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-gray-300 pl-3 pr-8 text-xs bg-white text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F] focus:border-[#2F4F4F]"
753:                 >
754:                   <option value="ALL">All Warehouses</option>
755:                   {warehouses.map((wh) => (
756:                     <option key={wh.id} value={wh.id}>
757:                       {wh.name}
758:                     </option>
759:                   ))}
760:                 </select>
761:                 <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 absolute right-2.5 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
762:               </div>

764:

766:             <div>

770:                   onChange={(e) => setSelectedStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
771:                   className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-gray-300 pl-3 pr-8 text-xs bg-white text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2F4F4F] focus:border-[#2F4F4F]"
772:                 >
773:                   <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
774:                   <option value="BOOKED">BOOKED (Incoming)</option>
775:                   <option value="ARRIVED">ARRIVED (In Yard)</option>
776:                   <option value="COMPLETED">COMPLETED</option>
777:                   <option value="NO_SHOW">NO_SHOW</option>
778:                   <option value="CANCELLED">CANCELLED</option>
779:                 </select>

781:               </div>
782:             </div>
783:           </div>
784:         </CardHeader>
785: 
786:         <CardContent className="p-0">
787:           {isLoadingBookings ? (
788:             <div className="py-16 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-3 text-gray-500">
789:               <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[#2F4F4F] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
790:               <p className="text-sm font-medium">Loading warehouse bookings...</p>
791:             </div>
792:           ) : filteredBookings.length === 0 ? (
793:             <div className="py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
794:               <Truck className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-gray-300 mb-2" />
795:               <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">No bookings found</p>
796:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
797:                 {bookings.length === 0
798:                   ? 'No dock reservations have been created for this warehouse yet.'
```
